sogs pas ci bya snyam na/ de ltar gnas pa de mthar thug gi bgrod bya'i cha nas 'bras bur bzhag cing*/ de'i ngo bo ma rig pas bsgribs te yin yang phyin ci log tu snang ba dung ser 'dzin bzhin gyur pa sbyong dus rang gi ngo bo dang po'i gzhi thog tu phebs shing 'khrul snang glo bur ba ldog pa las 'bras bu gzhan zhig sngar med gsar byung du bsgrub pa ma yin te/ kun 'dus las/ btsal nas thob pa ma yin te/ / rgyu nyid dus na 'bras bu'i mchog/ ces so/ / gsum pa gang la gdams pa'i snod bstan pa la gnyis las/ skal bzang sby-in pa'i snod ni/ sangs rgyas kuna~X gyi~X gsang ba phyaga~X rgya~X che~Xn po~X gsang sngags nang pa gsum yin la/ de dag gi nang nas kyang mchoga~X tu 'phags shing ngo mtshar ba'i mchog rang bzhin gsang ba'i snying po'i rgyud yin pas gang zag mang du thosa~X pas tshig gi rim pa la mkhas shing de'i don bsa~Xms byung gi shes rab kyis dpyad pas don gyi gnas lugs la mkhas pa des yang dag pa'i don de nyid bsgoma~X pa la~X yang dang yang du legs par raba~X tu sbyanga~Xs pa'i~X shesa~X raba~X kyi miga~X dang ldana~X pa rnama~Xs kyisa~X zunga~Xs shig pa'o/ / de'i nang nas kyang rang bzhin gsang ba'i snying po'i snoda~X dang ldana~X pas zab mo'i don rlabs po che la mi skrag cing mos pa sems kyi nganga~X tshula~X dge zhing bza~Xng bas sdig pa spong zhing rkyen gyis mi 'gyur la~X dad pa brtana~X pa de la chos 'di gtad par bya zhing rang gi lusa~X dnga~X longasa~X spyoda~X thams cad bla ma dang chos kyi phyogs su gtonga~X nus pa la~X yongs su rdzogs par sbyina~X ste/

sdud pa las/ chos phyir srog kyang gtong la zhum pa'i sems kyang med/ / rang gi sa la dogs med rtag tu ri rab 'dra/ / zhes pas/ nor bzang dang rtag tu ngu ba lta bu la tshig don rdzogs par sbyin no/ / gnyis pa la skal med la mi sbyin par bstan pa ni/ sbyin par bya ba'i snod las gzha~Xn du~X bstan yang mi go ba dang go yang phyin ci log tu spyod cing sdom pa dang dam tshig 'chal ba bsnyen sgrub tshogs gnyis las g.yel ba'am dngangs shing skrag pa skye ba rnams la dus nama~X yanga~X sbyina~X par mi~X bya~X ste/ nyes pa chen pos gdung bar byed pa'i phyir ro/ / gang zhe na yang dag pa'i don la rmonga~Xs pa~X mi shes shing skal ba med pa dang*/ sgo gsum 'phya~Xr ba ma bsdams ma zhi bas sdig pa byed cing gsang ba sgrogs pa la sogs pa rnams la~X gala~X te byina~X na mkha' 'gro dang dam can gyi chad pas dusa~X mi~Xn pa~Xr ni~X sroga~X za~Xd na~Xs tshe'i dus byed cing*/ phyi ma la tsha dmyal mun pa mi bzad pas 'khrigs pa rnams su dmyal ba'i mes bsre~Xgs shinga~X grang dmyal gyi gangs dang bu yig la sogs pas sbreba~Xs nas srog gi zungs tsam lus kyang nyam thag pa'i sdug bsngal gyis gdungs para~X yuna~X ringa~X gnasa~X te bskal pa stong phrag nyi shu la sogs par thar ba'i skabs med do/ / de skad du yang rnam snang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba las/ mtshon dang me dang dug ni/ / de bzhin gdon dang rims rnams dang*/ / sbrul dang sha za dag gis kyang*/ / bsad nas dmyal ba chen por skye/ / zhes pa dang*/ mdo las/ chos kyi phongs pa'i las bsags pa de ni sems can dmyal ba chen po nas dmyal ba chen por 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ / zhes so/ / gsum pa skabs kyi don bsdu ba ni/ de skad ces dkyil 'khor gyi dbang phyug de~X bzhina~X gshe~Xgs pa~X kun tu bzang po nyida~X kyisa~X rang snang du bkod pa rigs lnga la sogs pa'i de~X bzhina~X gshe~Xgs pa~X nyida~X la~X che~Xd du~X brjo~Xd par mdzad

do~X/ / mchog tu gsa~Xng ba~X'i snyinga~X po~X rdzogs pa chen po'i gdams ngag tshe 'di nyid du grol bar byed pa'i de~X kho~X na~X nyida~X nge~Xs pa~X la~Xs/ tshe gcig la sangs rgyas thob par byed pa'i don theg pa 'og ma la shina~X tu~X gsa~Xng ba~X'i ma~Xn nga~Xg gi snyinga~X po~X'i le~X'u~X ste~X bcu~X gsuma~X pa'i rnam par bshad pa~X'o~X/ / / / ༈ don gsum pa 'bras bu sku dang ye shes kyi rang bzhin la bstod pa'i tshul la gsum ste/ don gyi 'brel dgod/ tshig gi don bshad/ skabs kyi don bsdu ba'o/ / dang po ni/ lam bskyed rdzogs kyi dkyil 'khor bstan pa de~X nasa~X 'bras bu lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor la bstod pa'i phyir de~X bzhi~Xn gshe~Xgs pa~X thama~Xs ca~Xd kyi bdag po kun tu bzang po phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo des sku dang ye shes kyi~X dkyila~X 'kho~Xr rang snang ba la~X dgyesa~X pa~X chena~X po'i~X glu~X 'di~X bla~Xngs so~X zhes pa'o/ / gnyis pa la gnyis te/ sku lnga ye shes lnga dang bcas pa la spyir bstod pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbang phyug yab yum la bye brag tu bstod pa'o/ / dang po la lnga las dang po sku rdo rje rigs kyi dkyil 'khor chos kyi dbyings su sku lnga rdzogs pas oṃ~X zhes glu'i 'go 'dren par byed pa ste/ sku'i dkyil 'khor de yang sku lnga dang ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin du mtshon pa'i phyir bstan pa'o/ / de'ang glu'i yan lag lnga dang ldan pa ste/ glu len pa po/ glu'i dbyangs/ glu'i tshigaglu'i rgyan/ glu byin gyis rlob par byed pa rnams so/ / de'ang glu'i dbyangs ni 'dren pa ste/ lnga'irjes su skyes pa/ drug gi rjes su skyes pa/ bar ma'i rjes su skyes pa/ dri za'i rjes su skyes pa/ blo gsal gyi dbyangs/ 'khor nyan pa rnams 'byung ba na dbyangs kyis 'dren pa'o/ / de'ang sku de yang phyoga~Xs bcu~X dusa~X bzhi~X'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku rdo rje gnyis su med pa'i rang bzhin du mngon par rdzoga~Xs par sangs rgyas pa~X'i rang bzhin no/

/ de'ang rang snang dag pa'i ye~X she~Xs me long lta bu la sogs pa'i rang bzhin spros pa dang bral ba'i dkyila~X 'khora~X ni/ sku'i thugs rnam par dag pa'i thi~Xg le~X che~Xn po gnyis su med pa'o/ / de lta bu'i rang snang de yang bsoda~X na~Xms phun sum tshogs pa'i rang bzhin snang la rang bzhin med pa'i dkyi~Xl 'kho~Xr ni/ sku~X'i~X sku ste rigs lnga'i rang bzhin mtha' dbus med par khyab pa'i sku yi tshoga~Xs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'o/ / de'i ngo bo snanga~X stonga~X gnyis su med pa'i rang bzhin ni/ sku'i gsung brjod bral don gyi thiga~X le~X chen po ste yon tan phun sum tshogs pa kuna~X tu rdzoga~Xs pa'o/ / de las dgyes pas ho~X zhes so/ / gnyis pa gsung padma rigs kyi dkyil 'khor du so sor rtog pa'i ye shes kyi sgo nas bstod pa ni/ ye nas rnam par dag pa'i phyir gsung lnga rdzogs shing lhun gyis grub pas oṃ~X zhes so/ / gsung rdo~X rje~X 'od dpag med kyi dkyil 'khor de yang bsoda~X nama~Xs dang ye shes kyi rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i thiga~X le~X chena~X po'o/ / snang ba dang stong pa dbyer med pas rdo~X rjesa~X so sor rtog pa la sogs pa'i ye~X she~Xs kyi dkyila~X 'khora~X ldana~X pa ni gsung gi thugs so/ / yang gnyis su med pa'i rdo~X rje~X ye shes kyi rang sgra~X che~Xn po mtha~X' ya~Xs pa~X mnga' ba ni gsung gi gsung ngo*/ / don gyi rdo~X rje~X rang snang ba ni rgyala~X po~X ste/ snang stong dbyer med pa'i thiga~X le~X che~Xn po gsung gi sku ste ngo mtshar che ho~X/ / gsum pa thugs sangs rgyas rigs kyi dkyil 'khor du me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi sgo nas bstod pa ni/ thugs lnga rdzogs pas oṃ~X sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku~X gsunga~X thugasa~X kyi~X rdzo~Xgs pa~X chena~X po rnam par snang mdzad do/ / de nyid la yo~Xn tana~X dang phrina~X la~Xs ma lus pa kuna~X tu~X rdzo~Xgs pa ni thugs kyi thugs so/

/ yon tan phun sum tshogs pa rnams ma btsal par ye~X nasa~X lhuna~X rdzogasa~X su gnas parang bzhin kuna~X tu~X bza~Xng po'i ngang ni thugs kyi gsung ngo*/ / de'i tshe ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor rang snang du 'dusa~X pa'i~X tshogasa~X chena~X po ni rang bzhin dag pas thi~Xg le~X che~Xn po ste thugs kyi sku'o/ / lhun gyis grub pas ho~Xḥzhes so/ / bzhi pa yon tan rin po che'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor du mnyam nyid ye shes kyi sgo nas bstod pa ni/ yon tan phun sum tshogs pa lnga lhun gyis grub pas oṃ~X zhing khams phun sum tshogs pa chos kyi dbyings mtshan ma thams cad mi~X dmi~Xgs shing thabs shes kyi sgyu~X 'phrula~X lhun stug po bkod pa'i rang snang mnyama~X pa'i~X dbyinga~Xs na gzhal yas khang dang*/ lha'i dkyil 'khor mtha~X' ya~Xs pa rgyan gyi bye brag kuna~X tu~X klubs shing 'od zer sna~X tsho~Xgs pa phyogs bcur 'phro~X ba ni yon tan gyi sku'o/ / ye shes mtha~X' ya~Xs pa kuna~X na~Xs lhuna~X gyisa~X grub cing dbyer med mnyam pa'i ngang du thi~Xm pa n-i brda'am rang bzhin te yon tan gyi gsung ngo*/ / ting nge 'dzin dang rdzu 'phrul dang mngon par shes pa la sogs pa sna~X tsho~Xgs kyi gter yid bzhin gyi nor bu ltar dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i sku~X gsunga~X thuga~Xs chena~X po mnga' ba ni yon tan gyi thugs te ngo mtshar che ho~X zhes so/ / lnga pa 'phrin las las kyi rigs kyi dkyil 'khor du bya ba grub pa'i ye shes kyi sgo nas bstod pa ni/ 'phrin las lnga lhun gyis grub pas oṃ~X gdul bya'i 'jig rten drug gi phyoga~Xs bcu'i~X snod dang bcud kyi 'jiga~X rtena~X zhing gi rdula~X phra ba snyeda~X du~X 'jug pa ni gdul bya'i zhing khams phun sum tshogs pa'o/ / de dag tu rgyala~X ba'i~X dona~X phrin las rnam pa bzhi po rnama~Xs kyi grangs kyang rdula~X phrana~X snyeda~X ston pa ni mdzad pa rang gi ngo bo yin te 'phrin las kyi sku'o/

/ gang gis ston na gang la gang 'dul gyi sprula~X pa~X yang rdula~X phrana~X gyi grangs dang mnyam pa bsa~Xm ya~Xs kyisa~X gdul ba ni sprul pa 'phro ba ste 'phrin las kyi gsung ngo*/ / ji ltar 'dul na sprul ba de dag gis zhing de dag tu skada~X ciga~X yuda~X tsam la~X khyab nas 'bad rtsol med par 'gro ba'i don lhuna~X gyisa~X gruba~X pa ni/ chos kyi sku las ma g.yos bzhin du rtsol med du grub pas 'phrin las kyi thugs so/ / de ni ngo mtshar bas ho~X zhes bzhad pa'o/ / gnyis pa dkyil 'khor gyi dbang phyug yab yum la bye brag tu bstod pa ni/ sku dang ye shes lhun gyis rdzogs pas oṃ~X phyogs bcu dus bzhi dang rang snang gi rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor thama~Xs ca~Xd ma~X lusa~X pa'i rang bzhin ni sku~X gsunga~X thuga~Xs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo yin la/ de dag gi sku~X gsunga~X thuga~Xs kyi~X byed pa po'i bda~Xg nyida~X che~Xn po ni kun tu bzang po dang*/ sku~X gsunga~X thuga~Xs kyi~X bya ba mos yul kuna~X tu~X khyaba~X pa ni kun tu bzang mo ste/ yab yum gnyis su med pa'i rang bzhin de ni 'khor 'das thams cad sku~X gsunga~X thuga~Xs kyi ngo bo ye nas sangs rgyas pa'i chos nyid thi~Xg le~X che~Xn po'i dbyings su byang chub pas dus gsum 'pho 'gyur med pa'i rang bzhin gzhi lam 'bras bu'i kun tu bzang po yab yum ni sangs rgyas dang sems can kun gyi gdod ma'i mgon por lhun gyis grub pas ho~X zhesa~X dgyes pa chen po'i glus bsngags pa'o/ / gsum pa skabs kyi don bsdu ba ni/ tshul de skad ces lhun stug po bkod pa'i zhing rang snang dag pa'i 'khor la zhu ba po med par ched du bsgraga~Xs so~X/ / 'bras bu gsanga~X ba'i~X snyinga~X po~X sku dang ye shes kyi de~X kho~X na~X nyida~X nge~Xs pa~X la~Xs gnas lugs ji lta bzhin bstoda~X pa~Xs dkyil 'khor dang dkyil 'khor gyi dbang phyug chen po nyid rang bzhin lhun gyis mnyesa~X pa~X'i le~X'u ste~X bcu~X bzhi~X pa'i rnam par bshad pa~X'o~X/

/ / / ༈ spyi don gnyis pa khro bo mngon par 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor bshad pa la gsum ste/ gzhi lhun gyis grub pa'i rang bzhin khro bo'i dkyi 'khor snang ba'i tshul bstan pa/ lam ji ltar bsgrub pa thabs kyi yan lag rgya cher bshad pa/ 'bras bu sku dang ye shes la bstod pa'i tshul brjod pa'o/ / dang po la gnyis te/ spyi'i don dang*/ gzhung gi don no/ / dang po la gsum ste/ gzhi lhun gyis grub pa'i khro bo spyir bstan pa/ de las sprul pa'i khro bo bye brag tu bshad pa/ skabs kyi don ngos gzung ba'o/ / dang po ni/ kro dha'i sgra las khro bo ste mi mthun pa'i phyogs las rnam par rgyal zhing 'gro ba'i don rngams pa'i 'phrin las drag pos mdzad pa'o/ / dbye na gsum ste/ gzhi chos nyid kyi khro bo dngos po dang mtshan mar med pas chos sku spros pa'i mtha' dang bral ba'o/ / de'i ngang las 'og min du he ru ka'i dky-il 'khor snang ba ni longs spyod rdzogs pa'i rang bzhin don gyi gnas lugs so/ / de'i thugs rje lhun gyis grub pas gang la gang 'dul gyi khro bor snang ba ni mdzad pa 'phrin las kyi rang bzhin sprul ba'i sku'i ngo bo ste/ thabs zhags las/ mnyam nyid ngang gis khro la phyag 'tshal lo/ / khro bas longs spyod mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ / rdo rje 'du 'phro mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes so/ / yang chos bzhi'i sgo nas kyang khro bor bstan te/ chos nyid dang*/ ye shes dang*/ mdzad pa dang*/ phrin las so/ / dang po ni/ chos nyid spros pa dang bral ba ni mtshan ma'i gnas med pas ngang gis khro ba ste/ rdo rje las/ yang dag shes rab chen po ni/ / mtshan ma 'joms phyir khro bo'i mchog/ ces so/ / gnyis pa ni/ ye shes rgyas pa na mi shes pa dang phyin ci log gi gnas med pas spang bya la ltos nas ngang gis khro bas te/ rgyas pa las/ rang rig ye shes rgyal po yis/ / phyogs bcu thams cad dbang bsdus nas/ / kun kyang mi dmigs dbyings su thim/

/ zhes pa dang*/ gsum pa ni/ thugs rjes 'gro ba skyob pa na 'bad rtsol med par mi mthun phyogs 'joms pas shugs kyis khro ba ste/ lha rgyud las/ 'dzin pa mi rtog thugs rje zhen chags khro/ / zhes so/ / bzhi pa ni/ gdul bya'i dbang gis khro bor bcos pa ltar snang ba ste/ dgongs 'dus las/ shin tu gdug cing gtum pa la/ / zhi bas phan par mi 'gyur te/ / shes rab thabs kyi phyag rgya las/ / khro bor de bzhin gshegs kun mdzad/ / ces so/ / de'ang 'gro ba la gdug pa can 'byung ba dang*/ chags sogs zhi ba'i rigs gnyis su 'byung ba ci yin zhe na/ spyi bo dang snying ga na khro bo dang zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor lhun grub tu yod pa'i rtsal che chung dang*/

ma rig bdag tu 'dzin pas 'khor bar 'khrul dus zhe sdang dang de'i 'khor nga rgyal phrag dog gnyis dang mtshungs ldan gyi las kyis khro bo'i gdangs ma rungs shing gtum bar snang bas pha rol la gnod pa'i gzhir gyur cing*/ 'dod chags kyis zhi ba'i mdangs 'phel bas dga' zhing chags pas dbang du byed pa dang*/ gti mug ni gnyis ka'i ngo bor gnas pa ste/ ye shes rol pa'i rgyud las/ gzhi la grub pa'i sangs rgyas ni/ / zhi dang khro bo'i rang bzhin las/ / ma rig dug gsum rgyu mthun pas/ / dbang po'ang zhi drag gnyis su snang*/ / zhes so/ / de nyid 'dul ba la 'dul byed kyang zhi khro gnyis lhun grub tu 'byung ste/ de las/ de nyid 'dul phyir dkyil 'khor gnyis/ / phyogs dus kun tu zhi khror snang*/ / skad cig yud la lhun gyis grub/ / ces so/ / de dag kyang gzhi lam 'bras bu gsum du gnas te/ gzhi la ye nas dag pa'i khro bo ni sems can kun dang sangs rgyas thams cad la khrag 'thung gi dkyil 'khor lhun grub tu spyi bor gnas pa ste/ bhandha smug nag 'bar ba'i gzhal yas na/ / mthu chen bdud kyi rgyal pos mgo sgo bcad de brtsigs/ / rngams pa'i khro bo rnams kyis gzer gyis btab/ / ces pa dang*/ phra bkod las/ rang rang mgo la khro skur gnas/ / zhes so/ / lam mngon par sgrub pa'i khro bo ni dkyil 'khor du bskyed cing bsgom pa ste/ gsang rgyud las/ lam gyi khro bo'i dkyil 'khor ni/ / 'bar ba'i tshogs chen rab tu bsgom/ / zhes so/ / 'bras bu lhun gyis grub pa'i khro bo ni dri ma dbyings su dag ste rang snang lhun stug po bkod par khro bo'i dkyil 'khor du snang ba ste/ de las/ 'bras bu de bzhin nyid dbyings khro/ / sku gsum lhun stug rang snang gsal/ / zhes so/ / de'ang gzhi la khro bo med na lam du de bsgrub pa yang bla med kyi theg pa'i tshul la mi rigs pa dang*/ lus grub kyi dkyil 'khor gsar rnying la grags pa phal po che 'di dag don la mi gnas par 'gyur pa dang*/

bsgrubs kyang mi 'grub pa'i skyon dang*/ sprul pa'i 'phro gzhi med pas de las 'phros pa'i sprul pa mi rigs pa'i skyon la sogs pa du ma yod do/ / des gzhi la yod pa'i khro bo sangs rgyas kyis mngon du gyur/ sems can gyis ma gyur/ lam pas rjes su slob par byed pa bstan pa'o/ / gnyis pa de las sprul pa'i khro bo bye brag tu bshad pa ni/ rgyud 'dir bcom ldan 'das he ru kas 'jig rten gyi khro bo ma lus pa rnams btul nas dkyil 'khor gyi gdan dang mu ran la bkod par bstan pa ni 'di nyid du rgyas par 'chad pas shes la/ thugs rjes sprul pas rū tra ji ltar btul ba'i tshul dgongs 'dus las 'byung ba bzhin te/ de ni bskal pa chen po stong phrag bcu gnyis dang drug gi sngon rol tu bskal pa kun bkod zhes bya ba la zhing khams mngon par dga' bar sangs rgyas mi bskyod pa'i bstan pa byung ste/ de'i tshe gsang sngags spyod pa'i dge slong thub dka' gzhon nu zhes bya ba bla na med pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba zhig byung ngo*/ / de'i nye 'khor du khyim bdag ke'u ka ya zhes bya ba la bu thar pa nag po zhes pa dang*/ de'i g.yog dan phag ces bya ba yod do/ / de'i tshe thar pa nag po g.yog dang bcas pa dge slong thub dka' gzhon nu'i drung du song ste gsol ba/ dge slong chen po dngos po thams cad la ci dga' bar spyad pas grol ba'i lam yod ces thos na de lta nyid du nges sam/ dge slong gis smras pa yod du rung ngo*/ / de nas thar pa g.yog dang bcas te rab tu byung nas 'dun te thams cad ji lta bu'i lam gang yin zhes dris pa'i lan du/ ji bzhin nyid de ma bcos na/ / dngos po bzhi la gnas spyod kyang*/ / nam mkha' la ni sprin bzhin te/ / 'di ni rnal 'byor dam pa'i lam/ / zhes smras pas/ de gnyis yi rangs te song ba las/ thar pa ni thabs la mi mkhas shing blo gros rtul bas sgra ji lta ba bzhin dngos po bzhi la rang dgar spyad pas lus dam par 'chos kyang sems ngan 'gro'i lam du zhugs so/

/ dan phag ni blo gros rno zhing thabs la mkhas pas don ji lta ba bzhin spyod de/ lus ma rabs su bcug ste bran byed kyang sems dam pa'i lam du zhugs so/ / de nas de gnyis lta spyod ma mthun te rtsod pa las/ dge slong la dris pas/ dan phag ltar nges so zhes smras pa na/ thar pa 'khrugs te gnyis ka ltar ro zhes kyang ma mnyam par/ bdag gcig pu sum 'byin snyam nas/ g.yog dang dge slong gnyis ka spyos shing thag ring por spyugs so/ / de nas thar pas sangs rgyas kyi gsang ba sgra ji lta bur spyad cing log par bsgyur/ log pa'i brtul zhugs bzung nas dur khrod kyi mi ro zos shing g.yang gzhi gyon nas dur khrod gyi ce spyang nag po dang*/ 'phar ba rkang sdebs dang*/ srin po lag sdebs dang*/ bya gcan gsod byed dang*/ dur bya kang ka dang*/ za byed dur phag la sogs pa'i ma rungs pa rnams brten te thams cad kyi srog 'phrog cing*/ smad 'tshong ma'i tshogs mang po bsdus te chags pa chen po spyod pas gnas so/ / rgyu des shi ba'i 'og tu ngan 'gro mu mtha' med par brgyud de mtha' ma la rū tra thar pa nag po zhes bya ba/ gzugs kyi khams man chad dbang du bsdus shing sha dang khrag la dad pas 'gro ba'i tshogs la gnod pa'i bgegs su gyur to/ / de'i tshe dpal ha ya ghrī wa la sogs pa'i skus kyang ma thul bar gsang bdag gis dpal chen por byas te/ lus kyi nang du zhugs nas brgyangs pas gdod bka' nyan cing las la 'du bar gyur cing*/ zhabs kyi 'og nas gdung ba'i smre bshags chen po sngon gyi sdig pa bshags te chung ma dang bcas pa 'bangs su khas blangs nas btul ba'au/ / de yang mngon spyod las gzhan gyis mi thul ba'i rigs can bdud dang gshin rje la sogs pa rnams la de bas kyang 'jigs pa'i sku gsung thugs su sprul nas tshar gcod cing 'dul bar mdzad pa'o/ / gsum pa skabs kyi don ngos bzung la gsum ste/

dkyil 'khor ngos gzung ba/ rūtra ngos gzung ba/ dus dang ston pa ngos gzung ba'o/ / dang po la gnyis las/ rtsod pa bkod pa ni/ skabs 'di'i khro bo'i dkyil 'khor rang bzhin yin nam/ sprul pa yin/ dang po ltar na gdul bya'i don du dkyil 'khor spros par bshad pa dang 'gal zhing*/ gnyis pa ltar na khro bo'i rang bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor gyi le'u ste zhes 'og min du rang snang bar bshad pa dang 'gal zhes pa'o// gnyis pa de'i lan gsal bor bshad pa ni/ kun tu bzang po khro bo'i dkyil 'khor du ye nas gnas pa'i rang snang las de ltar snang ba yin te/ rang bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor gyi zhes pas grub po/ / sprul pa ltar bstan pa ni gdul bya'i ngor de ltar snang ba'i 'char gzhi byed pa nyid shes par bya ba la btags nas cha mthun par bshad pa las/ sprul pa rang mtshan pa'i dkyil 'khor gyis gdul bya rang mtshan pa btul ba ni med de/ 'on kyang de ltar 'phrul ba sgyu ma'i rtsed 'jo bstan pa bzhin no/ / ston pa'i 'thad pa yang sems can gyi rgyud na de lta bu'i rigs yod pa rnams tshul de lta bus 'dul ba'i dper mdzad pa ste bzo la sogs pa'i sngon du de'i dpe 'god pa bzhin no/ / de'ang rang bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor dbyings nas rang snang ba de'i tshe rang snang ye shes kyi rol pa de snang ba ni spyi bo na khrag 'thung gi dkyil 'khor gnas pa'i rtsal las lhun gyis grub par rang snang ba yin no/ / de las gdul bya'i 'jig rten du de ltar snang ba ni dbyings kyi zla ba las chu snod du snang ba bzhin no/ / de'ang zhi khro'i rang snang las gzhan snang longs spyod rdzogs pa de 'dra ba chu'i zla gzugs bzhin snang ba ni sprul pa'i sku ste/ mdo sde rgyan las/ chu dang nam mkha' zla gzugs bzhin/ / zhes chos sku'i mkha' la longs sku'i zla ba gdul bya'i chu nang du sprul skur snang ba'i dpes bstan pa bzhin no/

/ sngar zhi ba'i rang bzhin phyis khro bor bsgyur ba ma yin te/ ye nas de ltar lhun gyis grub nas gnas shing dus tha dad pa'ang med de/ brjod bya'i dbyings de ltar gnas pa rjod byed kyi gzhung dgod pa na dus gcig tu bstan du ma btub pas rim gyis gsungs shing sprul pa skad brjod pa'o/ / gnyis pa rū tra ngos gzung ba la gnyis las/ rtsod pa dgod pa ni/ 'dir gsungs pa'i rū tra ni tha mal pa yin nam/ sprul pa yin/ dang po ltar na yi dwags srin po chen po zhes zer bas/ gzugs khams dbang du sdud pa de mi 'thad de/ 'dod khams pa yin pa'i phyir dang*/ bsam gtan gyi ting nge 'dzin ma thob pa'i phyir dang*/ dpal chen po'i zhal mthong zhing dngos kyi gdul byar gyur pa yang mi 'thad de/ dpal chen po dang spyod yul gcig tu ma spyod pa'i phyir ro/ / gnyis pa ltar na ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal myongs ba mi rigs so zhes pa'o/ / gnyis pa lan la gnyis las/ phyogs dang po'i lan ni 'dod khams pa yin yang gzugs khams dbang du sdud pa yang 'gal ba med de/ 'dod pa'i rten la 'phags sa thob pas gzugs khams pa sdud pa dang*/ sngon gyi las rmad du byung ba'i mthu ni bsam gyis mi khyab pas des sdud pa'o/ / 'dod pa'i yi dwags chen por smos pas ting nge 'dzin ma thob par mi 'byung te/ rten 'dod pa yin yang sems gzugs kyi ting nge 'dzin thob pa mi 'gal te/ 'dod pa'i so so skye bos bsam gtan gzugs med kyi sems thob par gsungs pa dang*/ 'dod pa'i 'phags pa bzhin no/ / yi dwags srin po chen po zhes pas kyang don la ting nge 'dzin dang rdzu 'phrul che bar mtshon pa'o/ / dpal chen po'i zhal mthong ba la skal ba gcig pa'i spyod yul spyad pa dgos na yang ha cang thal te/ thub pa drug mthong ba'i sems can gyis thub pa dang spyod yul gcig tu spyad par thal ba dang*/ lha mi dud 'gro bem po la sogs pa mthong ba'i tshe'ang de dag spyod yul gcig tu spyod par thal ba'i skyon mi spong ba yin no/

/ de bas na 'dir bstan pa'i rū tra 'khor dang bcas pa ni tha mal pa snang yang tha mal pa ma yin te/ 'phags pas sems can skyo ba bskyed pa'i phyir dmyal ba dang yi dwags kyi 'jig rten sprul pa bzhin du/ rang snang gi ston pa thugs rje'i 'char tshul dang ye nas gnas pa'i khro bo mngon par 'byung ba'i cho 'phrul 'og min du bkod pa nyid longs spyod chen po khro bo'i rol par de ltar snang ba yin mod/ yi dwags la sogs pa tha mal pa'i gzugs su snang bas tha mal pa yin na'ang ha cang thal te/ 'gro ba 'dul ba'i thub pa rnams kyang tha mal pa'i gzugs dang skye rga na 'chi dang nad dang g.yul 'gyed pa la sogs par sprul pa snang ba'ang don la tha mal par 'gyur ro/ / yang 'og min na khri 'degs pa'i seng ge la sogs par snang ba de yang tha mal par 'gyur ro/ / 'dod na yon tan lnga'i rol pa nyid stobs sogs kyi char gnas pa'i brda don rang snang bas rgyal ba'i rol par bshad pas gsal lo/ / phyogs gnyis pa'i lan ni ngan song gi sdug bsngal rang mtshan pa myong ba med de/ rū tra de nyid rang snang ye shes kyi sprul ba bkod pa'i phyir ro/ / de sngon bsten pa'i stobs kyis thams cad mkhyen pas gzigs nas zhes pa'ang de ltar snang ba'i rū tra la yod par bstan pa ma yin te/ phyis 'jig rten du rū tra rang mtshan pa 'byung ba rnams la rgyu de lta bus bskyed par bstan pa'o/ / de'ang thun mong gi mdo sde las kyang mi thung sor phreng can gyis mi stong du gcig gis ma longs pa bsad pa'i sor mo'i phreng ba bsgrubs pa las/ sangs rgyas kyis btul nas de'i nyes pa med par bstan pa yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprul pas sprul pa'i mi bsad de phreng bar byas pa las phyi rabs gnyen po mchog rnams nyes pas mi gos par bstan pa la dgongs pa lta bu'o/ / yang sprul pa'i nyan thos kyis bslab pa'i mtshams las 'das pa sngon yang de ltar 'das shing*/

phyis kyang ngan song du skyes pa 'khor gyis mthong ba'i cho 'phrul bstan pas dge slong rnams btul ba'i tshe'ang sprul pa la de lta bu'i las bsags pa dang snga phyi brgyud nas sdug bsngal myong ba med pa bzhin no/ / tshul 'di de bas kyang ches 'phags te gzhan gyi ngor de ltar bstan nas sprul pa'i rū tra dang dkyil 'khor bstan pa yang ma yin te/ rang bzhin gyis khro bo'i dkyil 'khor mngon du gyur pa na ye shes kyi rol pa de lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin ye shes sgyu ma'i cho 'phrul du rang snang ba ste/ de las gdul bya'i 'jig rten du de ltar snang ba'i 'phro gzhi byed pa'o/ / gal te 'phro gzhi la de ltar med na 'phro ba'i rnam 'phrul yang de lta bu 'byung bar mi rigs te/ nam mkha'i zla ba dang chu'i rdzing bu'i gzigs brnyan rnam pa tha mi dad pa'i dbyibs su ji ltar rung ste/ nam mkhar zla ba yod kyang rdzing bur ljon shing la sogs pa rnam pa gzhan snang ba la sogs pa ma nges pa'i skyon du 'gyur ro/ / sangs rgyas rnams kyi rnam par sprul pa rgya mtsho snang ba yang kha cig tu ni gdul bya'i dbang dang gzhi la gnas pa'i dbye bas sku dang ye shes kyi rol pa tha dad par snang ba ste/ don gyi ngo bo la 'khor 'das gnyis su med par rgyu gcig pa la sogs pa'i tshul gyis gzhi 'char gzhi'i ngang las de dang der 'char ba ni lhun gyis grub pa'i ye shes so/ / 'o na ma dag pa yang 'char gzhi yod dam gdul bya la de ltar snang ba'i phyir zhe na/ ma dag pa zhes pa gang la zer/ 'gro drug tu snang ba la byed na de'i 'char gzhi thugs rje rol pa la 'gro ba drug gi spyod yul rgya mtshor snang ba'i rol ba rang bzhin gyis dag par yod par bshad do/ / rtsa 'khor drug gi rang bzhin 'gro ba drug gi 'jig rten snang ba yod pa'i phyir te/ rdo rje las/ 'khor lo drug gi rang bzhin gyis/ / 'jig rten drug gi snang ba ni/

/ ye nas snang ba lhun grub pas/ / rlung sems byed pas de ltar snang*/ / zhes so/ / de'ang 'khor ba'i tshe ma rig pas de ltar bde sdug la sogs par 'khor yang*/ 'khor ba'i rang bzhin gzugs brnyan dang 'dra bar rtogs pa mthar phyin pa'i tshe de dag gi 'char gzhi 'gro drug so so'i 'jig rten du thub pa drug gi rol pa ston pa yang de las byung ba'o/ / de'ang 'gro ba drug gi 'char gzhi snang bas 'gro drug rang mtshan pa'i 'khor ba yod par mi 'gyur ro/ / rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs su 'gyed pa'i tshe las dag pa'i sems dpa' la de med pa dang*/ me long kun gyi 'char gzhir gnas kyang de'i ngo bo la gos pa med pa bzhin no/ / 'di ltar sangs rgyas phal bo che las kyang*/ zhing gi rang bzhin rgya mtsho rnams/ / sems kyi spyod yul sna tshogs snang*/ / ji ltar dwangs ba'i rgya mtsho la/ / gzugs brnyan rgya mtshor snang ba bzhin/ / sa chu me rlung nam mkha' dang*/

/ sems kyi rang bzhin rgya mtsho na/ / zhing khams rgya mtsho'i rdul snyed rnams/ / sus kyang bkod pa med par gnas/ / la la rang bzhin dag pa dang*/ / kha cig spyod yul sna tshogs la/ / 'gro ba'i khams kun gsal bar snang*/ / ba spu'i khung bu nyag re la'ang*/ / sangs rgyas zhing khams rgya mtsho ste/ / sna tshogs brjod kyis mi lang ba'o/ / zhes so/ / des nas sangs rgyas kyi chos ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i spyod yul te blo zhan pa dag gis ji ltar dpag par nus/ gzhan yang 'gro drug tu snang bas 'khor bar mi 'gyur te/ thub pa drug dang sgyu ma dang mig 'phrul gyi 'gro ba bzhin/ de'ang 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal 'byung ba'i rgyu bdag tu 'dzin pa log pa na sdug bsngal so so log pa yin gyi/ 'char gzhi 'khor lo drug gi rtsa 'dab thugs rjes 'khor ba la rang dang mthun par snang ba ston pa'i rang bzhin me long gi ngos lta bu med par 'gyur ba ni ma yin no/ / gal te 'di nyid med na 'gro drug gi snang ba'ang glo bur du gang gis byas pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi longs spyod chen po'i sku la 'khor 'das kyi 'byor ba thams cad ma tshang bar 'gyur ba dang*/ ma dag pa 'khor ba la snang ba'i sku dang thugs rje'i rol pa rgyun chad par 'gyur ro/ / 'di ltar rnal 'byor sems tsam pas kyang kun gzhi la thog ma med pa'i dus nas yul dang don dang lus su snang ba'i ngo bo gsum yod par bshad de/ de nyid ma dag pa sbyangs pa las dag pa'i rang bzhin du gnas gyur yang don gyi kun gzhi sngon dang phyi ma da lta gsum du 'pho 'gyur med par chos kyi skur lhun gyis grub par 'dod pas/ 'char gzhi 'khor 'das kyi rol pa de nyid med par mi 'gyur ba ji lta ba bzhin no/ / lan dngos mdor bsdu na/ 'di yi rū tra ni ye thog dang por kun tu bzang po sangs rgyas pa'i tshe rang snang gi rtsa 'dab 'khor lo na snang ba'i bdud btul bar rang snang ba yin pas rang mtshan pa'ang ma yin te/

rang snang yin pa'i phyir ro/ / sprul pa'ang ma yin te/ sprul pa ni gdul bya gzhan gyi snang ngo bo la ltos pa yin la/ 'di rang snang yin pas gdul bya dang gdul byed tha dad pa don la ma grub pa'i phyir ro/ / des na rang snang ba ye thog dang por snang ba'o/ / mdo dang ming 'dra ba las/ don mi mtshungs te dus tha dad pa dang*/ gdul bya dang 'dul byed rgyud tha dad pa dang*/ ngo bo gcig la tha dad ltar snang ba'i khyad yod do/ / gsum pa dus dang ston pa ngos bzung ba la gnyis te/ dus mtshungs mi mtshungs dang*/ 'dul byed kyi ston pa gcig mi gcig ngos bzung pa'o/ / dang po la gnyis las/ rtsod pa dgod pa ni/ 'dir thog ma med pa'i dus su btul zhing*/ mdor bstan pa 'di la btul ba'i dus tha dad cing*/ mdor 'dzam gling dang*/ 'dir 'og min du bshad pas gnas kyang tha dad pas mi mtshungs pa'i phyir ro zhe na/ lan ni 'dir dus bzhi mnyam pa nyid kyi dbyings su bstan pas thog ma med pa'i dus zhes brjod de/ lo'am bskal pa kun gyi sngon rol lta bu 'ba' zhig ma yin la/ bstan pa 'di'ang bskal pa bzang po lta bu gcig kho nar nges pa'ang ma yin te/ gdul ba'i zhing dang dus skad cig ma gcig bskal pa snga phyi dang 'jig rten du mar ston pa'i cho 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i phyir ro/ / des na dus thog ma med pa ni ngo bo la ltos te ma nges pa'i dus yin la/ 'gro ba la snang ba'i rang snang du bkod pa'i dus la nges gzung byas pa dang yang mi 'gal ba de ltar yin no/ / 'dzam gling dang 'og min yang ston pa dang 'gro ba rang snang so sor snang ba tsam las 'og min phyogs 'di kho na na yod ces nges gzung mi rung ste/ dag pa'i sems dpa' dang sangs rgyas kyi snang ba yin la/ de nyid gar khyab na 'og min gyis khyab pa'i phyir ro/ / gzugs kyi 'og min ltar dngos po tha dad pa'i zhing gzhan yod pa ma yin no/ / gnyis pa la'ang gnyis las/

rtsod pa dgod pa ni/ mdor btul ba dang*/ 'dir btul ba gnyis gcig gam tha dad/ gcig na mdor gsang bdag dang*/ 'dir he ru ka'i btul bar gsungs pas tha dad dang*/ gnyis pa ltar na'ang de sngon brten pa'i zhes pa la sogs pas mdo dang mthun par snang bas so zhe na/ gnyis pa de'i lan ni/ spyir gyi gsang bdag dang he ru ka'ang tha dad pa ma yin te/ gdul bya'i ngor gsang bdag tu snang ba de nyid rang snang dag pa'i zhing du he ru kar gnas pas phyi nang ltar yang yin mod/ mdo dang rnam pa mtshungs pas gcig pa'ang ma nges te/ de kho na 'dra ba'i rgyud gzhan yang yod pa dang lha sbyin dang mchod sbyin ming mtshungs kyang tha dad pa bzhin no/ / des na rang snang 'og min du ting nge 'dzin gyi rol pas btul ba de bzhin du gdul bya'i snang ngor gsang bdag gis btul bar snang ste/ dus dang ston pa'ang sangs rgyas kyi spyod yul yin pas mtshungs pa mi 'gal te/ de ltar byin gyis rlob nus pa'i phyir ro/ / mdor bsdu na mi 'jigs pa bzhi yod pa'i brdar seng ge'i khri snang ba ltar/ bdud dang phyir rgol ba mtha' dag las rgyal zhing dregs pa can zil gyis gnon pa'i mnga' dbang rdzogs pa'i brdar rū tra btul bar snang ba yin no/ / de'ang byang chub brnyes pa de'i tshe bdud btul bar snang dgos pas rū tra ste dregs pa can gyi bdud dpung ye thog dang por bcom pa'i tshul bstan pa na rang snang rtsa 'dab kyi snang ba la dbang sgyur ba'o*/ / gnyis pa gzhung gi don la gnyis te/ khro bo mngon par 'byung ba'i tshul mdor bstan pa dang*/ de'i rang bzhin rgyas par bshad pa'o/ / dang po ni/ zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor bstan pa de~X na~Xs phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i de~X bzhi~Xn gshe~Xgs pa~X thama~Xs ca~Xd kyi~X bda~Xg nyid chen po~X dpal kun tu bzang po sanga~Xs rgyasa~X thama~Xs ca~Xd kyi~X sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i ngo~X bo~X nyida~X kyi~Xs chos sku spros pa dang bral ba'i ngang las ma g.yos bzhin du lhun stug po bkod pa'i zhing du rang snang khro~X bo~X'i dkyi~Xl 'kho~Xr du ye nas longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur mngona~X para~X 'du~X mdzada~X de sprul pa sku'i khro bo 'byung ba'i 'char gzhir bzhugs so/

/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ gdul bya las kyi khro bo'i byung tshul dang*/ 'dul byed ye shes kyi khro bos btul tshul lo/ / dang po la gnyis te/ dgos ched dri ba dang*/ de'i lan bshad pa'o/ / dang po ni/ 'char gzhi longs sku dang de las shar ba sprul pa sku'i khro bo'i dkyil 'khor bstan pa de'i~X dgongs pa'am rgyu mtshan ci'i~X phyira~X zhe~X na~X zhes so/ / gnyis pa la gnyis te/ rgyu gang gis bskyed pa dang*/ 'bras bu gang du smin pa'o/ / de'ang sprul sku'i khro bos 'dul ba la longs sku'i khro bo dgos la/ longs sku'i khro bos mdzad pa'i cho 'phrul rang snang du ston pa ci 'dra ba sprul sku'i khro bos gdul bya'i 'jig rten du ston pas chu dang zla gzugs bzhin 'brel ba grub pa de'i phyir ma dag par snang ba nyid 'dul bar ston pa'o/ / skabs 'di'i gdul bya dang 'dul byed bzang ngan gyis bskyed pa'i rgyu 'bras dang bzang ngan du snang yang don la bzang ngan med de/ ngo bo'i 'char tshul de ltar snang ba'i phyir ro/ / des na 'di dang mdo gnyis 'char gzhi dang 'char byed du 'brel lo/ / rnam pa de 'dra bas dus gcig pa'ang mi dgos te/ 'char byed 'char gzhi dang dus gcig kyang*/ 'char gzhi 'char byed dang gcig pa'i nges pa med de zla ba dang chu zla'i dus bzhin no/ / 'on te gcig pa'ang mi 'gal ba rung ste/ de ltar byin gyis rlob nus pa'i phyir ro/ / dang po ni/ nga dang nga yir 'dzin pas gang zag gi bda~Xg tu~X rang gi sems rmonga~Xs pa'i~X rnam par rtoga~X pa~X lhan cig skyes pa'i ma rig pas 'dzin pa la bdag tu zhen pa dnga~X*/ chos thams cad gzugs brnyan dang 'dra ba brda tsam blos brtaga~Xs tsam yin pa la~X de ltar ma shes par bden bden grub grub por mngona~X para~X zhe~Xn pa~X kun brtags pa'i ma rig pasaX gzung yul la bdag gir zhen pas 'khor bar 'khyams shing srid pa'i rgyu byed de/ sdug bsngal gyis 'khor mor gdungs la yanga~X dga~X pa'i~X lama~X 'khor ba las nges par 'byin pa'i shes rab zab mo dnga~X brala~X ba~X dga~X ni srid pa'i 'du byed pa spyi'i rgyu yin la/

de'i steng du don zab mo rgyud lung gi khong na gaba~X pa'i~X rang bzhin rtogs par shin tu dka' ba rang bzhin gyi gsanga~X ba~X ma~X rtoga~Xs para~X sbyor sgrol gyi thabs la sogs pa sbasa~X pa'i~X gsanga~X ba~X spyod pa brlang po rang ga ba la~X mngona~X para~X 'chela~X nasa~X spyod cing*/ rgyu~X dge sdig dnga~X 'brasa~X bu~X bde sdug gi 'brel ba las 'bras bslu ba med pa'i rten 'brel la~X rmonga~Xs pasa~X gsang ba zab mo rnams kyi sgra ji lta bar spyod cing phyin ci log gi lam la zhugs pa rnams rū tra 'byung ba'i rgyu ste thar pa nag po lta bu'o/ / de skad du'ang sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor las/ 'das pa'i dus na sngon byung ba/ / bdag nyid chen po rtag pa yis/ / de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung rab las/ / 'gro ba'i tshul ni sngon byung ba/ / de tshe sems can thams cad ni/ / log par lta la brtson par 'gyur/ / lta ba shin tu log pa yis/ / mnar med dmyal ba chen por ltung*/ / zhes so/ / gnyis pa 'bras bu gang du smin pa la gnyis te/ rnam smin gyi 'bras bu sdug bsngal myong ba dang*/ rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu gzhan la 'tshe ba'o/ / dang po la'ang gnyis las/ dmyal bar skyes pa'i tshul ni sngon zhe sdang gis kun nas bslang pa'i las gsod pa la sogs pa dang*/ nga rgyal dang phrag dog gi las bla ma dang mched grogs la ngan sems dang tshig rtsub dang log par lta ba la sogs pa dam tshig nyams pa'i nyes pa ni srida~X pa~X'i sa~X bo~Xn rtsuba~X mo~X ste mi dge rngams po che desaX bar do med par rdo rje dmyal bar 'phanga~Xs nasa~X bar mtsha~Xms meda~X pa'i~X raba~X tu~X tsha~X ba'i~X dmya~Xl ba mnar med para~X skad cig la brdzus te skyesa~X so~X/ / de nyid du bskal chen du mar sdug bsngal la spyod do/ / dmyal ba pa de~X dag raba~X tu~X tsha~X ba'i~X sduga~X bsngala~X draga~X posa~X gdunga~Xs ba~X dnga~X las cung zad bsrabs te/ de las thar du nye ba na grang dmyal gyi gnas dag mthong nas 'di~X bsa~X shina~X tu~X granga~X ba'i gnas pha gir skyes shing sdug bsngal myong yanga~X ci~X ma~X ru~Xng snyama~X pa'i~X moda~X la~X yang der skyes te/

gangs dang bu yug la sogs pas raba~X tu~X sbreba~Xs pa~X ste shin tu grang ba dnga~X lus kyang padma~X ltara~X bzhi tshal lam brgyad tshal la sogs par gsa~X pa~X'i sduga~X bsnga~Xl dra~Xg po~X ste/ bzod dka' ba bstud mar 'byung ba dga~X gi~Xs raba~X tu~X nyen pa bskal pa du mar gdunga~X ngo~X*/ / de~X lta~X bu'i~X sduga~X bsnga~Xl mi bzad pa'i dmyal bar ra~Xb tu~X tsha~X ba~X dang*/ la~X soga~Xs pa ni tsha ba dang*/ ngu 'bod chen po dang*/ ngu 'bod dang*/ bsdus 'joms dang*/ thig nag dang*/ yang sos te brgyada~X dnga~X*/ shina~X tu~X granga~X ba~X padma chen po ltar gas pa dang*/ la~X soga~Xs pa~X ni padma ltar gas pa/ utpal ltar gas pa/ kyi hud zer ba/ a chu zer ba/ so tham pa/ chu bur rdol ba can/ chu bur can te brgyada~X po~X dga~X tu~X phan tshun zung re re zhing skyes res byed de/ dran pa nyer bzhag gi mdo las/ gang dag bar mtshams med pa'i las/ / bsags pa de dag mnar med par/ / skyes nas dmyal mes yun ring bsreg/ de nas padma cher skyes shing*/ / de bzhin yang sos chu bur can/ / phan tshun sdug bsngal rab tu myong*/ / zhes so/ / de'ang theg pa thun mong pa ltar bskal pa gcig la sogs pa nas dmyal ba'i gnas nas thar ba'i lo grangs dang bcas pa las lhag par bstan pa'i phyir/ dmyal ba'i gnas de dag tu skyes dus 'jiga~X rtena~X gyi~X khama~Xs la chags 'jig 'byung ba na 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan du brgyuda~X cinga~X der yang chags 'jig byung dus gzhan du dmyal ba'i tsha grang gi gnas zung brgyad yod par skye zhing*/ de dag gi tshe tshad ni bska~Xl pa~X che~Xn po~X stonga~X phra~Xg bcu~X gnyisa~X su~X tsha grang gi sdug bsngal myanga~X ngo~X*/ / de'ang bskal chen ni 'jig rten gyi khams gcig chags pa/ gnas pa/ 'jig pa/ stongs pa bzhi la bar bskal nyi shu nyi shu ste brgyad cu la bskal pa chen por bshad pa ni/ mdzod las/ de ltar 'jig rten chags pa 'di/ / bskal pa nyi shur gnas pa yin/ / chags pa dang na 'jig pa dang*/

/ zhig gnas 'dug pa dag mnyam mo/ / de dag brgyad cu la bskal chen/ / zhes so/ / de'ang nyan thos pa ltar phyi rol gyi snod dang dmyal gnas kyi chags 'jig bden par grub pa med cing*/ sems can de dag las snang la der skye dus 'jig rten la chags 'jig byung bar snang zhing*/ 'jig rten gzhan gyi dmyal khams so sor skyes par snang ba rmi lam bzhin te 'khrul ba'i bag chags mthu brtas pa las byung ba'o/ / gnyis pa yi dwags su skyes pa'i tshul ni/ de~X na~Xs dmyal ba'i rnama~X pa~Xr smina~X pa~X de dag zada~X pa~X da~Xng yi~X dwaga~Xs su skyes so/ / de'ang zad pa la gnyis te/ gnyen pos bcom nas zad pa tsha reg dang grang reg lta bu ste gnyen po dge bas spang bya mi dge ba zad pa dang*/ rang gi 'bras bu rnam smin gyis zad pa sa bon las myu gu skyes stobs kyis zad pa ltar dge sdug gi 'bras bu myong ba'o/ / 'di ni phyi ma'o/ / de'ang yi dwags su skye ba'i las yod bzhin du dmyal bar skye ba'i las ma zad kyi bar mi skye ba c-i yin zhe na/ las gnyis yod na chen po'i 'bras bu sngon la ma byung gi bar du chung du 'byin mi nus te/ nyi ma'i 'od yod dus gza' skar gyi 'od mi snang ba bzhin no/ / des na dge sdig stobs gang che'i las re re'ang stobs gang che sngon la smin pa'o/ / de'ang mdzod las/ las kyi 'khor ba lci gang dang*/ / nye ba gang dang goms pa gang*/ / sngar byas gang yin de dag las/ / snga ma snga ma rnam smin 'gyur/ / zhes pa las/ 'di ni lci ba sngon la smin pa'o/ / de'ang bkres skom gyi mes gdungs shing zas skom 'ba' zhig yid la 'dod pas na yi dwags te/ rab tu ltoga~Xs pa~X dnga~X sko~Xm pa'i~X sduga~X bsnga~Xl gyi~Xs rab tu nyena~X pa~X ni spyi mthun gyi sgrib pa can no/ / kun gyi yid du 'ong ba nyi ma dang zla ba yang gdungs shing mi dga' bas phyi rol 'do~Xd pa~X'i dngo~Xs po~X rnama~Xs yida~X du~X mi~X 'o~Xng ba~X chu gtsang rnag khrag la sogs par mthong ba ni phyi'i sgrib pa can no/

/ bshes spring las/ yi dwags rnams la sos ka'i dus su ni/ / zla ba'ang tsha zhing dgun ni nyi ma'ang bsil/ / zhes pa ltar ro/ / bza' btung dang por mi rnyed cing rnyed kyang mgrin par mi chud chud na'ang nang khrol la me 'bar te/ lus kyi phyi nang kun tu me 'bar ba'i phyir na longs spyod kyi dngos po rnams gdu~Xg cinga~X rtsuba~X pa'i~X dngo~Xs po~X sna~X tshoga~Xs su~X skad cig la 'gyura~X ba~X ni me lce'i 'khor lo can no/

/ skom pa'i tshe rgya mtsho dang chu klung chen po dang*/ bkres pa'i tshe bza' ba'i bye brag dang*/ gnas dang yo byad yid du 'ong ba dag la longs spyod par 'dod nas bltas shing de'i drung du phyin pa'i tshe/ yang lhag rol lam rjes tsam yang me~Xd pa~Xr 'gyura~X zhi~Xng sdug bsngal 'phel ba ni zas skom gyi sgrib pa can no/ / rus gzeb la pags pas g.yogs pa tsam las sha khrag gi mdangs med par shina~X tu~X rida~X kyanga~X skama~X pa~X dnga~X lasa~X dnga~X yana~X laga~X mi~X 'tshama~X pa~Xr ri rab dang 'jag ma tsam la dbang po ma tshang zhing skyon chags pa mgo bo ri rab tsam la kha khab m-ig tsam pa la sogs pa rnam par mi 'tsham pa'i rang bzhin du gyur pa ni bska~Xl pa~X che~Xn po~X druga~X tu~X yi dwags kyi 'jig rten der gcig nas gcig tu brgyud cing skyesa~X so~X/ / gnyis pa rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu gzhan la ji ltar 'tshe ba'i tshul ni/ de~X nasa~X yi dwags su skye ba'i la~Xs kyi~X sgriba~X pa~X rgyu rtsuba~X mo~X'i rnama~X pa~Xr smi~Xn pa~X de~X ya~Xng khada~X kyisa~X bsraba~Xs te rags pa de zad pa dnga~X*/ phra ba'i rgyu dang sngona~X gyi~X skye ba la khro bo mgo dang phyag du ma yod pa bsgoms shing rang mtshan du zhen nas phra men la sogs pa'i 'khor yid la byas te drag sngags rtsub mo rnams bzlas shing dngos po bzhi la spyad pa la sogs pa'i las kyi sri~Xd pa~Xs rū tra'i rgyud du mtshama~Xs sbyora~X na~Xs skyes so/ / de yang ngo bo yi~X dwaga~Xs kyi 'gro bas bsdus shing cha lugs srina~X po~X chena~X po~X'i mtshon cha dang mgo thod thogs pa sems ra~Xb tu~X gdu~Xg pa~X can khro zhing gtuma~X po~X 'jigs su rung ba ste/ rdzu 'phrul ni lusa~X gci~Xg la~X'ang mgo~X bo~X brgya~X yod pa~X dang de yang stag dang seng ge la sogs pa'i mgo~X brnyan mi 'dra ba sna~X tshoga~Xs pa~X dnga~X*/ lha dang lha min la sogs pa'i lusa~X brgya~X la~X ma he lta bu'i mgo~X bo~X gci~Xg pa~X dnga~X*/

/ 'dis ni rang snang lhun stug po bkod par snang ba ci 'dra ba gzhan snang phyogs bcur snang bar bstan to/ / gsum pa dregs pa can gyis 'bangs su khas blangs pa la bzhi las/ dang po 'bangs su dam bcas te dkyil 'khor gyi gdan du phul ba ni/ cho 'phrul bkod pa de~X na~Xs dregs pa can de~X dga~X skrag cing lus shina~X tu~X 'da~Xr zhi~Xng sems breda~X pa~Xs ra~Xb tu~X dpa' zhuma~X pa~X'i nga ༵rosa~X bdag cag gi lus 'banga~Xs su~X mchi~X/ ngag 'ba~Xngs su~X mchi~X/ sems 'ba~Xngs su~X na~Xn tana~X ma~X bgyi~Xs na~X rang rang gi mgo~X dnga~X lusa~X ni~X tshal pa brgyar gsha~Xgs shinga~X snyinga~X yanga~X tshal pa brgya stong du 'ga~Xs shi~Xng gtuba~X par gyura~X ci~Xgalus kyang rul cing myags la dmod pa'i mes tshiga~X na~Xs tshe 'dir brla~Xg pa~X da~Xng phyi mar dmyara~X ba~Xr lhunga~X na~Xs 'o dod chen po 'bo~Xd pa~Xr shoga~X cig ce~Xs 'banga~Xs su~X mchi~X ba~X'i mna~X' tshig bo~Xr na~Xs rang rang gi lus khro bo rigs lnga'i dkyi~Xl 'kho~Xr gyi~X gda~Xn du~X rang rang gis bzha~Xg go~X / gnyis pa 'khor phul te gus pa'i gtsug gis mchod pa ni/ dregs pa can thama~Xs ca~Xd kyi~Xs mgrina~X gci~Xg tu~X ya~Xng smrasa~X pa~X bdaga~X ca~Xg rnama~Xs kyi~X mchi~Xs branga~X chung ma dang*/ ma~X da~Xng sringa~X mo~X dang bu~X mo~X rnama~Xs khro bo'i tshogs kyis longs spyod kyi dkyi~Xl 'kho~Xr che~Xn po~Xr bzhe~Xs su~X gso~Xl/ gdug pa can 'joms pa'i dpa~X' bo rjes su 'dzin pa'i lha~X skyabs kyi dam par gyur pa'i rjesa~X nges par bzhe~Xs su~X gso~Xl/ bda~Xg ca~Xg so~X so~X'i 'kho~Xr dang bca~Xs pa thams cad kyisa~X zhal mthong ba'i khro ba'i tsho~Xgs kyi~X dkyila~X 'kho~Xr che~Xn po~X 'di~X'i mi~Xng tsa~Xm 'dzina~X para~X byeda~X pa'i~X 'gro ba la ya~Xng bdag cag gi spyi gtsu~Xg gi~X yid bzhin gyi no~Xr bu~X 'od 'ba~Xr ba~X bkur ba ltara~X/ yid g.yo~X sgyu~X me~Xd ci~Xng mchog tu gusa~X pa dang ldana~X pa~X'i sema~Xs kyisa~X mchod gnas su blos blanga~Xs te~X rtag tu spyi~X bo'i~X gtsu~Xg tu~X bzha~Xg ste~X bkura~X sti dang rim gro che ba~Xr bgyi~X zhing*/

lhun stug po bkod par khro~X bo~X ra~Xng bzhina~X gyi~X dkyila~X 'khora~X rang snang mtha' dbus med par khyab pa'i sprina~X chen po ye nas lhun gyis grub par rnama~X para~X spros ༵pa~X'i le~X'u ༵ste~X bco~X lnga~X pa'i rnam par bshad pa~X'o~X/ / / / ༈ spyi don gnyis pa lam ji ltar bsgrub pa thabs kyi yan lag rgya cher bshad pa la lnga ste/ thugs rgyud bskul ba gsung sngags kyi dkyil 'khor/ dmigs pa'i rten gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor/ der mchod pa ji ltar bya ba'i tshul/ dam tshig dang ldan pas 'grub pa dam tshig gi rim pa/ dam tshig can gyis 'phrin las ji ltar bsgrub pa'i tshul lo/ / dang po la gnyis te/ spyi'i don dang*/ gzhung gi don no/ / dang po la bcu las/ dang po ting nge 'dzin gsum bsgom pa ni thog mar sems bskyed par bya ste/ 'dzin pa'i dbang gis sdug bsngal zhing*/ / gdug pa srid gsum 'dul ba yi/ / nga rgyal chen po brtan pa'i phyir/ / sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i ting 'dzin bsgom/ / zhes brjod pas snying rjes gdug pa can rnams 'dul ba'i don du sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa bsgrub snyam du bsams nas ting nge 'dzin gsum bsgom mo/ / gnyis pa dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ni thog mar gzhal yas khang bskyed pa dang*/ lha bskyed pa gnyis las/ 'dir sgrub thabs dang bstun te rang nyid cho ga lnga'i sgo nas dpal chen po'i skur bskyed la/ bhrūm̐ bi shwa bi shwaddhe zhes pa khro bo'i gzhal yas khang chen po'i nang du 'khor gyi gnas su 'khor bskyed par bya ste/ bdag gi sems nyid gdod ma'i sangs rgyas yin pa'i phyir bdag gi sras su de bzhin gshegs pa bya ste gtso bo yam yum gyi mkha' gsang las dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams spros la rang rang gi gnas su bzhugs shing gsal gdab/ rigs mi nub cing lhun gyis grub par bya ba'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa'i sras su bdag bya ba thugs kyi sems dpa' spros pas dkyil 'khor la bskor ba dang phyag la sogs pa byas te thugs kar thim par bsam mo/

/ gsum pa dkyil 'khor spyan drangs pa ni/ phyogs dus dkyil 'khor bdag nyid che/ / la sogs pa'i mthar/ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ e hye hi a na ya dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥs spyan drang ngo*/ / bzhi pa rig pa'i me tog dor ba ni raṃ zhes brjod pas nye gnas su byon par bsam pa ni 'dres pa nan tan gyi phyag go / lnga pa bstim pa ni oṃ badzra kro ta sa ma ya hūm̐/ oṃ khro la khros pas zhi mdzad pa/ / thugs rjes khro dpal rngams pa'i tshogs/ / 'bar ba'i byin rlabs rmad po che/ / de nyid du ni bdag la stsol/ / ces pas gnyis su med par thim par bsam mo/ / drug pa brtan cing dam tshig bskul bas dbang du bya ba ni/ oṃ badzra kro ta sa ma ya st+wam̐ gyis brtan par bya'o/ / oṃ badzra kro ta sa mā ya phaṭa: kyis dam tshig rjes su bskul bar bya'o/ / oṃ badzra kro ta sa ma ya hos dbang du byas te mnyes par bsam mo/ / bdun pa sngags kyi mchod pas gsal bar mchod pa ni/ a li u li tā li ta pā li/ daṃṣtāṃ go nā rau tri kha raṃ yo gi nī khā hi ho zhes pa ni mchod pa'i glu'o/ / brgyad pa gsal gdab pa ni hūm̐ ha he phaṭaḥ smug nag sngo nag ser nag dang*/ / zhes pa la sogs pas lha'i dkyil 'khor gsal btab la gsang sngags ci 'grub tu bzlas pas kyang mnyes par bya'o/ / dgu pa mchod pa ni le'u bco brgyad pa las gsungs pa'i sgrol ba/ sbyor ba/ bdud rtsi/ thun mong 'dod yon lnga'i mchod pas mchod nas/ tshogs kyi mchod par bya'o/ / gal te las 'ga' zhig bsgrub tu yod na tshogs kyi rjes la phrin las brtsams te lhag ma'i gtor ma gtang ngo*/ / bcu pa rjes kyi bya ba ni de nas nyams chags bshags pa dang*/ smon lam gdab pa dang*/ bzod par gsol ba dang*/ bsngo ba dang*/ bkra shis brjod pa dang*/ rten gyi dkyil 'khor yod na bsdu ba rnams bya'o/ / de'ang bco lnga pa khro bo rang bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ bcu drug pa gsang sngags kyi dkyil 'khor dang*/

bcu bdun pa dmigs pa'i rten gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ bco brgyad pa de nyid mchod pa'i thabs dang*/ bcu dgu pa dam tshig gi rim pa dang*/ nyi shu pa 'phrin las bsgrub pa dang*/ rtsa gcig pa khro bo dgyes pa'i glu'i bstod dbyangs te/ 'di dag gis dkyil 'khor gcig gi cha rkyen rdzogs par bstan pa yin no/ / de'ang rim pa 'di dag rgyas par sgrub thabs snang ba dam pa rgyan las gsungs pa der blta'o/

/ 'di tsam gyis ni mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pa 'phrin las dang bcas pa bde blag tu khong du chud par bsams nas spyi'i don du bkod pa yin no/ / gnyis pa gzhung gi don la gsum ste/ gsang sngags 'byung ba'i tshul mdor bstan pa/ ji ltar byung ba'i rang bzhin rgyas par bshad pa/ ltas khyad par can gyis mjug bsdu ba'o/ / dang po ni/ rang bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor bkod pa de~X na~Xs bco~Xm ldana~X 'da~Xs dgye~Xs pa~X che~Xn po~Xs khro bo'i dkyi~Xl 'kho~Xr gyi~X tshoga~Xs che~Xn po~X gong du bstan pa 'di~X dga~X dma~X tshi~Xg chen po'i gsung gi~X rang bzhin yin pas de nyid rnal 'byor ba rnams kyisaX gruba~X para~X bya~X ba~X'i phyira~X/ rang snang bkod pa'i de~X bzhi~Xn gshe~Xgs pa~X'i khro~X bo~X zhes smos pa ni byang chub sems dpa' la sogs pa gzhan gyi rgyud kyis bsdus pa bsal nas/ sangs rgyas longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku zhi ba rdo rje dbyings dang tha mi dad par bstan pa'o/ / de lta bu'i khro bo khra~Xg 'thunga~X che~Xn po~X rang rang gi btsuna~X mo~X da~Xng bca~Xs pa~X'i tshoga~Xs de~X dga~X gi~Xs rang rang gi sku~X da~Xng gsu~Xng dnga~X thuga~Xs rdo~X rje~X'i bdag nyid rang byung gi ye~X she~Xs chen po sngags kyi rang sgrar rang shar ba 'brug stong ldir ba tsam pa'i nga ro rngama~Xs pa~X la~Xs gsunga~X gi~X dkyi~Xl 'kho~Xr sngags kyi tshogs 'di~X dga~X rang shar du phyunga~X ngo~X*/ / gnyis pa la lnga ste/ lha bskyed pa'i/ ye shes pa spyan drangs pa'i/ dngos grub kyi don du gsol ba gdab pa'i/ rig pa'i me tog dor ba'i/ phrin las kyi don du gtor ma sbyin pa'i sngags so/ / dang po la'ang lnga las/ gtso bo yab yum bskyed pa las/ yab kyi sngags ni/ oṃ zhes pa la sogs pa ste/ o~Xṃ bkra shis pa dang sngags byin gyis rlob pa'o/ / ta~X thā~X ga~X ta~X de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ / ma~X hā~X chen po/ shrī~X ni dpal/ he~X ru ༵ka~X ni khrag 'thung*/ ma~X hā~X tsa~Xṇḍa~X ni gtum po chen po/

sa~Xrba~X du~Xṣta~Xn sdang ba thams cad do/ / a~Xnta~X ka~X mthar byed pa'o/ / de dag rtsa ba'i sngags te bcom ldan 'das la 'bod pa'o/ / ha~X na~X rgyob cigada~X ha~X sregs shigapa~X tsa~X tshos shigahūm̐~X hūm̐~X hūm̐~X ni gdug pa can gyi lus ngag yid gsum sdud pa'o/ / pha~Xṭaḥni dum bur gtong ba'o/ / de dag phrin las kyi sngags so/ / de bzhin du badzra~X ni rdo rje/ ra~Xtna~X rin po che/ pa~Xdma~X ni skad sor bzhag ste padma/ ka~Xrma~X las te/ gzhan rnams snga ma bzhin no/ / yum gyi sngags ni o~Xṃ sa~Xrba~X ta~X thā~X ga~X ta~X ma~X hā~X kro~X dhāe shwa~X ri~X ni de bzhin gshegs pa khro mo dbang phyug ma/ sa~Xrba~X du~Xṣta~Xna~X hūm̐~X pha~Xṭaḥsdang ba kun bsdus la chom zhig pa'o/ / o~Xṃ ma~X hā~X ba~Xdzra~X dha~X ra~X ma~X hā~X kro dhāe shwa ༵rī~X dzwa~X la~X nī~X hūm̐~X pha~Xṭaḥzhes pa/ rdo rje'i gzung ma khro mo dbang phyug 'bar ba chen mo gdug pa can bsdus la gtor cig pa'o/ / o~Xṃ ma~X hā~X sū~Xrya~X ra~Xtna~X ma~X hā~X kro~X dhāe shwa~X rī~X bi~X da~X ma~X ni rin cen nyi ma'i khro mo dbang phyug ma chen mo rnam par 'joms ma'o/ / o~Xṃ hri~X shwa~X tta~X sa~X manta~X pa~Xdma~X ma~X hā~X kro~X dhāe shwa~X ri~X khā~X hi~X kun tu dgod pa'i khro mo dbang phyug chen mo zo zhig pa'o/ / o~Xṃ sa~Xrba~X a~X mo~X gha~X ma~X hā~X kro~X dhāe shwa~X ri~X bī~X shwa~X ni thams cad don yod pa'i khro mo chen mo dbang phyug sna tshogs ma'o/ / gnyis pa ma mo brgyad kyi sngags ni/ oṃ~X ba~Xdzra~X sngar bzhin no/ / gau~X rī~X ni dkar mo'o/ / de sngon gyi gzhung phal che bar ko'u rī zhes brjod pa'ang de nyid de/ mdzod ldan dang*/ mkhas pa dang*/ padma la dga' ba la sogs pa du ma la 'jug kyang*/ mdzod ldan du bsgyur ro/ / tsau~X rī~X ni chom rkun ma'o/ / pra~X mo~X hā~X ni rab tu rmongs ma'o/ / bai~Xtta~X lī~X ni ro langs ma'o/ / tsa~Xṇḍa~X lī~X ni gtum mo'o/ / pu~Xkka~X sī~X ni spos mo'o/

/ gha~Xsma~X rī~X ni sme sha can no/ / sma~X sha~X ni dur khrod ma'o/ / ha~X brgyad ni de dag gi sa bon no/ / de'ang badzra gau rī dzaḥ zhes pa dang sbyar na phrin las bsgrub pa ste/ dzaḥbasal na nyes par byed pa'o/ / de bzhin du shes par bya'o/ / gsum pa phra men ma brgyad kyi sngags ni senga~X hā~X mu~X khā~X ni seng gdong ma'o/ / byā~X ghri~X mu~X kha~X stag gdong ma'o/ / sri~X la~X mu~X kha~X wa gdong ma'o/ / shwa~X na~X spyang ki kri~X ta~X bya rgod/ ka~Xng ka~X dur bya/ kha~X khā~X bya rogahu~X lu~X mu~X khā~X 'ug pa'i gdong can ma'o/ / he~X brgyad ni sa bon no/ / phrin las kyi sngags kyang snga ma bzhin no/ / bzhi pa sgo ma bzhi'i sngags ni| ā~Xrya~X te~X dza~X te~X nga~X ni 'phags pa'i gzi brjid de rta mgo can no/ / a~X mo~X gha~X ni don yod pa ste phag gi gdong can no/ / ba~Xdzra lo~X ka~X rdo rje 'jig rten snang byed ma ste dred gdong ma'o/ / bha~Xsmi~X pa~X la~X ya~X ba~X ti~X ni thal bar byed pa ste spyang gdong can no/ / mtha' rten gyi dza~Xḥhūm̐~X ba~Xm̐ ho~Xḥbazhi ni sa bon no/ / lnga pa dbang phyug ma rnams kyi sngags ni/ bhyo~X nyi shu rtsa brgyad de/ de'ang bha gī ni sring mo/ bharya chung ma/ de dag gi sgra bsdus te bhyo zhes sa bon du byas pa'o/ / las bsgrub pa'i tshe oṃ ma ni rakṣa si bhyo dgra bo mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥces pa la sogs pa so so'i sngags dang sbyar ro/ / gnyis pa ye shes pa spyan drangs pa'i sngags ni ru lu ru lu ru lu hūm̐ ni khro bo 'chol ba'i dkyil 'khor 'bod pa'o/ / de'ang sngon las kyi srin po'i dam tshig gis gdug pa'i glu dpal chen pos byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ / e~X hye~X hi ༵ni tshur spyon tshur spyon no/ / a~X na~X ya~X ho~Xḥganas 'dir ro/ / dza~Xḥhūm̐~X ba~Xm̐ ho~Xḥni tshad med bzhis sems can gyi las la bskul ba'o/ / ra~Xm̐ ni dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa spyan drangs pa'i me ri 'dab 'byor tsam du bzhugs pa'o/

/ bla ma rong pa ni rig pa'i me tog dor ba ste bdag dang lha rang bzhin dbyer med du rtogs nas gnyis su med pa la phyogs pa'o zhes 'chad do/ / gsum pa rig pa'i me tog dor ba'i sngags ni o~Xṃ ba~Xdzra~X kro~X dha~X sa~X ma~X ya~X hūm̐~X ni khro bo dam tshig la 'dus shig pa'o/ / bzhi pa dngos grub kyi don du gsol ba gdab pa ni o~Xṃ gdul bya las kyi khro~X bo ma rungs pa 'dul ba la~X ye shes kyi rang bzhin de bas kyang khrosa~X par snang bsa~X gdul bya'i rgyud zhi~X bar mdza~Xd pa~X thuga~Xs rje~X ngang gis khro~X bor sprul pa ni 'gro ba'i dpa~Xl chen po rab tu rngama~Xs pa~X'i tsho~Xgs/ sku gsung thugs ye shes kyi rang bzhin 'ba~Xr ba~X byina~X rlaba~Xs rmada~X du byung ba che~Xn po~X de~X dus da lta nyida~X du~X ni~X bda~Xg la~X sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub ma lus pa stsola~X cig pa'o/ / sa~X ma~X ya~X st+wa~Xṃ dam tshig la nos shigasa~X ma~X ya~X pha~Xṭaḥdam tshig spros shigasa~X ma~X ya~X ho~X dam tshig yin no zhes pa'o/ / lnga pa phrin las kyi don du gtor ma sbyin pa'i sngags ni a~X li~X u~X li~X bza' ba dang btung ba*/ tā li~X ta~X pa~X li~X de dag gi yan lag go / da~Xṃṣta~Xṃ gau~X na~X rau~X tri~X mche ba can rdo rje drag po'i tshogs/ kha~X ra~Xm̐ yo~X gi~X ni~X khā~X hi~X ho~X zhal 'bar ba rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs gsol cig pa'o/ / de dag gang gi zhal du gsol snyam na hūm̐~X ha~X he~X pha~Xṭaḥlha sum cu'i dkyil 'khor ro/ / de'ang 'di ltar rig par bya ste/ gsang sngags 'di dag bod skad du ma bsgyur ba ni gsung pa po'i bden tshig 'grub par bya ba'i phyir ro/ / gal te bsgyur nas bzlas na dngos grub med de/ bod skad du sngon gyi gsang sngags gsung ba pos byin gyis ma brlabs pa'i phyir ro/ / skad so sor shan sbyor ma shes kyang nyes pa med de/ dad pa dang mos pa rtse gcig pas bzlas na dngos grub chen po ji lta ba bzhin 'byung ngo*/

/ sgra sbyor shes na'ang phan yon yod de/ tshig don go bas don gyi gzungs 'grub pa dang tshig la rmongs pa med pa yin no/ / gsum pa ltas khyad par can gyi mjug bsdu ba ni/ de skad cesa~X brjo~Xd pa~Xs 'ji~Xg rtena~X druga~X gi~X phyoga~Xs ba~Xcu thama~Xs ca~Xd kyi snod ma dag pa'i dngos po dang bcud kyi sgrib pa'i tshogs las/ lus kyi mi dge ba rnams tshiga~X ngag gi ra~Xb tu~X tshi~Xgasems kyi kuna~X tu~X rab tu tshi~Xg go~X/ de ltar tha mal gyi dngos po sgrib pa dang bcas pa tshig nas snang ba snod kyi 'jig rten ye shes kyi snang bar 'bar zhing gdul bya'i sgo gsum la sku'i ye shes 'ba~Xr/ gsung gi ra~Xb tu~X 'ba~Xr/ thugs kyi kuna~X tu~X rab tu 'ba~Xr ro~X/ / de'i tshe snang srid snod bcud nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa thama~Xs ca~Xd du ༵'ba~Xr ba~X'i dkyi~Xl 'kho~Xr gyi~X tshoga~Xs rigs lnga'i rang bzhin gyisa~X nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad sku'i dkyil 'khor gyis ganga~X zhing sku de dag las gsang sngags kyi rang sgra 'brug stong tsam gyis khyab par ra~Xb tu~X ganga~X ba thams cad kyang thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa dang 'od dang gzi brjid kyis gsal la chos skus khyab pa'i thugs kyi rang bzhin gnyis su med pas kuna~X tu~X ganga~X ba~Xr gyura~X to~X/ / zhes pa'o/ / yang dkyil 'khor gsum gyis nam mkha' dang sa gzhi dang bar snang gsum tu gang rab tu gang kun tu gang ngo*/ / yang rang snang lhun stug po bkod par 'od dang gzi brjid dang ye shes kyi bkod pas gang rab tu gang kun tu gang ba'o/ / gsung mchog tu gsa~Xng ba~X'i snyinga~X po~X ye shes kyi rang sgra'i de~X kho~X na~X nyida~X nge~Xs pa~X la~Xs/ ye shes kyi khro~X bo~X'i tsho~Xgs che~Xn po~X'i gsung ༵gi~X gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dkyi~Xl 'kho~Xr mtha' dbus med par sprosa~X pa~X'i le'u~X ste~X bcu ༵druga~X pa'i rnam par bshad pa~X'o~X/ / / / ༈ spyi don gnyis pa dm-igs pa'i rten gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor la gsum ste/

dkyil 'khor 'byung ba'i rgyu spyir bstan/ dkyil 'khor gyi rang bzhin rgyas par bshad/ ngo mtshar gyi ltas snang ba'o/ / dang po ni/ gsung gsang sngags kyi dkyil 'khor bstan pa de~X na~Xs bco~Xm ldana~X 'da~Xs dgyesa~X pa~X che~Xn po~Xs khro bo'i sprin phung gsang sngags dang bcas pa de~X da~Xg gi~X rnam pa gsal bar byed pa na dmigs pa'i rten dgos pas phyi rabs kyi gdul bya la phan pa'i don du gzugs brnyan gyi dkyi~Xl 'kho~Xr bstana~X pa~X'i phyira~X che~Xd du~X brjo~Xd pa~X 'di~X dag brjoda~X do~X/ / gnyis pa la gnyis te/ rten gzhal yas khang dang*/ brten pa lha'i dkyil 'khor ro/ / dang po la gsum las/ gzhal yas khang dngos ni/ ye shes lnga mtshon pa'i phyir phyi nang med par me dpung 'ba~Xr ba~X'i klong pho brang gi 'og gzhi lte ba mu 'khyud dang bcas pa'i 'kho~Xr lo~X rtsiba~Xs bzhi~X pa~X ni rigs lnga'i rang bzhin gyi brda'o/ / de'ang tshad med pa bzhi dang bden pa bzhi mtshon pa'i phyir gru~X chada~X bzhi~X yisa~X rnama~X pa~Xr brgyana~X pa'o/ / de'i steng du ye shes kyi gzhal yas khang yon tan rgyas pa'i brdar gru~X bzhi~X pa rnam par thar ba bzhi'i mtshon byed du sgo~X khyuda~X bzhi~X da~Xng lda~Xn pa'i dbus sku lnga'i brdar 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi gru chad dang bcas pas mdzes pa'o/ / des mtshon pa rnam thar brgyad kyi rta babs dang bden pa gnyis kyi don mtshon pa ye shes 'ba~Xr ba~X'i b.ra~X khyama~Xs phyi nang gnyisa~X kyisa~X mdze~Xs shing bandha'i rtsig pa chen pos lhun mtho ba'o/ / gnyis pa de mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan ni/ phal cher gong dang mtshungs shing*/ khyad par du thoda~X pa skam rlon gyi rtsig pa la sbrula~X nag gi chun pos dkris shing*/ thod pa sbrul gyi za ra tshags dang*/ nyi ma dang zla ba'i mthong khung dang*/ tshangs pa'i gdung dang*/ mchog chen gyi ka ba dang*/ rus sbal gyi ka gdan dang*/ zhing gi phyam dang*/ mchog phran gyi gral ba dang*/ g.yang gzhi'i thog g.yam dang*/

rgyu ma'i drwa ba dang*/ don snying gi drwa phyed dang*/ sgo bzhi rus sbal gyi ma them dang*/ chu srin gyi ya them dang*/ sbrul nag gi skyes bu dang*/ zhing chen gyi sgo glegs la sogs pa sna~X tshoga~Xs pas brgyan zhing*/ nyi~X ma~X dang zla ba dang gza' skar gyi kha bad dang rgyan gyisaX brji~Xd cing me dpung 'ba~Xr ba~X'i rtse las me'i tsha tsha phyogs bcur 'phro~X ba'i phreng ba~X ma~Xng po~X dang 'od zer 'khruga~Xs pas mdzes pa'o/ / gsum pa gdan gyi khyad par ni 'gro ba zil gyis gnon pa khyu~X mcho~Xg dang*/ gzi brjid che ba ma~X he~X dang*/ gdug pa che ba gzi~Xg da~Xng*/ dpa' brtul che ba staga~X dang*/ rang bzhin gyis gtuma~X pa~X'i doma~X rnams kyi~X spara~X ba~Xs ni~X btegs pa'o/ / mi shes pa dag sder mos lha chen po bzung zhes 'chad pa ni ma yin te/ 'di dag gi khri'i steng du dregs pa pho mo bsnol ba la bzhugs pa yin no/ / de'i steng du dregs pa'i dba~Xng phyuga~X lha~X che~Xn po la~X so~Xgs pa khyo shug zunga~X du bsnol ba'o/ / bzung ni yi ge ma dag pa'o/ / srog chags 'di dag kyang sku gsung thugs ye shes lnga'i mtshon byed du rang snang ba'o/ / gnyis pa brten pa lha'i dkyil 'khor la gnyis te/ gtso bo'i bzhugs tshul dang*/ 'khor gyi bkod pa'o/ / dang po la gsum las/ sku mdog dang zhal phyag gi rnam pa las/ sku mdog ni gti mug gnas su dag pas gtso bo smuga~X naga~X zhe sdang dag pas badzra he ru ka sngo~X na~Xg nga rgyal dag pas ratna sera~X na~Xg da~Xng 'dod chags dag pas padma dma~Xr na~Xg phrag dog pas karmā yab yum ljanga~X na~Xg ste rtsa zhal dang bcas pa'o/ / dbus dang shar nub byang bzhi'i he ru ka'i g.yas dkar zhing*/ lho'i g.yas sngon po'o/ / dbus dang lho dang byang gi g.yon dmar zhing*/ shar dang nub kyi g.yon ser po'o/ / de'ang drag po'i 'phrin las mthar phyin pa'i rtags su thams cad la nag po'i sgra smos so/ / gdul bya gdug pa can gyi snang ngor rab tu 'ji~Xgs pa~X'i sku~X ste/

zhal phyag gi gnas lugs ni dug gsum dag cing sku gsum mnga' ba'i phyir thams cad kyang dbu~X gsu~Xm pa| ye shes drug la dbang bsgyur zhing pha rol tu phyin pa drug gis 'gro ba drug sgrol ba'i phyir phyag drug pa rdzu 'phrul bzhi dang bdud bzhi 'dul ba'i brdar zhaba~Xs bzhi~X brkyang bskum du bgrada~X pa'o/ / gnyis pa rgyan chas dang gsung gi nga ro la/ rgyan chas ni dpal kyi chas brgyad de/ theg pa chen po'i don la mnga' brnyes pa'i mtshon byed du glang chen lpags pa'i stod g.yogs/ dregs pa dbang du sdud pa zhing gi g.yang gzhi'i stod g.yogs/ gzung 'dzin gyi mtha' las grol ba stag lpags kyi sham thabs te ko~X rlona~X gyi go~Xs ni~X rnam pa sna~X tshoga~Xs dang ldana~X pa'o/ / sbrul ni rgyal rigs dkar po'i dbu rgyan/ rje rigs ser po'i snyan cha dang mgur chu/ bram ze'i rigs dmar po'i do shal dang dpung rgyan/ rmongs rigs ljang gu'i sked ragagadol ba'i rigs nag po'i phyag zhabs kyi gdu bu'o/ / thod phreng ni mi mgo skam po'i dbu rgyan/

rnyid pa'i ser ral kha/ rlon pa lnga bcu rtsa gcig gi do shal lo/ nyi ma dang zla ba'i chas ni phrag pa g.yas g.yon nas 'od 'gyed pa ste thabs dang shes rab kyis snang ba'i brda'o/ / de dag gis mtshon nas/ rakta'i thig le/ zhag gi zo ris/ thal chen gyi tshom bu dang brgyad do/ / de'ang ko rlon/ sbrul/ thod phreng*/ nyi zla gnyis/ rakta/ zhag thal ba rnams dur khrod chas brgyad do/ / gsung gi nga ro ni rngama~Xs pa~X'i sgra~X skad che~Xn po 'jiga~Xs pa~Xr sgroga~Xs pa 'brug stong ldir ba tsam mo// gsum pa phyag mtshan dang btsun mo'i sbyor tshul la/ phyag mtshan ni/ sangs rgyas gsang ba phyag g.yas g.yon gyi dang po gnyis na rdo rje dang 'khor la/ bar ba ni ral gri dang dung chen mtha' ma na dgra sta dang thong gshol la sogs kyi sgra dbyug to/ / tri shul/ bai con la sogs pa'o zhes gsungs shing*/ rong pa ni g.yas dang po rang rang gi phyag mtshan/ g.yon dang po bandha raktas bkang ba/ gzhan rnams rim pa bzhin sbyor bar bzhed kyang*/ 'di sgyu 'phrul rdo rje dang mthun par sbyar na/ g.yas dang po rnams rang rang gi phyag mtshan 'dzin pa ste/ de'ang badzra he ru ka'i g.yas dang po rdo~X rje~X rtse dgu pa'o/ / rigs lnga ga'i g.yas bar ma rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang*/ g.yon bar ma dunga~X che~Xn te thod pa lcang lo med pa khrag gis ganga~X ba~X'o~X/ / karma he ru ka'i g.yas dang po rala~X gri~X/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i g.yon dang po dang*/ rin po che'i g.yon tha ma gnyis na dgra~X sta~X/ las kyi g.yon dang po thong gsho~Xl/ rdo rje'i g.yon tha ma dang*/ las kyi g.yon tha ma gnyis stong gi 'jig rten 'khor yug dang bcas pa mtshon pa'i phyir rnge chung ngo*/ / la~X so~Xgs kyis bsdus pa/ buddha'i g.yas dang po 'khor lo/ ratna'i rin po che/ padma'i padma/ buddha'i g.yon tha ma kha ṭāṃ garin po che'i g.yon dang po rgyu zhags/ rdo rje dang padma'i g.yon dang po dril bu/ padma'i g.yon tha ma rnge chung*/

thams cad kyi g.yas tha ma ti ra ste zhing dbyug gdengs pa ste/ ranga~X gi~X la~Xg cha~X sna~X tshoga~Xs bsnama~Xs pa'o/ / de'ang rdo rje las/ rdo rje rdo rje dril bu dang*/ / 'jig rten 'khor yug bcas pa 'degs/ / de bzhin 'khor lo dgra sta dang*/ / kha ṭwām̐ rab tu 'khrol ba'o/ / nor bu rin cen rgyu zhags dang*/ / rdo rje dgra sta rab tu bsdebs/ / chags mchog padma chen po dang*/ / dril bu rnga yi sgra sgrogs pa'o/ / las kyi ral gri gshol chen dang*/ / 'jig rten rgyang mar 'phen pa ste/ / bar ma rdo rje dung dmar 'khrug/ ti ra chen po rab bsdebs pa'o/ / zhes so/ / btsun mo'i 'khril tshul ni rang rang gi rigs kyi btsuna~X mo~X lnga ni zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma 'ji~Xgs pa'i~X tshoga~Xs g.yas yab la 'khyud cing g.yon thod khrag gtso bo'i zhal du stobs pa dnga~X 'khri~Xl ba'o/ / gnyis pa 'khor gyi bkod pa la gnyis las/ dang po khro mo nyi shu'i bkod pa ni/ gnas kyi ma mo brgyad ni/ de'ang rnam shes tshogs brgyad 'khor ba bskyed pa'i gnas yin la/ de rnams gnas su dag par byed pa'i phyir gnas kyi phyag rgya zhes bya'o/ / de la gau rī dkar mo zhing dbyug dang bhan dmar/ tsau rī ser mo mda' gzhu 'gengs pa/ phra mo ha dmar mo phyag gnyis chu srin gyi rgyal mtshan bsgreng ba/ bai tta lī nag mo rdo rje 'phyar zhing bhan dmar thugs kar 'dzin pa/ pukka sī dmar ser byis pa'i rgyu ma 'dren pa/ ghasma ri ljang nag dung dmar dkrug cing gsol ba/ sma sha ni mthing nag byis pa'i snying za ba/ tsaṇḍa lī ser skya bam gyi mgo lus 'bral ba'o/ / yul gyi phyag rgya phra men brgyad la/ de'ang sgo lnga'i rnam shes kyi yul gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya/ yid kyi yul chos/ nyon mongs pa can gyi yul kun gzhi/ kun gzhi'i yul phyi nang gi chos thams cad gnas su dag pas yul gyi phyag rgya'o/ / de'ang seng ha ser mo lag pas ro bsnol nas kha'i thad du 'dzin pa/

byā gri dmar mo ro la mig 'bru tshugs su blta ba dang*/ sri la nag mo zhing la 'dag pa dang*/ shwa na mthing ga ro'i lto ba 'dral ba dang kri ta dmar mo ro'i rgyu ma 'dren pa dang*/ kang ka ser mo zhing chen phrag la khur ba dang*/ kā ka nag mo bhan gri thog pa dang*/ hu lu mthing ga lcags kyu 'debs pa'o/ / sgo ma bzhi'i phyag rgyas rab tu mdzes pa ni/ phyin ci log gi bdud bzhi 'joms shing ye shes bzhi yis rgyas 'debs pa ste/ rta gdong dkar mo lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ phag gdong nag mo zhags pa 'dzin pa/ dred gdong dmar mo lcags sgrog 'dzin pa/ spyang gdong ljang gu dril chen 'dzin pa'o/ / gnyis pa dbang mo nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi bkod pa ni slas chung ma dang byi mo mdza' mo dang bran mo'i tshogs ni g.yog gi las byed pa'i cha nas btags te de ltar bcu phrag gnyis dang ni brgyad kyis mdzes par bskor ba'o/ / de dag rang rang gi 'og na ro'i gdan dang thod rlon la sogs pa'i lag cha dang bcas te phrin las ci bgyi zhes ni chas te 'khor bar gnas so/ / ji ltar gnas na/ srin mo smug nag thod rlon 'chang ba dang*/ tshangs pa dmar ser padma 'dzin pa dang*/ 'khrug mo dkar ljang tri shul 'dzin pa dang*/ gta ོ gas 'dod sngon mo 'khor lo thogs pa dang*/ gzhon nu dmar mo mdung thung 'dzin pa dang*/ dbang mo dkar mo rdo rje 'dzin pa dang*/ 'dod pa dmar mo tsandan*/ bdud rtsi dmar mo padma/ zla ba dkar mo punḍa ri ka*/ bai con ljang gu dbyug to/ / srin mo dmar nag dung khrag 'thung ba/ za ba ljang nag ro yi rgyu ma 'dren pa/ dga' ba dmar mo gri gugamyos ma dmar mo gshol/ gcig pur spyod ma ser mo spu gri/ yid 'phrog dmar mo mda' gzhu/ grub mo dkar mo bum pa/ rlung lha sngon mo ba dan/ gsod byed dkar mo ral gri/ me mo dmar mo gsal shing*/ phag mo nag mo mche zhags*/ rgan byed nag mo zhing za ba dang*/ sna 'phyang dkar mo thod khrag 'thung ba/

chu lha dmar mo sbrul zhags/ nag mo chen mo lcags kyu/ ser mo zhags pa/ dmar mo lcags sgroganag mo dril bu 'khrol ba'o/ / le'u 'di ni bri ba dang sgom pa la sogs pa spyi'i don du smos kyi gcig kho na'i phyogs su chad pa ni ma yin no/ / gsum pa ngo mtshar gyi ltas snang ba ni de skad ces brjod pas 'jig rten drug gi phyogs bcu thams cad du ye shes kyi khro bo me dpung 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor zhing gi rdul snyed nam mkha'i dbyings dang chos kyi dbyings kyis khyab pa kun tu sku gsung thugs kyi snang bas gang bar gyur to/ / ra~Xng bzhina~X gsa~Xng ba~X'i snyinga~X po~X dkyil 'khor gyi de~X kho~X na~X nyida~X nge~Xs pa~X la~Xs/ khro~X bo~X'i dkyila~X 'khora~X gyi~X rnam dbye bstan pa'i le~X'u~X ste ༵bcu~X bduna~X pa'i rnam par bshad pa~X'o~X/ / / / ༈ spyi don gsum pa der mchod pa ji ltar bya ba'i tshul la gsum ste/ don gyi 'brel dgod/ tshig gi don bshad/ skabs kyi don bsdu ba'o/ / dang po ni/ dkyil 'khor bstan pa de~X na~Xs bco~Xm ldana~X 'da~Xs mchod sprin gyi rol pa la dgyesa~X pa~X chena~X po~Xs phyi nang gsang ba'i rang bzhin gyis mnyesa~X pa'i~X mcho~Xd pa~X che~Xn po~X 'di~X dag che~Xd du~X brjoda~X do~X/ / gnyis pa la gsum ste/ sbyor sgrol gyi mchod pa spyir bstan/ dam rdzas 'dod yon gyi mchod pa bye brag tu bshad/ de'i phan yon dngos grub 'grub pa'i tshul brjod pa'o/ / dang po la gnyis las/ sgrol ba'i mchod pa ni/ de~X la~X rgyal ba mcho~Xd pa dang sems can la sbyina~X pa bya ba'i tshul ni bsod nams kyi tshogs yin la/ de dag gi nang nas mchog dma~X pa~X ni~X sems nyid ye nas dag pa mchod bya mchod byed med pa don gyi mchod pa ste mchod pa'i phyag rgya chen po yin pas na/ tho~Xg ma~Xr bda~Xg nyida~X kyis 'khor ba'i gnas 'dir ma rig pa'i log par rtoga~X pas dngos po dang mtshan mar goma~Xs pa'i phyin ci log spros pa'i mtha' brgyad dang gzung 'dzin du zhen pa'i blo ngan thams cad gdod nas skye ba med pa'i ngang du bsgrala~X te/

phyi nang gi chos thams cad nam mkha'i rang bzhin can du bsgom par bya'o/ / de skad du'ang rgya mtsho las/ mchod pa'i phyag rgya che mchog ni/ / sems kyi rtogs tshogs kun bsgral te/ / mchod dang mchod bya mi dmigs pa'i/ / rang bzhin nam mkha'i ngang du bsgom/ / zhes so/ / kha cig lta ba rtogs pa goms pa'i sgom par sbyor ba ni ma rtogs pa'i rnam 'gyur du snang ngo*/ / mchod pa spyi'i sngon 'gro'am rdzogs rim du sbyar yang 'gal ba med mod/ 'od kyang sgrol mchod la sgra nye ba'i phyir bshad de/ thog ma med pa nas bdag gzhan du rtog pa goms pa de yod pas zhe sdang rang ga ma 'byung ba'i phyir/ sgrol ba'i tshe gnyis su med pa'i don dang dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje'i ngang nas rang gi gzung 'dzin gyi zhen pa dang bsgrub bya thabs shes kyi ngang nas bsgral ces bya ba yin no/ / ji ltar bsgral ba dngos ni/ rang gi gnyis 'dzin gyi rtog pa chos dbyings su bsgral ba de~X na~Xs bsgral ba'i yul dang sgrol byed bdag nyid gnyisa~X su me~Xd pa'i blo~X yisa~X ni~X shes rab mtha' gnyis la mi gnas pa'i ngang las/ thabs snying rje chen pos bsgral bar bya ste/ zhing bcu lta ba'i sems can blo~X nga~Xn srid pa'i 'ji~Xg rtena~X 'og mar brgyud pa 'di dag snyinga~X re~X rje~X snyam du byams pa dang snying rje tshad med pa bsgoms nas/ bdag nyid sgyu ma dang yul mig yor gyi tshul tsam du shes par bya ste/ kun rdzob tu snang yang don dam par gnyisa~X su~X meda~X pa~Xr rtogs pas bsgrala~X ba~Xr bya~X'o~X/ / de'ang skabs dang sbyar te bya zhing rgyas par le'u bcu gcig pa dang*/ nyi shu pa'i skabs drag po'i phrin las ltar bya'o/ / gnyis pa sbyor ba'i mchod pa ni gong du bshad pa ltar bdag dang yum lhar bskyed pa'i gsang bar dkyil 'khor spyan drangs la yab yum gnyis su med par 'khrila~X ba~X'i bde ba byang chub kyi sems kyi mcho~Xd rdzas che~Xn po rdo rje dang padma mnyama~X par sbyora~X ba~X la~Xs skyes pa'i ngo bos bda~Xg nyid ༵mnyesa~X pa~X de yisaX de bzhin gshegs pa kun mnyesa~X pa~Xr bya~X'o~X/

/ gnyis pa dam rdzas 'dod yon gyi mchod pa bye brag tu bshad pa la gnyis las/ dang po dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa ni bdag gzhan 'khor 'das mnyama~X pa~X'i dngos grub sgruba~X pa'i rdzasa~X che~Xn po~X bdud rtsi lnga la sogs pa da~Xg bda~Xg gi phung po khams da~Xng skye mched ye nas dkyil 'khor du gnas pa la ting nge 'dzin zab mos gsal btab pa dang bdag dang mnyama~X pa~X ye shes lha'iX tsho~Xgs la~X dbula~X lo/ / de'ang dri chen/ dri chu/ sha chen gyi dwangs ma/ rakta/ byang chub kyi sems lnga ni ngo bo ye nas dag pa chos kyi dbyings*/ rang bzhin de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs la sogs pa rigs lnga dang*/ ye shes lha'i ngo bor gnas shing byin gyis brlabs te longs spyad pas dug lnga dang*/ 'byung ba'i nad rnams sel ba'i phyir sman gyi mchog ste/ thal ba las/ sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam sbyor ba'i*/ / rang byung gdod nas rnam par dag / rtsa brgyad stong las sbyar ba'i sman/ / ye shes lnga rdzogs grub pa'i rdzas/ / rgyud lnga'i sems can kun sgrol ba'i/ / dug lnga sel ba'i bdud rtsi mchog/ ces so/ / rtsa brgyad stong las sbyar ba ni de dag gi ye shes lnga lnga la sogs par phye na de tsam du gnas pa'o/ / gnyis pa 'dod yon gyi mchod pa la gnyis las/ mchod rdzas ni sha dang mar la sogs pa'i bza~X' ba da~Xng shing tog la sogs pa'i bca~X' ba da~Xng ja dang rgun chang la sogs pa'i btunga~X ba da~Xng li chu dang za ber la sogs pa'i bgo~X ba dang*/ gzhan yang lha dang mi'i longa~Xs spyoda~X 'dod yon lnga~X dang lda~Xn pa thama~Xs ca~Xd kun ji ltar 'bul tshul ni~X/ mchod yul ye shes kyi lha'i dkyi~Xl 'kho~Xr du gsa~Xl ba la~X ni~X mchod rdzas 'dod yon gyi lha'i dkyi~Xl 'kho~Xr thi~Xm pa'i tshul gyis dbul zhing bdag yab tu shes pa la rdzas yum du rol pas longs spyod par bya'o/ / de skad du'ang mnyam sbyor las/ sha dang chang du ldan pa yi/ / bza' ba sna tshogs grub pa ni/

/ dga' ba'i longs spyod skal mchog ste/ / che ba'i dam pa rab tu 'grub/ / ces so/ / gsum pa de'i phan yon la gnyis las/ thun mong gi dngos grub la'ang 'thad pa'i tshul dgod pa ni phyoga~Xs bcu~X dusa~X bzhi~Xr sems can gyi don la gshe~Xgs pa~X yi~X/ bde~X bar gshe~Xgs pa rnams kyi yo~Xn tana~X rma~Xd po~X che~X thams cad kyang sems goms pa las gzha~Xn na~X yo~Xd pa~X ma~X yi~Xn na~X/ thun mong gi dngos grub lha~X srina~X bran du 'khol ba dang las phran tshegs zhi rgyas dbang drag la~X so~Xgs 'grub pa lta smosa~X kyang ci~X dgo~Xs zhes pa ni 'thad pa grub pa'i don dngos so/ / gnyis pa mchog gi dngos grub ni rnala~X 'byo~Xr ba rtogs pa dang ting nge 'dzin la~Xs su~X runga~X ba rnama~Xs kyisa~X mtshan bcas lha'i sku phya~Xg rgya~X che~Xn po~X me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bu'i bskyed rim rdzoga~Xs par gyura~X ci~Xng mtshan med rdzogs pa chen po bya rtsol med pa'i ngang la 'di'o zhes spros pa'i mtha' dang 'dzin zhen du gsala~X ba'i~X yi~Xd gnyisa~X gang yang meda~X pa~Xs na~X de bzhin nyid kun tu bzang po'i dgongs par phyin te/ sku gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i dkyila~X 'kho~Xr che~Xn po~X phrin las dang bcas pa 'ba~Xr zhing 'thob pa~Xr 'gyura~X ro/ / de'ang chos thams cad sems kyi cho 'phrul yin zhing*/ sems kyang ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin thabs kyi grub rdzas kyis mtshon nas lam du byas pa las gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi don gnyis rdzogs par gyur te/ sgyu 'phrul thal pa las/ dngos po ma lus sems nyid phyir/ / mtshan nyid bral ba chos kyi dbyings/ / rang bzhin med pa ye shes lnga/ / byed pa med par rang snang ba'o/ / shes rab ting 'dzin thabs dag gis/ / nus mthu nges par 'byung b.ra'agyur/ / 'di lta'i lam la gang gnas pa/ / sangs rgyas ma lus thams cad kyis/ / phyogs bcu kun nas byin gyis rlobs/ / dkyil 'khor 'bar ba thob par 'gyur/ / zhes so/

/ gsum pa skabs kyi don bsdub ni/ de skad ce~Xs brjoda~X pasa~X phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i mnyesa~X pa~X'i mcho~Xd pa~X che~Xn po~Xs phyi nang gi 'j-i~Xg rtena~X druga~X gi~X phyoga~Xs bcu~X thama~Xs ca~Xd du khyaba~X pa~Xr gyura~X to~X/ / ye shes gsa~Xng ba~X'i snying ༵po~X kun la khyab pa'i de~X kho~X na~X nyida~X nge~Xs pa~X la~Xs/ bla na med pa'i yo byad kyis rgyal ba mcho~Xd cing sems can la sbyina~X pa dam pa~X bstana~X pa~X'i le~X'u~X ste~X bco~X brgyada~X pa'i rnam par bshad pa~X'o~X/ / / / ༈ spyi don bzhi pa dam tshig dang ldan pas 'grub pa dam tshig gi rim pa la gsum ste/ don gyi 'brel dgod pa/ tshig gi don bshad/ skabs kyi don bsdu ba'o/ / dang po ni/ mchod sbyin bshad pa de~X na~Xs bco~Xm ldana~X 'da~Xs dam tshig chen po'i rang bzhin la dgye~Xs pa~X che~Xn po~Xs gsang sngaga~Xs 'cha~Xng ba'i rnal 'byor pa rnama~Xs 'bras bu myur du 'grub cing log par mi ltung bas smon pa dona~X yo~Xd pa~Xr bya~X ba'i~X phyira~X gsang chen rgyal po'i dma~X tshi~Xg che~Xn po~X 'di~X che~Xd du~X brjo~Xd par mdzad do~X/

/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ spyi'i don dang*/ gzhung gi don no/ / dang po la gsum ste/ bsrung bya dam tshig gi rang bzhin/ dam tshig dang sdom pa'i khyad par/ bslab gsum mi 'gal bar 'dus tshul lo/ / dang po la lnga ste/ nges tshigadabye ba/ phan yon/ nyes dmigs/ gso thabs so/ / dang po ni/ sa ma ya zhes pa'i sgra las dam tshig tu bshad de/ de la gsum las/ bsrungs na phan yon 'thob pas dam tshig tu gzhag pa ni/ rdo rje las/ dam pa rnams kyi dgongs pa la/ / dbang dang byin rlabs thob pa yis/ / dam pa'i tshul bzhi nges spyad na/ / mi mthun phyogs rnams tshig par 'gyur/ / zhes so/ / nyams na nyes dmigs 'thob pas kyang de skad ces bya ste/ yang de nyid las/ dam pa rnams kyi bka' bcag cing*/ / byin rlabs dmod bor rang bzhin grub/ / dam pa 'di las gang 'das pa/ / rdo rje can yang tshig par 'gyur/ / zhes so/ / thun mong dam bca'i tshul gyis kyang de skad ces bya ste/ ye shes dam pa las/ rgyal pa'i gsang chen rmad kyi chos/ / ma nyams dam du 'dzin pa'i phyir/ / bla mas ji skad bstan pa bzhin/ / dam bcas tshig ni brtan 'dzin pa/ / dam tshig ces su bshad pa yin/ / zhes so/ / mdor na spang bya spong zhing bsgrub bya sgrub par dam bcas pa las mi nyams par byed pa'i sgo gsum gyi brtson pa'i rang bzhin dge ba cha dang bcas pa la de skad ces bya'o/ / gnyis pa dbye ba la gsum ste/ ngo bo'i dbye ba/ yan lag gi dbye ba/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbye ba'o/ / dang po la gnyis te/ ngo bo dngos dang*/ de'i dbye ba'o/ / dang po ni/ rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig gnyis te/ de'ang ljon shing gi rtsa ba ltar bsrungs shing bskyed na yon tan gyi 'byung gnas yin zhing ma bsrungs na mi 'byung bas rtsa ba'i dam tshig ces bya la/ de bsrung ba'i thabs dang grogs su gyur pa'i phyir yan lag gi dam tshig ces bya'o/ / gnyis pa de'i dbye ba la bco lnga ste/ rtsa ba'i lnga dang*/ yan lag gi bcu'o/

/ rtsa ba lnga ni/ bla med mi spang ba/ bla ma bkur ba/ sngags dang phyag rgya rgyun mi gcad pa/ yang dag pa'i lam du zhugs pa la byams pa/ gsang ba'i don gzhan du mi bsgrag pa'o/ / dang po ni/ dkon cog gsum nam yang mi spong ba'o/ / dbye na gzhi sems can thams cad ye nas dkon cog gsum du gnas pas mi spang ba dang*/ lam bskyed rdzogs gnyis su med pa'i rang bzhin don dam pa dang kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems gnyis mi spang pa dang*/ 'bras bu bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas sku gsum/ de'i gsung mdo rgyud lung dang rtog pa'i chos/ de'i don la slob pa'i dge 'dun dkon cog gsum mi spong pa'o/ / de'ang sems can gyi sems nyid ye nas dag pa'i sangs rgyas su bshad de/ sems nyid rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas pas/ / sangs rgyas gzhan du ma 'tshol cig/ ces so/ / de'i ye ge 'khor lo las byung ba'i ngag kyang chos su bshad de/ rdo rje las/ ā li kā li las byung ba'i/ / 'gro ba'i sgra skad dam pa'i chos/ / zhes so/ / bsod nams dang dge ba bsgrub pa'i zhing du gyur pas dge 'dun du'ang bshad de/ legs par grub pa las/ sbyin sogs bsod nams rnam 'phel zhing*/ / de dge'ang bsgrub par rigs yod phyir/ / rnam pa gnyis kyis chos 'grub pas/ / ma lus 'gro kun dge 'dun nyid/ / ces so/ / yang kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i ngo bo sems nyid rang bzhin gyis dag pa'i sangs rgyas/ bden pa gnyis dang bskyed rdzogs chos/ nyams su len pa po dge 'dun te ye shes drwa ba las/ bden don bden pa'i rang bzhin de nyid 'dzin*/ / rnal 'byor ba de dkon mchog gsum dngos nyid/ / ces so/ / 'bras bu'i gsum yang rgyud bla ma las/ ston pa bstan pa slob don gyis/ / skyabs gsum rnam par gzhag pa yin/ / zhes so/ / kha cig bla med mi spang ba phyogs re kho nar 'chad pa ni mi 'thad de/ dkon mchog gi rang bzhin ma shes pa'i phyir ro/ / bla ma bkur la 'ang gnyis te/

dbye ba dang*/ bkur thabs so/ / dang po la lnga ste/ 'dren pa'i bla ma ni chos kyi sgor 'dren pa rab byung gi mkhan po lta bu ste/ 'dul ba las/ mkhan po mthong ma thag tu stan las ldang bar bya'o/ / zhes pa dang*/ kā ri kā las/ bla ma gnas pa'i sgo glegs la/ / lag pas dal gyis brdung bar bya/ / nang zhugs gus pas bla ma la/ / khams bde mi bde la sogs dri/ / zhes so/ / shes rgyud 'grol ba'i bla ma ni chos 'chad pa'i slob dpon lta bu ste/ mdo sde thar ba chen po las/ chos smra ba'i dge slong la gus pas bla mar bya ste/ zhes pa dang*/ dkon brtsegs las/ chos smra ba ni bla ma'i mchog rab ste/ / rgyal ba'i mchod sdong chen po de bkur ro/ / zhes so/ / man ngag ston c-ing lung 'bogs pa'i bla ma ni sems bskyed pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen lta bu ste/ sdong po bkod pa las/ de ni bdag gis thog ma med pa nas sems bskyed pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen yin te/ zhes so/ / nyams chags skong ba'i slob dpon ni sdig pa bshags pa'i yul du gyur pa ste/ su si ti ka ra'i rgyud las/ bshags pa'i yul du gang gyur pa/ / de yang de yi bla ma yin/ / zhes so/ / dam tshig dbang gi bla ma ni/ rgya mtsho las/ dbang bskur mchog thob rdo rje yi/ / bla ma la ni de bzhin gshegs*/ / zhes so/ / de dag gi steng du kun gyis dam par bkur zhing*/ bka' drin cung zad thob pa'i spyi'i bla ma dang drug tu 'ang bshad de/ gsal bkra las/ spyi dang 'dren dang dam tshig dang*/ / chags nyams skong dang shes rgyud 'grol/ / man ngag lung gi slob dpon rnams/ / zhes so/ / gnyis pa bkur thabs ni thun mong gi bla ma rnams bsod nams dang mchod pa'i zhing la sogs pa dam pa'i yul du blta bas bdag nyid nad pa/ gdams pa sman/ nyams su len pa de rgyud la bsten pa/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen sman pa mkhas pa'i tshul gyis bsten te/ sdong po bkod pa las/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyis bdag nyid la nad pa'i 'du shes dang*/
