chos la sman dang*/ nyams su len pa la nad nye bar 'tsho ba dang*/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen la sman pa mkhas pa'i 'du shes rab tu bskyed par bya'o/ / zhes pa'i tshul gyis so/ / khyad par du gsang sngags rdo rje'i slob dpon la tshul gsum gyis bkur te/ de'ang dkon cog bzhi par gsungs pa ni/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang*/ / slob dpon yang ni bzhi pa yin/ / zhes so/ / sangs rgyas dang mnyam par yang rnam snang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba las/ sangs rgyas kun dang bla ma mnyam/ / zhes so/ / lhag par yang thugs kyi rgyud dpal gsang ba 'dus pa las/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad pas/ / bla ma'i ba spu khung gcig mchog/ ces pa'i tshul gyis ji ltar mnyes pa'i rim pas bkur bar bya'o/ / sngags dang phyag rgya rgyun mi gcad pa la'ang gnyis las/ sngags ni lha so so'i dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs kyi rim pa ste lha'i de kho na nyid la sogs pa lngas bzlas pa dang*/ phyag rgya ni dngos grub bsgrub pa'i grogs kyi yan lag ste/ bsam pa chos kyi phyag rgya/ brjod pa dam tshig gi phyag rgya/ bsgyur pa las kyi phyag rgya/ lha'i sku phyag rgya chen po'o/ / rgyun mi gcad pa rab chu bo'i rgyun lta bu/ 'bring nyin mtshan gyi thun la gnas pa/ tha ma'ang nya stong brgyad la sogs pa zla ba dang lo'i dus su ma chags par byed pa ste/ rngam klog las/ rab gyis chu bo'i rgyun bzhin nam/ / nyin gsum mtshan gsum nyin mtshan du/ / ma yengs pa yi ngang gis bzla/ / 'bring gis zla gcig dus drug dang*/ / dus bzhi bar du mi gcad cing*/ / tha mar brtson pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ / zla re'am ra ba'i dus dag tu/ / brtson par 'bad de mi byed pa/ / byang chub sa bon brlag pa yin/ / tshogs dang gtor ma'ang de bzhin te/ / tha mas lo zla mi 'da' 'o/ / zhes so/ / yang dag pa'i lam du zhugs pa la byams pa ni mched la brtse gdung bya ba ste/ spyir mched lcam rnam pa drug ste/

sems can thams cad ye gdod ma nas bdag gi spun yin pa'i phyir spyi'i mched do/ / sangs rgyas kyi chos la zhugs so cog ni bstan pa gcig pa'i mched do/ / lta spyod gcig pa ni mthun pa'i mched do/ / bla ma gcig pa ni mdzes pa'i mched do/ / chos lhan cig tu nyan pa ni nye ba'i mched do/ / dbang lhan cig tu zhus pa ni 'dres pa'i mched de rdo rje'i spun no/ / 'dir ni spyir thar ba'i lam dang theg pa chen por zhugs pa la brtse ba ste/ dpal 'phreng gi mdo las/ byang chub sems brtan theg chen zhugs la byams/ / zhes so/ / khyad par du rdo rje'i spun la brtse gdung bya ba ste/ rngam glog las/ rdo rje'i spun la gdung sems kyang*/ / 'dres dang ma 'dres yongs kyi spun/ / yang dag lam du zhugs pa la/ / rngan dang bcas kyi sems tsam yang*/ / rtag tu spang bar bya ba yin/ / brtse zhing gdung ba'i shugs phyung la/ / gcig la gcig ni mig bzhin blta mdor na srog la'ang mi chags par/ / spun dang ming srang dgos pa sgrub/ / ci phyir rdo rje spun rnams ni/ / 'di nas byang chub bar dag tu/ / mi 'bral 'grogs pa'i grogs mchog ste/ / me mar 'od dang sdong bu 'dra'o/ / zhes so/ / gsang ba mi bsgrags pa'i dam tshig kyang gsang sngags kyi lta sgom spyod 'bras zab mo rnams snod ma yin pa'i 'gro ba la shin tu gsang ba ste/ phra rgyas las/ spyi dang bar gsang bzhi bzhi dang*/ / 'os dang gnyer gtad rnam pa bcu/ / lta zab spyod pa brlang po dang*/ / lha'i ming gzungs dang grub rtags rnams/ / spyir gsang rnam pa bzhir bshad do/ / sgrub pa'i gnas dus grogs dang rdzas/ / bar du gsang nas bsgrub par bya/ / gsang bar 'os pa'i dam tshig ni/ / phud dang gtor ma tshogs dag dang*/ / bandha phur pa mar me'i snod/ / rdzas dang lag cha dkyil 'khor rnams/ / skye bos mthong bar yongs mi bya/ / dril bu rnge'u chung la sogs sgra/ / skye bos thos par yongs mi brdung*/

/ grogs kyi skyon dang mtshang rnams dang*/ / sems can kun gyi ngan spyod rnams/ / kun la gnod pa'i spyod pa rnams/ / shin tu gsang na byang chub rgyu/ / gnyer gtad pa ni gdams pa ste/ / sngar bshad slob dpon mched kyis so/ / zhes so/ / de'ang lta ba zab mo/ spyod pa brlang po/ lha'i ming gzungs/ grub pa'i rtags te spyir gsang bzhi/ sgrub pa'i gnas dus/ grogs/ rdzas te bar gsang bzhi/ phud dang gtor ma la sogs pa mthong du mi rung ba'i dam rdzas rnams gsang bar 'os pa/ bla ma dang mched lcam gyis 'di ltar gyis shig la sogs pa gnyer du gtad pa ste bcu po 'di dag gang la gsang na/ de nyid las/ dam nyams dam las log pa dang*/ / dam med dkyil 'khor ma mthong dang*/ / 'dres dang ma 'dres thams cad la*/ / zhes pa dang*/ rngam glog las/ snod ma yin pa'i gang zag la/ / dus dang gnas skabs kun tu gsang*/ / snod dang ldan pa rnams la yang*/ / dbang ma thob par bshad pa min/ / zhes so/ / ji ltar gsang na de las/ sems kyi bstan par mi bsam zhing*/ / lus kyis thams cad sbas la spyad/ / ngag gis rdo rje'i lce yod kyang*/ / brjod par bya ba ma yin no/ / zhes so/ / de ltar rtsa ba'i dam tshig gi lha mi spang ba dang*/ dngos grub kyi 'byung gnas bla ma bkur ba dang*/ sngags dang phyag rgya rgyun mi gcad pa ni yon tan khyad par can bsgrub pa'i dam tshig yin la/ de'i yan lag tu yang dag pa'i lam du zhugs pa dang*/ mched lcam la gus pa ni bla ma'i thugs dang 'gal ba bsrung zhing*/ gsang ba gzhan la mi smra ba ni lha dang sngags dang phyag rgya'i de nyid dang 'gal ba bsrung ba yin no/ kha cig lha dang sngags phyag rgya gnyis sgrub pa/ de dag gi thugs dang 'gal ba bsrung ba'i phyir bla ma dang mched la gus pa/ gsang ba mi smra ba gsum srung ba'o zhes pa ni ma yin te/ mnyam sbyor las/ sgrub pa'i dam tshig chen po ni/ / lha dang bla ma mi spang zhing*/ / sngags dang phyag rgya rgyun mi gcad/

/ ces pa ste/ dngos grub bsgrub pa'i rtsa ba bla ma yin la/ de mnyes na dngos grub 'byung ba de las/ mchod pa thams cad yongs spangs la/ / bla ma mchod pa yang dag brtsam/ /de mnyes pa las kun mkhyen gyi/ /yon tan mchog ni ma lus 'byung*/ / zhes pa dang*/ rdo rje las/ dkyil 'khor dbang phyug bla ma nyid/ / ces pas lha'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo bla mar gsungs pa'i phyir te/ de mnyes pa 'ba' zhig bsgrub dgos pas/ sgrub pa'i dam tshig kho nar bshad pa'i lung dang 'gal lo/ / de ltar lnga po yang sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin gsum gsum las ma 'das pas/ sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshigs gsum du gnas te/ dper na bla med mi spang ba'ang lus kyis bkur zhing*/ ngag gis bstod la/ sems kyis gus par bya ba dang*/ bla ma'ang tshul de dang mched la'ang sgo gsum gus pa dang*/ sngags dang phyag rgya'i dam tshig la'ang sgo gsum tshang ba dang*/ gsang ba yang sgo gsum gyi bya bas gsang zhing sbed pa'o/ / kha cig bla ma dang mched lcam la gus pa ni gzhi ma lus kyi bya ba yin pas sku'i dam tshig lha mi spang zhing sngags dang phyag rgya rgyun mi gcad pa ni bzlas brjod kyi yan lag ste gsung gi dam tshigagasang ba mi smra ba ni yid la brnag par bya ba yin pas thugs kyi dam tshig go zer ba de yang rigs par ma mthong ste/ 'don pa bsgyur na mtshungs pa'i phyir ro/ / gnyis pa yan lag gi dam tshig bcu la/ mi spang ba lnga dang*/ dang du blang ba lnga'o/ / dang po ni/ nyon mongs pa lnga ste/ de'ang rang bzhin shes pas mi spang ba/ thabs kyis zin na lam gyi grogs yin pas mi spang ba/ sku dang ye shes yin pas mi spang ba'o/ / dang po la gnyis las/ sangs rgyas kyi rigs sam gdung yin pas mi spang ba ni/ mdo las/ rmongs pa'i sems kyi de bzhin nyid ni rdo rje sems dpa'i de bzhin nyid do/ / rdo rje sems dpa'i de bzhin nyid ni de kho na nyid do/ / zhes pa dang*/

dri ma med par grags pa las kyang*/ nyon mongs pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdung ngo*/ / zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs so/ / rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa yin pas spang blang med pa'i phyir mi spang ba la'ang kun rdzob tu nyon mongs pa smig rgyu dang 'dra ste/ skad cig gis mi rtag pas rang gis rang spangs shing*/ de'ang snang la nges gzung gi dngos po dang ngo bo bden pa'i chos su ma grub pa'i phyir spang byar med de/ rdo rje las/ nyon mongs rnams ni sgyu 'dra ngo bos stong*/ / rang gis mi rtag rang bzhin shes pas grol/ / zhes so/ / don dam par gang gi dngos por yang ma grub cing kun tu btsal na mi rnyed pas kyang spang du med de/

phyir mi ldog pa 'khor lo'i mdo las/ ma rig nam mkha' ji bzhin te/ / chos rnams thams cad mtshan nyid med/ / 'dod chags med kyang zhe sdang med/ / nga rgyal dang ni phrag dog kun/ / sgyu 'dra ngo bo nyid med de/ / yod med mi dmigs rten dang bral/ / zhes pa dang*/ spyod 'jug las/ nyon mongs rnams ni yul na mi gnas phyogs na mi gnas dbang sogs la min de dag bar na'ang min/ / zhes pa dang*/ ye nas stong pa'i dngos 'di la/ / thob pa ci yod shor ci yod/ / mi dgar ci yod dgar ci yod/ / thams cad nam mkha' 'dra bar ni/ / bdag 'dras yongs su gzung bar gyis/ / zhes so/ / gnyis pa thabs kyis zin na lam gyi grogs yin pas mi spang pa ni/ nyon mongs pa lnga ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin yin la/ de nyid man ngag gis nyams su blangs pas nye lam du 'gyur te/ rgya mtsho las/ nyon mongs lam ni dag pa che/ / thabs kyi 'dod yon rgyan gyi mchog/ thams cad thams cad rol pa yis/ / myur du he ru ka dpal 'gyur/ / zhes so/ / tshul 'di mdo sde las kyang gsungs te/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ ji ltar grong khyer rnams kyi mi gtsang lud/ / de ni bu ram shing pa'i zhing la phan/ / de bzhin byang chub sems dpa'i nyon mongs lud/ / de ni rgyal ba'i chos kyi zhing la phan/ / zhes pa dang*/ theg bsdus las/ thabs chen rnams dang ldan pa la/ / nyon mongs byang chub yan lag 'gyur/ / zhes gsungs so/ / gzhan yang spangs bya nyon mongs pa med na spongs byed gnyen po mi 'byung bas kyang spong bar mi rigs pa dang*/ nyon mongs pa'i chos can yod na de rang gis ngo bos stong pa'i chos nyid yod pas kyang chos nyid mngon du bya ba'i phyir mi spang ba dang*/ nyon mongs pa la brten nas sems can gyi don 'grub pa'i yan lag tu 'gyur bas kyang mi spang ba yin no/ / 'o na nyon mongs pa ma spangs na yon tan mi skye zhing sangs rgyas mi 'thob bo zhe na/ lam dang 'bras bu'i yon tan ni nyon mongs pa'i rgyu kho na las 'thob ste/

ye shes yin zhing de goms par byas pa'i phyir ro/ / ngan 'gro la sogs par brgyud cing 'ching ba ma yin nam zhe na/ nyon mongs pa'i rang bzhin shes nas goms na de'i nyes pas mi gos shing bde 'gro'i lus dang 'bras bu 'dzin pa kho na'o/ / kha cig na re nyon mongs pa lam du byed pa na thabs kyis zin dgos sam mi dgos/ dgos na nyon mongs pa lam du byas pa ma yin te/ thabs lam du byas pa'i phyir/ mi dgos na tha mal pa dang khyad med par thal lo zhe na/ bshad pa/ nas la zan byed par 'dod mod/ rngo ba dang btags par byas na nas kyis zan du'ang mi 'gyur te/ phye'i zan yin pa'i phyir dang*/ ma byas na zan du'ang mi 'grub po zhes pa 'di la lan ci yod/ de'ang rgyu nas la rkyen rngo ba dang btags pas zan du 'gyur ro zhe na/ 'dir yang rgyu nyon mongs pa la rkyen thabs kyis lam du byed pa kho na'o/ / 'di ltar nyon mongs pa'i dngos po gcig la nyan rang gi spang byar mthong ba dang byang chub sems dpas spyad byar mthong ba dang*/ gsang sngags thun mong bas dag byar mthong ba dang*/ thun mong ma yin pas blang byar mthong ba ni dper na gser las byas ba'i rang bzhin gcig la/ chol zangs su byas pa'i tshe btsog pa dang*/ gzhong par byas pa'i tshe gtsang ba dang*/ gdu bur byas pa'i tshe rgyan dang*/ lha'i sku gzugs su byas pa'i tshe mchod pa'i rten du byed pa bzhin du/ rkyen gyis theg pa so sos de ltar mthong yang ngo bo ye nas dag pa'i ye shes yin pas/ gzhi lam 'bras bu'i chos su nyon mongs pa de nyid 'gyur ba'i spang bar bya ba ma yin pa'i rgyu mtshan 'thad pa dang bcas pa'o/ / gsum pa sku dang ye shes yin pas mi spang ba ni/ dam tshig nyer brgyad pa las/ phrag dog la sogs nyon mongs lnga rnams ni/ / ye nas rigs lnga'i rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir/ / zhes pas/ gti mug chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs te rnam par snang mdzad kyi dam tshig go

/ zhe sdang me long lta bu'i ye shes rdo rje'i rigs te mi bskyod pa'i dam tshig go / nga rgyal mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes rin po che'i rigs te rin cen 'byung ldan gyi dam tshig go 'dod chags so sor rtog pa'i ye shes padma'i rigs te snang ba mtha' yas kyi dam tshig go / phrag dog bya ba grub pa'i ye shes las kyi rigs te don yod grub pa'i dam tshig go/ des na 'gro ba'i sems so cog tu 'char ba nyon mongs pa lngar snang dus nas sku dang ye shes su grub pa'i phyir mi spangs bar gdams so/ / gnyis pa dang du blang pa'i dam tshig lnga ni bdud rtsi lnga ste/ de'ang ye nas blang dor med pa'i chos nyid kyi rol pa yin pas kyang dang du blang ste/ le lag las/ bdud rtsi ye nas dag pa'i chos*/ / blang dor med pa kun las 'das/ / ye bsrung chen po'i dam tshig tu// mkhas pas dang du blang bar bya/ / zhes so/ / rigs lnga'i rang bzhin yin pas kyang dang du blang dgos te/ thal ba las/ bdud rtsi lnga ni rigs lnga'i dngos/ / dri chen dri chu byang chub sems*/ / zhes so/ / dngos grub sgrub pa'i rdzas yin pas kyang dang du blang ste/ gsang 'dus las/ sha chen dam tshig chen po ni/ / rdo rje gsum mchog 'grub par 'gyur/ / zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs so/ / yang bdud rtsi lnga dang sha lnga brten na mkha' 'gro 'du zhing dngos grub nye bas kyang dang du blang ste/ mdo las/ ba lang khyi dang rta sha dang*/ / mi sha glang chen sha la sogs/ / zos na yon tan thams cad 'grub/ / bdag cag rnams kyi dam tshig lags/ / zhes pa dang*/ sngon gyi rgyal ba grangs med kyis/ / brtul zhugs 'di lnga gtsor spyad na/ / dam tshig dam par gzung bas na/ / sngon gyi dam tshig yin par grags/ / zhes pas brtul zhugs spyod pa'i grogs su gyur pas kyang dang du blang bar bya ba yin no/ / gnyis pa yan lag gi dbye ba ni sum brgya drug cu ste/ de'ang dam tshig thams cad ni lha'i rang bzhin yin la/

lha thams cad kyi rtsa ba ni thabs dang shes rab yin pas rtsa ba'i bla med mi spang la sogs pa lnga po'i gang rung gcig la'ang rtsa ba thabs dang shes rab/ de gnyis la sku gsung thugs su phye bas drugade dag la'ang sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las lnga lnga ste sum cu/ rtsa ba'i thabs shes gnyis bsnan pas sum cu rtsa gnyis so/ / de ltar lnga ga las phye bas brgya drug cu'o/ / yan lag gi dam tshig nyis brgya ni yan lag gi bcu'i 'dod chags mi spang ba lta bu gcig la'ang thabs dang shes rab gnyis las/ thabs la ye shes lnga dang yul lnga ste bcu/ shes rab la'ang ye shes lnga dang yul lnga ste bcu phrag gnyis la nyi shu'o/ / de ltar nyi shu tshan pa bcu la nyis brgya'o/ / rong pa ni yan lag gi dam tshig ni yan lag nas dbye bar bya ste/ gcig la'ang sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi yan lag rnam pa lnga dang*/ sku gsung thugs kyi dngos gzhi gsum yang de nyid du zhig ste yan lag gi gzhi med/ rtsa ba thabs dang shes rab gnyis kyang thabs shes rab dang ldan/ shes rab thabs dang ldan pas rtsa ba gnyis po zhig ste yan lag bzhir 'gyur bas/ de yang sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las lnga'i cha shas su 'gyur bas na*/ rtsa ba'i 'phro gzhi med de yan lag dang cha shas nyi shu nyi shur 'gyur ro zhes dkon cog 'grel du bzhed do/ / dam tshig 'di dag ni yon tan gyi cha shas dbye ba yin gyi/ mtshan nyid tha dad pa'i rnam grangs ni so sor bshad pa med ces gsungs so/ / gsum pa bsam gyis mi khyab par dbye ba ni sems can gyi rtog tshogs ji snyed pa'i gnyen por dam tshig gi dbye ba'ang de snyed yin pas grangs 'di kho na'o zhes gcig tu chad pa med de/ gsal bkra las/ dam tshig rnam pa'i grangs dag ni/ / sems can grangs dang log rtog grangs/ / rtog 'dul gnyen por dam tshig grangs/ / rgyal pa nyid kyis brjod las 'das/ / zhes so/ / gsum pa dam tshig bsrung ba'i phan yon ni/

gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi don thams cad 'grub pa ste/ dam tshig gsum bkod las/ gsang sngags rdo rje'i dam la gnas/ / de yis smon pa kun 'grub cing*/ / lha rnams kyis kyang rtag tu bsrung*/ / rgyal ba rgyal mchog sras bcas kyis/ / bu bzhin dgongs pa dam pa mdzad/ / ting 'dzin yon tan dpag yas shing*/ / kun bzang rigs kyi dam pa 'grub/ / ces so/ / bzhi pa ma bsrungs pa'i nyes dmigs ni/ rang nyid kyi legs pa las nyams shing gzhan la nyes pa ngang gis sbyin pa ste/ de las/ dam tshig las ni 'das gyur na/ / 'di phyir bde legs nyams pa dang*/ / yid du mi 'ong sna tshogs myong*/ / sa spyod me yi sdug bsngal la/ / bskal pa bye ba grangs med gnas/ / zhes pa dang*/ kun 'dus las/ ji ltar 'o ma rul ba dag/ rul pas 'o ma kun rul ltar/ / rnal 'byor nyams gyur gcig gis ni/ / rnal 'byor can kun ma rungs byed/ / ces so/ / lnga pa gso thabs ni/ de'ang nyan thos ltar ma yin gyi/ gsang sngags ni gso rung ba'i thabs yod de/ rngam glog las/ dam tshig nyams par gyur pa na/ / mgon btsun mnyamapa'i don rtogs na/ / de nyid bskong ba'i gnas su 'gyur/ / bla ma spun la smad gyur na/ / tshe 'di nyid la mnyes byas te/ / mthol bshags drag pos 'gyod byas na/ / de ni bskong ba'i mchog tu 'gyur/ / gal te bdag gam bla ma spun/ / ma bskang bar du tshe 'phos na/ / de ni bskang ba'i tshad las 'das*/ /gsung gi tha tshig ral gyur na/ / rdo rje chos su bdag bsgom ste/ / tha tshig gang brlag 'bum 'bum 'don/ / thugs kyi tha tshig ral gyur na/ / rdo rje sems dpar bdag bsgom la/ / lo gsum bar du mi smra bar/ / bsam gtan sbyor ba rab tu bya/ / yan lag tha tshig ral gyur na/ / so so rang rang rigs kyis bskang*/ / zhes pas sku gsung thugs kyi nyams chags kyi gtso bo sgo gsum dang sbyar la brtson pas bskang bshags byas na dag par 'gyur ro/ / 'di ni thabs kyi dam pa ste 'og ma dag las 'phags so/

/ de'ang nyan thos kyi sdom khrims ni 'chab sems ma skyes na lan bdun gso bar snang zhing skyes na lan gcig la'ang gsor mi rung bas rdza be'u chag pa dang 'dra'o/ / byang chub sems dpa' ni rin po che snod chag pa dang 'dra ste dge ba'i bshes gnyen la brten nas nyams pa gso bar rung ste*/ mgar ba mkhas pas snga ma las lhag pa'i snod byar rung ba bzhin no/ / gsang sngags ni rin po che'i snod zhom pa dang 'dra ste rang gi stobs kyis gsor rung bas na/ mgar ba mi dgos par rang gi rtsol bas zhom pa bsrang du yod pa dang 'dra'o/ / gnyis pa dam tshig dang sdom pa'i khyad par ni/ de'ang rang gi rgyud sdom pa'i cha nas pa'ang yin la/ sangs rgyas kyi gsang ba'i rdo rje gsum 'dzin zhing mi nyams par byed pas dam tshig kyang yin te/ bum pa gcig nyid byas pa'ang yin la mi rtag pa'ang yin pa bzhin no/ / des na ngo bo gcig la ldog pa tha dad de/ phra rgyas las/ de ltar sum brgya drug cu rnams/ / bdag gi rdo rje mchog gsum pos/ / log par mi ltung sdom pa'i dngos/ / sa gzhi lta bur gsungs pa yin/ / zhes pa dang*/ rngam glog las/ chos kun ye nas dag pa'i phyir/ / log rtog ye nas rnam par dag/ de bas sdom pa rnam par dag/ dam tshig 'di ni rmad po che/ / zhes so/ / de'ang sdom pa'i ngos nas gzhal na gsum ste/ so so thar pa/ byang chub sems dpa'/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom pa ste/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ so so thar dang byang chub sems/ / rig 'dzin sngags kyi sdom pa'o/ / zhes pa dang*/ rngam glog las/ dge slong byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ / rnal 'byor rnal 'byor chen po yin/ / zhes so/ / de'ang so so thar ba'i sdom pa ni rang nyid gcig pu zhi bde 'dod pas ji srid 'tsho'i bar du rigs bdun gang yang rung ba bsrung zhing*/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa gnyis don du sdom pa'i tshul khrims kyis rgyud sdoms/ dge ba chos sdud kyis rtogs pa dang yon tan khyad par can rnams bsgrub/

sems can don byed kyisagazhan la phan 'dogs pa'o/ / rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom pas gzhan don rlabs po che sgrub cing nyon mongs ye shes su bsgyur ba ste/ kun 'dus las/ de ltar sdom pa gsum po yang*/ / rang dang gzhan don phan pa che/ / zhes so/ / dam tshig ni rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin nyams pa med par bsrungs bas gzhan la phan pa 'ba' zhig lhur len pa yin no/ / gsum pa bslab gsum mi 'gal bar 'dus tshul bstan pa la gnyis te/ mi 'gal ba dang*/ 'dus tshul lo/ / dang po ni/ 'di ltar nyan thos kyi phas pham pa bzhi bsrung bya'i rtsa ba dang*/ de'i yan lag chang mi 'thung ba la sogs pa yin zhing*/ byang chub sems dpa'i sems can la 'tshe ba cha dang bcas pa las ldog pa ltar snang bas sdom pa gsum tshang ba dang 'gal lo snyam na/ mi 'gal bar ston pa la gnyis las/ dang po nyan thos kyi so so thar ba'i sdom pa dang mi 'gal ba'i tshul ni/ de'ang srog gcod pa'i pham par gyur ba la/ gzhi mi yin pa bsam pa de nyid las gzhan du ma 'khrul bar zhe sdang rang ga mas gsod par rtsam pa/ dngos gzhi mtshon la sogs pas srog gi dbang po 'gag pa/ rjes yi rang ba ste chos bzhi tshang dgos pa la/ 'dir sgrol ba'i skabs su rnam pa hūm̐ du gsal zhing ngo bo ma skyes pa yin pas mi dang mi las gzhan dud 'gro la sogs pa'i 'gro ba phal ma yin pas gzhi'i yan lag ma tshang ngo*/ / de'i sdug bsngal dang bral 'dod kyi snying rje yod kyi gsod sems rang ga ma med pas bsam pa'i yan lag kyang ma tshang ngo*/ / gsad bya dang gsod byed du 'dzin pa med pas srog kyang med cing de gcad pa'ang med pas dngos gzhi'i yan lag kyang ma tshang ngo*/ / rjes zhe sdang gis kun nas bslang ba'i yi rang med pas yongs su rdzogs pa'i yan lag kyang ma tshang bas nyes pa gang yang med do/ / de bzhin du ma byin par len pa'i tshe'ang gzhi mis bdag tu bzung ba'i rdzas dgos pa la/ 'dir bdag gzhan gnyis su med pa'i don rtogs pas rang snang gi rdzas rmi lam lta bu len pa'i phyir dang*/

bsam pa rku ba'i sems dgos pa las/ 'dir rang sems kyi snang ba tsam la rang snang rol gyis brku sems med pa dang*/ dngos gzhi rin thang tshang ba spos te bdag gir byed pa las/ de yang ma tshang ste sgyu ma dang rmi lam ltar gnyis su med pas spros pa med pa dang*/ rjes thob blo dgos pa las/ thob bya dang thob byed du zhen pa med pa'i phyir ro/ / mi tshangs par spyod pa'i pham par gyur pa la yang*/ gzhi mi'i bud med la sogs pa dgos pa las/ 'di lhar bskyed pa dang*/ dngos po zag byed du nor bu bcug nas pags rim 'das pa dgos pa las/ rdo rje dang padmar gsal bas de gnyis rang mtshan pa ma tshang ba dang*/

bsam pa ma 'khrul bas bde ba myong bar 'dod pa yang*/ dkyil 'khor gsum du shes pas bsam pa'i yan lag ma tshang ba'i phyir nyes pa med de/ brdzun du smra ba yang pha rol po'i 'gro ba la 'du shes gzhan du bsgyur bas lha la sogs pa ma mthong bzhin du mthong ngo zhes pa la sogs pa dgos pa las/ chos thams cad rdzun mnyam du shes nas gzhan la phan pa'i yan lag tu smras pa'i phyir na nyes pa med do/ / de bzhin du chang btung ba'ang bdud rtsir bsgyur ba'i phyir na longs spyod du mi rung bar bshad pa dang mi 'gal lo/ / de thams cad kyi skabs su bdag nyid dge slong yin pa/ yul ma 'khrul ba/ 'du shes gzhan du ma gyur pa rnams dgos pa las/ 'dir lha'i dkyil 'khor du gnas gyur pa'i phyir nyan thos kyi so so thar pa'i sdom pa dang 'gal ba med do/ / gnyis pa byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa dang yang 'gal ba med de/ gzhan la phan 'dod kyi snying rje dang thabs khyad par can gyis zin pa'i phyir ro/ / de gnyis dang ldan pa ni sems dpa' rnams la'ang gnang ba yin te/ phal po che las/ yang dag sems can don 'gyur ba'i/ / thabs de rgyal sras bslab pa'i mchog/ sprin las char chen 'bab pa yis/ / lo tog phun sum tshogs par byed/ / ces so/ / gnyis pa 'dus tshul la'ang gnyis las/ nyan thos kyi tshul ni gtso bor rang don sgrub pa'i sdom pa de yang 'dir rnal 'byor bas rang gi sdug bsngal las thar pa'i phyir rgyud sdom par 'dus te/ srog gcod dus nyid na sems kyi zhe sdang la sogs pa'i mi dge ba med pas rang gi zag pa rang mtshan pa bsdam pa'i phyir srog gcod pa spong pa'i sdom pa'ang bsdus so/ / de bzhin du lhag ma rnams la'ang sbyar te zag pa rang mtshan pa bsdams pas na thabs kyi spyod pa brlang po ltar snang yang ngo bo nyan thos kyi sdom pa 'dus pa kho na'o/ / dper na sman pa kha cig tsha ba'i nad la bsil sman byed pa na/ la las ldog ste bcos pas myur du phan pa gnyis 'gal pa ltar snang yang don la 'gal ba med pa ltar/

lam gyi thabs 'gal bar snang yang*/ don la rang rgyud kyi nyon mongs pa spong zhing dge ba bsgrub par don mthun pa kho na'o/ / gnyis pa byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa'i 'dus tshul ni/ spyod pa gang la spyor ba de'i tshe tha mal gyi nyon mongs rang ga ma'i 'jug pa sdom pas sdom pa'i tshul khṛms so/ /de la brten nas lam gyi yon tan gong du 'phel bas dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims so/ / thabs des gzhan la phan 'dogs shing rjes su 'dzin pas sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims so/ / de bzhin du gsang sngags kyi sdom pa'ang ji snyed thams cad 'dir 'dus te/ rgyud sdom zhing nyon mongs pa dag par tshul mtshungs pa'i phyir ro/ / gnyis pa gzhung gi don la gnyis te/ dam tshig chen po'i ngo bo spyir bstan pa dang*/ sgrub bsrung gi rnam gzhag bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ / dang po la gsum las/ dang po gsang ba'i dam tshig gzhan las 'phags pa'i tshul ni gang zag gang zhig gsang chen bla~X na meda~X pa'i thega~X pa 'dir zhugs te don phyin ci ma log pa~Xr ra~Xb tu ngesa~X pa ste nyams su blangs na~X 'dod chags la sogs pa'i nyona~X monga~Xs pa dug lnga dang des bskyed pa'i la~Xs rnama~Xs kuna~X la spyada~X kyanga~X*/ sgyu ma'i sprul pas spyad pa ltar las de nyid byasa~X par snang la~X de'i sgrib pa dang bag chags mi~X soga~X pa'i steng du bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshoga~Xs gnyis rdzogs par 'gyura~X te~X/ spyod pa de nyid kyi ngo bo la so sor thar ba'i tshula~X khrima~Xs dang byang chub sems dpa'i sdoma~X pa~X dang gsang sngags kyi dam tshig rnams phuna~X suma~X tsho~Xgs pa'i don tshang zhing rdzogs pa'i phyir ro/ / gnyis pa gsang ba'i dam tshig tu 'dul sdom thams cad 'dus par bstan pa ni gsang chen bla~X na me~Xd pa'i mcho~Xg gi~X dma~X tshi~Xg tu~X nyes spyod 'dula~X ba~X'i dba~Xng gi~Xs rnam par bzhag pa'i tshula~X khrima~Xs so so thar ba'i sdom pa dnga~X*/

des mtshon nas byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa dang*/ sngags phyi pa gsum nang pa dang bcas pa ji~X snyeda~X pa'i sdoma~X pa~X bsa~Xm ya~Xs yod pa~X ma~X lusa~X pa'i yon tan kuna~X yar ldan du 'dusa~X shing 'og ma'i skyon gyis phyogs phra mo tsam yang rnama~X pa~Xr da~Xg pa'o/ / gsum pa rtsa ba'i dam tshig chen po'i rnam par bzhag pa la bzhi las/ dang po srog gcad pa ni don dam par chos yo~Xd pa rtag pa'i mtha' dang me~Xd pa chad pa'i mtha' dang mtha' gnyis dang bral ba'i dbu~X ma~X'a~Xng mi~X dm-i~Xgs shi~Xng*/ kun rdzob tu bdag nyid sgyu~X ma~X dang sems can mi~Xg yo~Xr lta~X bu'i~X tshula~X gyis sgrol ba ltar snang yang*/ snang dus de nyid na sems can rang mtshan du ma grub pas sroga~X bden pa ba me~Xd cing sroga~X rang bzhin ma grub pas srog kyanga~X gco~Xd du~X me~Xd de rmi lam bzhin no/ / sroga~X da~Xng srog ldan gyi skyesa~X bura~X snang ba'ang rang sems 'khrul ba'i lo~Xg rtoga~X tsa~Xm las don la gnyis su grub pa med de/ yul 'khor skyong gis zhus pa'i mdo las/ bdag dang gzhan dang srog dang skyes bu rnams/ / med par snang la rang bzhin gnyis su med/ / phyin ci log tsam nyid las gzhan med de/ / yang dag ma yin kun brtags sgyu ma'i tshul/ / zhes pa dang*/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa'i nye ba 'khor gyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ ji ltar sgyu ma mkhan gyi 'jig rten na/ / sems can brgya phrag mang po sprul byas te/ / sprul pa de dag thams cad bsal gyur kyang*/ / sgyu ma de dag gsod pa yod min ltar/ / 'gro ba 'di dag sgyu ma'i rang bzhin te/ / 'di la mtha' ni nam yang dmigs su med/ / gang dag de ltar mtha' yas mos byed pa/ / de dag 'jig rten na ni tshor ba med/ / gang dag rang bzhin med chos 'di shes pa/ / dpa' bo de dag 'jig rten mya ngan 'da'/ / 'dod pa'i yon tan spyod kyang chags med cing*/ / chags pa rnam spangs sems can 'dul bar byed/ / mi dbang rnams ni sems can phan par mdzad/

/ ces gsungs pa bzhin no/ / dgos pa ni nges brjod las/ sangs rgyas bstan la gnod byed dang*/ / bla mar smod brtson ma rungs dang*/ / rtag tu sems can gnod brtson pa/ / mkhas pas bsgrims te gsod par bya/ / zhes pa dang*/ de ltar bsgral pa'i dgos ched kyang*/ / byang chub spyod 'phel sems can bde/ / lha mnyes bdag gi dam skong zhing*/ / las ngan bar chad sdug yun thung*/ / zhes pa dang*/ ya mā ri las kyang*/ e ma ho gsod pa 'di ni bzang*/ / gsod pa gsod pa ma yin te/ / zhes so/ / gnyis pa ma byin par blang pa ni chos thams cad don dam pa dang kun rdzob kyi bde~Xn pa~X gnyisa~X ka~Xr rang bzhin dbyera~X me~Xd pa~Xs don la ma grub cing*/ tha snyad du'ang ma grub ste 'phrula~X dga~X'i lha rnams rang gi sprul pa'i longs spyod la len pa'i tshula~X te~X gzhan du snang ba'i rdzas dang len pa po bdag nyid don la tha~X dada~X mi~Xn pa'i rang bzhin du shes nas/ rang snang gi rdzas la rang snang len pa'i tshul gyis ma byin par len dus de nyid na'ang blang bya'i yul sems can gzha~Xn da~Xng des bdag tu bzung ba'i rdzas rang mtshan pa ma~X byina~X par blang rgyu meda~X pa~X'i phyira~X ma byin par blanga~Xs pa yang me~Xd de/ blang bya'i yul blang rgyu'i rdzas len pa po bdag nyid kyis mtshon pa'i chos thama~Xs ca~Xd ye nas rnam par dag pa nam mkha' lta bu'i de bzhin nyida~X kyi~X dbyi~Xngs yin pa'i phyir ro/ / ji skad du dkon cog brtsegs pa las/ ji ltar sgyu mas sgyu ma'i nor blangs te/ / rmi lam nang bzhin dgos pa de spyad cing*/ / de la las med rnam par smin pa med/ / de bzhin chags med ye shes 'di bslabs te/ / mya ngan 'das pa dam pa mchog zhir 'gro/ / zhes so/ / blang ba'i dgos pa yang phyug po de dag gi tshogs rdzogs la bkren pa dag gi 'dod pa 'grub pa ste/ rdo rje las/ 'jungs pa rnams la nor blangs la/ / sems can bkren la sbyin par bya/ / de phyir mi yi bdag po dang*/

/ phyug po rnams kyi nor 'phrog go / zhes so/ / gsum pa rdzun du smra ba ni gzhan don du 'gyur ba'i dgos pa khyad par can yod na ji ltar phan pa de ltar smras kyang nyes pa med de/ 'di ltar 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chosa~X rnama~Xs kyi rang bzhin sgyu~X ma~X lta~X bu ༵dnga~X rmi lam lta bu la sogs pa yin la/ de dag so so'i minga~X da~Xng tshi~Xg tu~X btaga~Xs pa~X de yang so so'i rtog pas glo bur du btags pa'i phyir brdzuna~X pa nyid de/ yum bar ma las/ rab 'byor chos thams cad n-i rang bzhin gyis dngos po med pa ste/ gang brjod cing snang la btags pa de dag ni glo bur pa yin pa'i phyir brdzun pa'o/ / zhes so/ / de ltar rtogs na gtong bya'i yul brdzuna~X pa nyida~X la~X gtong byed bdag ni~X brdzun pas ngag tu yod med la sogs pa'i brdzuna~X spyoda~X cing gtong ba~X de'i tshe/ gtong dus de nyid nas brdzuna~X zhe~Xs bya ba'i chos su grub grub po ming tsam btaga~Xs pa rtsama~X du'ang yoda~X pa ma~X yi~Xn te/ sgra de nyid phyi nang gang na'ang med pa dang de'i ngo bo grag stong skye med yin pa'i phyir ro/ / de skad du'ang nye ba 'khor gyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ ji ltar 'chang ba bcangs te byis pa la/ / ston zhes ngag tu yod ces brjod byas nas/ / de yis 'chang pa stong pa mthong nas ni/ / byis pa de ni cho nges ngu ba ltar/ / de bzhin sangs rgyas bsam gyis mi khyab par/ / sems can tshul la mkhas shing mkhyen pa rnams/ / chos rnams 'di kun gsog gsob mkhyen gyur nas/ / 'jig rten dag la yod dang med ces ston/ / zhes pa ltar ro/ / dgos pa ni ci'i phyir zhe na/ snga ma las/ sems can rnams la phan spyod pas/ / rtag tu dam tshig bla ma'i nor*/ / sems can srog ni bsrung ba'i phyir/ / brdzun du yang ni smra bar bya/ / zhes so/ / bzhi pa mi tshangs par spyod pa ni/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin gang du'ang ma~X chaga~Xs pa~X dngos po dang mtshan mar grub pa cung zad kyang med pa'i gnas lugs stong pa~X nyid la~X blos de ltar rtogs pa ni cha~Xgs pa~X da~Xng ste shes rab kyi mtha' gnyis la mi gnas pa'i ngang nas yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i ye shes la chaga~Xs pa~X nyida~X na~Xs tha mal gyi 'dod chaga~Xs me~Xd pa~X de~X ni~X thabs snying rje chen po'i rang bzhin te/

tha mal rang gi 'dod chags las mcho~Xg tu gyur pa bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi rgyala~X po~X ste~X tshangs par spyod pa'i dam pa shina~X tu~X rnam par dag pa'i chaga~Xs pa~X che~Xn po~X padma'i rigs sems can la thugs rje 'byung ba'i ngang tshul yi~Xn no/ / ji skad du dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ ji ltar rmi lam sgyu ma'i rang bzhin du/ / skyes bu 'dod bsten de yang de 'dra ste/ / ngo bo nyid kyis stong la dngos po med/ / las med rnam par smin pa de yod min/ / zhes so/ / dgos pa ni/ snga ma las/ / sangs rgyas rnams ni mnyes bya dang*/ / dam tshig rnams ni bsrung ba dang*/ / gsang sngags rig pas bsgrub pa'i phyir/ / gzhan gyi bud med bsten par bya/ / zhes so/ / gnyis pa sgrub bsrung gi rnam gzhag bye brag tu bshad pa la bzhi ste/ ngo bo nges tshig dang bcas pa/ phan yon nyes dmigs dang bcas pa/ rang bzhin dbye ba dang bcas pa/ / phan yon chen po bshad pa'o/ / dang po la gnyis te/ ngo bo dang nges tshig go/ dang po la'ang gnyis las/ rtsa ba'i dam tshig ni gzhi lam 'bras bu gsum gyi bla~X na meda~X pa'i dkon mchog gsum mi~X spanga~X ba dang po'o/ / chos dang dam tshig gis 'brel ba'i bla ma rnams dang khyad par du gsang sngags rdo rje'i bla~X ma~X bkura~X ba gnyis pa'o/ / de'ang dbang bskur ba rgyud bshad pa gdams pa bstan pa ni gsum ldan te de las gnyan pa'i bla ma med do/ / dbang bskur ba la sogs pa gang rung gnyis ni gnyis ldan te bar ma'o/ / gang rung re re ni gcig ldan te cung zad mi gnyan no/ / bkur ba'i rim pa'ang de bzhin du bya zhing*/ re re'am gnyis ldan lta bu la/ dbang dang bshad pa dang man ngag gsum ni snga snga ma las gnyan no/ / dbang la'ang rim pa gong ma gong ma gnyan pas bla ma yang de bzhin du shes par bya'o/ / dkyil 'khor gang du zhugs pa'i lha rnams kyi rgyu ma nor ba rtsa ba'i snga~Xgs la sogs pa yan lag lnga'i sgo nas bzlas shing dam tshig chos las phyag rgya chen po dnga~X bzhi'i sgo nas lha so so'i phyaga~X rgya~X 'chang ba rnams rgyuna~X mi~X gcoda~X par dus dang brtson pa'i rim pas byed pa ni gsum pa'o/

/ yanga~X da~Xg pa'i lama~X du~X ste theg pa chen por zhuga~Xs pa'i gang zag rnams la~X byama~Xs pa ni bzhi pa'o/ / gab pa dang sbas pa'i lta spyod gsa~Xng ba~X'i do~Xn rnams phyi~X rol snod du ma gyur pa la smra~X bar mi~X bya~X ba ni lnga pa'o/ / don de~X dag rnams ni~X dam tshig gi rtsa~X ba~X lnga~X po rnama~Xs yin te~X/ dang po gsum sgruba~X pa'i dam tshig dnga~X phyi ma gnyis de dag gi thugs dang 'gal ba bsrunga~X ba'i~X dma~X tshi~Xg gi mcho~Xg yin no/ / gnyis pa yan lag gi dam tshig la'ang gnyis las/ mi spang ba'i dam tshig lnga ni gti~X muga~X gang du mi rtog pa dang 'dod chaga~Xs bde ba chen po dnga~X zhe ༵sdanga~X gsal ba chen po da~Xng nga ༵rgyala~X dregs pa chen po dang phra~Xg do~Xg khro bo chen po rnams ni gzhi ye nas dag cing thabs kyis lam du 'gyur pa la 'bras bu sku dang ye shes su 'char ba'i rang bzhin yin pas nam yang mi~X spanga~X ngo~X*/ / dang du blang ba'i dam tshig lnga ni dka~Xr rtsi~X byang chub kyi sems dang dma~Xr rtsi~X padma rakta dang dri~X chen dri chu dang sha~X che~Xn lnga'i dwangs ma rnams ni/ kha cig gis btsog par 'dzin pas de dang mthun pa'i blo spang byar shes pa ni dam rdzas kyis dga~X c-ing dben pa~X'i snoda~X yin pas de nyid du~X mi~X 'do~Xr ro~X/ / 'di la kha cig ye nas dag pa'i snod bcud du gnas pas mi dor zhes pa dang*/ la la dam rdzas dag pa dang de'i snod ka pā la mi dor zhes zer bas ma shes par snang ste gzhung de nyid bklags pas shes so/ / de dag ni rtsa ba'i grogs sam thabs su byung bas na ya~Xn la~Xg rnam pa bcu~X yi~X dma~X tshi~Xg ste~X rang dgar spyad na tha mal pa bzhin 'gyur bas/ ye~X nasa~X da~Xg pa gsum dang mnyama~X pa bzhir gnas pa'i don rtoga~Xs pa~Xs rang bzhin shes par byas la rang rang gi thabs kyis zin pa'i tshul gyis spyada~X par bya'o/ / gnyis pa nges tshig la'ang gnyis las/ rtsa ba'i nges tshig ni bsrunga~X zhi~Xng bsgruba~X pa~X'i dma~X tshi~Xg rnam pa lnga~X ni gsang sngags bsgrub pa'i rtsa~X ba'i dam tshig yi~Xn te~X/

ljon shing gi rtsa ba ltar bsrungs na dngos grub 'byung zhing nyams na theg pa chen po'i riga~Xs te mngon par byang chub pa'i skal ba meda~X par 'gyura~X ro/ / de'ang gnas skabs rgyangs bsṛngs pa tsam la de skad bya yi gtan du rigs sam skal ba med pa ma yin te/ thar pa'i sa bon bskrun pa'i phyir dang*/ rigs chad mi srid pa'i phyir ro/ / rigs zhes pa ni mtshan nyid kyi theg pas thog ma med pa'i chos khams dge ba sa bon gyi tshul tu 'dod de/

snying po bstan pa'i mdo las/ thog ma med pa'i dus kyi dbyings/ / chos rnams kun gyi gnas yin te/ / 'di yod pas na 'gro ba kun/ / mya ngan 'das pa thob par 'gyur/ / zhes so/ / yod lugs gnyis te/ chos nyid dang*/ chos can no/ / de'ang rgyud bla ma las/ gter dang 'bras bu'i shing bzhin du/ / rigs de rnam gnyis shes bya ste/ / thog med rang bzhin gnas pa dang*/ / yang dag blangs pas mchog nyid do/ / zhes so/ / dang po 'di ni sems nyid don gyi kun gzhi ye nas rang bzhin gyis dag cing 'od gsal ba ste/ rgyud bla ma las/ de bzhin yid kyi nang chud rin chen gter/ / dri med bsal dang gzhag med chos nyid kyang*/ / zhes so/ / chos can ni don gyi kun gzhi'i steng na ljon pa'i sa bon ltar sangs rgyas kyi mtshan dpe 'od zer dang bcas pa 'byung rung gi dngos po shin tu phra ba'i rang bzhin du thog ma med pa nas yod pa sbyangs pa las gzugs sku 'byung bar 'dod de/ de nyid las/ ji ltar a smra la sogs shing 'bras la/ / yod pa'i sa bon myu gu 'jig med chos sa rmos chu sogs ldan pas ljon shing gi / rgyal po'i dngos por rim gyis 'grub pa ltar/ / sems can rnams kyi ma rigs sogs 'bras kyi/ / pags sbubs nang chud chos khams dge ba yang*/ / de bzhin dge ba de la de brten nas/ / rim gyis thub pa'i rgyal po'i ngo bor 'gyur/ / zhes so/ / de'ang rigs dang pos chos sku dang*/ gnyis pas gzugs sku bskyed par/ de nyid las/ rigs 'di gnyis las sangs rgyas kyi/ / sku gsum thob par 'dod pa yin/ / dang pos sku ni dang po ste/ / gnyis pa yis ni phyi ma gnyis/ / zhes so/ / de ltar gzhi la yod pa'i rigs sad pa na sems bskyed dang lam bsgrub pa'i skal ba yod pas rigs dang po sad pa'i rtags su/ 'jug pa las/ so so skye bo'i dus na'ang stong pa nyid thos nas/ / nang du rab tu dga' ba yang dang yang du 'byung*/ / rab tu dga' ba las byung mchi mas mig brlan zhing*/

/ lus kyi ba spu ldang bar 'gyur ba gang yin pa/ / de la rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas blo yi sa bon yod/ / de nyid nye bar bstan pa'i snod ni de yin te/ / de la dam pa'i don gyi bden pa bstan par bya/ / zhes so/ / gnyis pa sad pa'i rtags ni/ snga ma las/ sbyor ba'i sngon du snying rje dang*/ / mos pa dang ni bzod pa dang*/ / dge ba yang dag spyod pa ni/ / rigs kyi rtags su yang dag bshad/ / ces so/ / de lta bu'i rigs de nyid gsang sngags pa ltar na/ nyi ma sprin gyis bsgribs pa'am 'dam gyis gos pa'i nor bu ltar sku dang ye shes dang zhing khams ye nas lhun grub tu yod par 'dod cing chos thams cad ye nas sangs ma rgyas pa med par 'dod de/ rdo rje phung po'i yan lag ni/ / zhes pa la sogs pa dang*/ sangs rgyas nyid las gzhan pa'i chos/ / sangs rgyas nyid kyis mi brnyes so/ / zhes so/ / de lta na'ang glo bur kun tu brtags pa'i dri ma nyid chab rom chu ru zhu ba ltar ye shes su grol bar 'dod de/ nyon mongs lnga ni ye shes lnga/ / srid pa gsum ni bde ldan zhing*/ / zhes rdo rje las bshad pa bzhin no/ / tshul 'di nyid bka' tha ma nges pa don gyi mdo sde las kyang gsungs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i mdo las/ ji ltar mi yi gser gyi gar bu ni/ / nyal nyil rnam pa'i nang du lhung gyur la/ / der de lo ni mi nyung ba zhig tu/ / de ltar gnas kyang mi 'jig chos can no/ / lha yis lha yi mig gis de mthong nas/ / rnam par sbyang phyir gzhan la smras pa ni/ / 'di na rin cen mchog gi gser yod la/ / rnam par sbyongs la de nyid bya ba gyis/ / de bzhin ngas ni sems can thams cad kyang*/ / nyon mongs rnams kyis yun ring rtag non mthong*/ / de dag gis ni glo bur nyon mongs shes/ / rang bzhin sbyangs phyir thabs kyi chos ston to/ / zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs so/ / des na de lta bu'i rigs las nyams pa ma yin kyang*/

rnal 'byor sems tsam pa ltar re shig lam sgrub pa'i rigs las nyams par 'gyur bas de skad ces bya'o/ / yan lag gi nges tshig ni mi~X spanga~X ba dang mi~X do~Xr ba'i dam tshig lnga~X tshan gnyi~Xs ni~X rtsa ba sgrub pa'i grogs su dgos pas yana~X la~Xg gi dma~X tshi~Xg ces bya ste/ de dag kyang rtsa ba dang gnyan mi gnyan dgos pa'i dbang gis mnyam pas na de las shin tu 'da~X' dka'a~X ba yin te/ ra ba mtshams kyi 'obs dang 'dra bas so~X/ / gnyis pa phan yon nyes dmigs dang bcas la 'ang gnyis las/ dam tshig la gnas pa'i phan yon ni chos thams cad ye nas sku dang ye shes su sangs rgyas par mnyama~X nyid kyi don la~X lam thabs dang shes rab zab mos mnyama~X para~X sbyora~X ba~X yi~X rang bzhin ni mnyama~X pa~X'i dma~X tshi~Xg chen po de nyid la~X gna~Xs na~X 'bras bu sku gsum 'du 'bral med par mnya~Xm pa nyid kyi yon tan lhun rdzoga~Xs che~Xn po~X sangs rgyas thoba~X par 'gyura~X ba~Xs na dam tshig bsrung bar bya'o/ / dam tshig las 'da~Xs na~X sanga~Xs rgyasa~X thob pa ma~X yi~Xn pas 'da' bar mi bya ste/ rgyal po'i khrims la gnas pas bde ba 'byung zhing 'das pas chad pa 'byung ba bzhin no~X/ / gnyis pa nyams pa'i nyes dmigs la gnyis las/ rtsa ba'i dam tshig nyams pa'i nyes pa la'ang nyams grib gzhan la gnod pa ni rtsa~X ba'i~X dam tshig nyama~Xs pa~X'i gang zag bslab sdom phyala~X bar dor ba~X dga~X dam tshig gso~X ba'i thabs la~X nye~X ba~Xr mi~X brtsona~X na de dnga~X skada~X ci~Xg tsa~Xm yang mi 'grogs shing yud tsam gcig tu'ang phan tshun gtam smra bar ma~X byeda~X cig ci'i phyir zhe na tshe 'dir nad dang gnod pa la sogs pa mi 'dod pa'i rkyen sna tshogs 'byung zhing phyi mar de dang mnyam du dmyal bar 'gro dgos pas dam tshig nyama~Xs pa las gyura~X pa'i nyesa~X pa brjo~Xd kyis mi~X langa~X ba 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ / de'ang zlas nyams pa zhes bya'o/ / kha cig de dang lung pa gcig gi chu la'ang mi btung zer ba ni dgongs pa ma yin te/

'di ltar gsang sngags 'og ma 'og ma rnams dog cing gong ma gong ma de las yangs bas dam tshig bsrungs mtshams kyang de bzhin te krī ya bas lung pa gcig gi chu la'ang mi btung bar bshad de/ dam tshig bkod pa las/ krī ya rnams las khyad par du/ / lung gcig chu la mi btung dang*/ / zhes so/ / u pas lung pa gcig tu gnas kyang mthong bar mi bya ba dang*/ yo ga bas mthong yang phrad par mi bya ba dang*/ ma hā dang a nu a ti gsum gyis phrad kyang gtam mi smra bar bya yi/ gnas gcig tu 'dug pa tsam la nyes pa de tsam ma gsungs so/ / gnyis pa nyams pa'i nyes pa rang la 'byung ba ni rtsa~X ba'i~X dma~X tshi~Xg nyama~Xs par gyura~X na~X char phab na than pa 'byung ba'am mthu btang na rang la log pa ltar gang sgruba~X pa~X thama~Xs cada~X de las lo~Xg pa~Xr 'gyura~X zhing*/ kun gyi yida~X du~X mi~X 'o~Xng ba dang*/ tshe 'dir phongs pa dang nad dang gdon dang 'tshe ba dang tshe thung ba la sogs pa mi 'dod pa thams cad 'byung zhing*/ phyi mar dmyal bar ltung zhing bskal pa du mar sdug bsngal ba la sogs pa rang gi yid du mi 'ong ba rnam pa sna~X tsho~Xgs pa~X'i rang bzhin rgyu dam tshig nyams pas bskyed pa'i gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'bra~Xs bu~X sdug bsngal du ma mi~X 'do~Xd bzhi~Xn du~X rang dbang med par 'du~X bar byed do/ / gnyis pa yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa'i nyes pa ni/ ya~Xn la~Xg gi dma~X tshi~Xg nyamasa~X par gyura~X na~X tshe 'dir sgrub pa'i 'bra~Xs bu~X mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub gang yang meda~X ci~Xng phyi ma nga~Xn songa~X gsum du ltunga~X ste/ rdo rje las/ dam tshig nyams pas thur du 'gro/ / 'dir yang legs pa'i 'bras bu med/ / ces pa ltar ro/ / gsum pa rang bzhin dang dbye ba bshad pa la gnyis las/ dam tshig gi rang bzhin ni rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dma~X tshi~Xg rnama~Xs ni~X sku gsung thugs kyi rdo~X rje~X che~Xn po'i ngo bo sanga~Xs rgya~Xs kuna~X gyi~X bda~Xg nyida~X dam pa yi~Xn no/

/ de'i phyir bsrungs na phan yon dang nyams na nyes dmigs chen po 'byung ba 'thad pa dang bcas pa'o/ / gnyis pa dbye ba la gnyis te/ rnam grangs kyi dbye ba dang*/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbye ba'o/ / dang po la'ang gnyis las/ rtsa ba'i dbye ba ni rtsa~X ba'i~X dma~X tshiga~X lnga~X po la~X ni~X bla med mi spang ba lta bu gci~Xg la~X'anga~X rtsa ba thabs dang*/ shes rab gnyisa~X da~Xng de gnyis la sku gsung thugs gsum gsum ste drug dang de re re'ang yon tan phrin las sku gsung thugs lnga lnga ste bsdoms pas bcu~X phra~Xg gsu~Xm yod do/ / yan lag gi dbye ba ni ya~Xn la~Xg gi da~Xm tshiga~X lnga~X gnyisa~X te bcu la~X 'dod chags mi spong ba lta bu gci~Xg la~X'a~Xng thabs dang shes rab las/ thabs la ye shes lnga dang yul lnga/ shes rab la ye shes lnga dang yul lnga ste bcu~X phra~Xg gnyisa~X su~X dbye~X ba~Xs nyi shu yod do/ / gnyis pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbye ba la gnyis las/ chos can bsam gyis mi khyab pas dam tshig bsam gyis mi khyab pa ni/ rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dma~X tshi~Xg de~X dag ni~X ngo mtshar rmada~X po~X che~X yin te/ 'gro ba'i khams rnams ye shes chen por 'dul ba'i phyir ro/ / de'ang sems can mtha' yas pa ltar de re re la ltos pa'i dam tshig sum brgya drug cu'ang de snyed du 'gyur bas mtha' yas so zhes bstan pa ni/ 'ji~Xg rtena~X druga~X gi~X phyo~Xgs bcu~X na~X srida~X pa gsu~Xm gyis bsdus pa'i 'gro~X ba~X ji~X snyeda~X yod pa~X de dag gi rnam par rtoga~X pa de snyed yod pa 'dula~X ba'i phyir rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dma~X tshi~Xg kyang de~X snyeda~X du spro~X bas nam mkha'i dbyings dang chos kyi dbyings ltar bsam gyis mi khyab pa'o/ / kha cig sems can gyi rtog pa mang ba bzhin dam tshig kyang rigs mi 'dra ste de snyed du 'chad pa ni dgongs pa ma yin te/ dam tshig de ni zhes rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig bshad ma thag pa de la snyegs pa dang 'gal lo/

/ gnyis pa chos nyid bsam gyis mi khyab pas/ dam tshig bsam gyis mi khyab pa ni/ de ltar chos can rnam grangs kyi dam tshig bstan pa las gzhana~X ya~Xng snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad ye nas blang dor med pas spang blang bsrung 'tshams las 'das pas rgyala~X mcho~Xg kuna~X tu bza~Xng po bya rtsol med pa'i mchog gi rol par chos tha~Xms ca~Xd ma~X lusa~X par 'dus shing gnyis su med pa'i phyaga~X rgya~X nam mkha' lta bu yi~Xn pas na/ gang gis kyang bcos shing rtsol sgruba~X re dogs me~Xd pa'i rang bzhin te/ dam tshig thams cad kyi snying po'i mchog dam pa ma~X lusa~X pa kun de yin pas na de bzhin nyid la bcos slad dang re dogs med pa'i gnas lugs rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang du shes par bya'o/ / de skad du'ang kun byed las/ kye/ ston pa'i ston pa kun byed rgyal po nga*/ / rtsa ba byang chub sems su kun gcig pas/ / kun kyang snying po'i dam tshig gcig yin te/ / bsrung dang mi bsrung don las 'das par rtogs/ / kye/ kun byed rgyal po lta ba'i dam tshig ni/ / skye med nam mkha' lta bur phyogs 'das pas/ / gang gis de dag legs par rtogs pa de/ / kun byed rgyal po'i dam tshig rtogs pa yin/ / kye/ chos rnams rtsa ba sems su gcig pa ltar/ / dam tshig rtsa ba bsrung du med par gcig/ kye/ kun byed nga yi dgongs pa'i dam tshig ni/ / ma yengs dran pas dngos po ye shes su*/ / ma bcos sus kyang ma byas rang byung ste/ / rig pas dbang sgyur bsrung dang mi bsrung med/ / ji ltar snang ba'i chos rnams thams cad kun/ / rang byung snying por gsal bas dbang bsgyur nas/ / kun byed rgyal pos byas pa'i chos rnams la/ / rig dang ma rig gnyis ka'i yul las 'das/ / 'da' nyams bsrung mtshams med pa'i dam tshig yin/ / zhes so/ / des na gnas lugs don gyi dam tshig ni brjod du med pa dang bstan du med pa dang mtshan ma med pa dang ye ji bzhin pa'i chos nyid dus gsum 'pho 'gyur med pa'i ting nge 'dzin te/

de~X la~X so~Xgs pa~X bsam brjod dmigs pa'i yul las 'das pas dam tshig gi ngo bo mtha~X' ya~Xs pa'i mcho~Xg rdzogs pa chen po don gyi gnas lugs su gnas pa'o/ / de lta bu'i dam tshig tu dam tshig thams cad ma bsgrubs kyang ngang gis 'du ba'i yon tan ni/ nam mkha' klong yangs kyi rgyud las/ nor bu rin cen rnyed pa'i mis/ / 'jig rten so nam mi dgos bzhin/ / ma bsgoms sems kyi don rtogs na/ / yon tan ma lus lhun gyis grub/ / de las mi 'da' dam tshig yin/ / zhes so/ / bzhi pa phan yon chen po rgya cher bshad pa la lnga las/ dang po 'jig rten pas bstod cing bkur ba ni/ rgyala~X ba~X'i riga~Xs kyi mcho~Xg gsang sngags 'dzi~Xn cing dam tshig la gnas pa~X de~X la tshangs pa dang brgya byin la sogs pa 'ji~Xg rtena~X pa'i gtso~X bo dang ༵de'i 'kho~Xr gyi~Xs bstod cing bkura~X sti dang phu dud byed par 'gyur ro/ / gnyis pa 'phags pas byin gyis rlob pa ni/ lha dang mi'i skye rgu rnams kyi nang nas dma~X pa~X mcho~Xg gtso bo sangs rgyas rnams da~Xng*/ de'i sras dma~X pa~X sar gnas kyi byang chub sems dpa' yi~Xs rim pa bzhin srasa~X kyi thu bo dnga~X spuna~X gyi dngas mar dgonga~Xs shing*/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pas byi~Xn gyi~Xs rloba~X pa'o/ / gsum pa rgyal ba'i spyod yul thob pa'i phan yon ni/ dam tshig la gnas pa de nyid bde~X bar gshe~Xgs pa nyida~X kyi spyod yula~X sar chud pa sa la gnas pas yongs su smin pa'i rig 'dzin gsum la zhuga~Xs pa~X'i mthar chos thams cad 'ji~Xgs pa me~Xd pa'i mchog kuna~X tu ༵bza~Xng pora~X sbyora~X zhing 'thob par byed do/ / de'ang sgrib pa gnyis dang*/ bdud bzhi dang*/ 'khor 'das gnyis dang*/ shes bya gang la'ang 'jigs pa med pas 'jigs med kun tu bzang po'i 'bras bu'i sangs rgyas su bshad do/ / sar chud pa'i rig 'dzin ni dkyil 'khor du zhugs te bskyed rdzogs dang por mnos pa dag go

/ sa la gnas pa'i rig 'dzin ni rtogs pa dang ting nge 'dzin thob nas de la rgyun du gnas pa'o/ / sar smin pa'i rig 'dzin ni thob pa de las kyang stobs cher gyur te/ rnam smin tshe dbang phyag rgya thob nas lhun gyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin la sbyor zhing thob par byed pa'o/ / bzhi pa sdom pa dang dam tshig gi yon tan 'dus pa'i phan yon ni/ bla na med pa'i dam tshig gi nang du chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs ji~X bzhi~Xn pa'i chos nyida~X nam mkha' lta bu dnga~X*/ sems can 'dula~X ba~X'i thaba~Xs theg pa mtha' dag gi don dang*/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang rig pa 'dzin pa la sogs ji~X snyeda~X pa de dag gi sdoma~X pa~X bsa~Xm ya~Xs kyi rigs gang yin pa~X ma~X lusa~X pa kun yar ldan gyi tshul bre mig tu phul ltar 'dus shing de dag gi yon tan ma lus pa lhuna~X gyisa~X gruba~X pa yin no/ / lnga pa nyams kyang gsor rung ba'i phan yon ni rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyama~Xs pa na~X nyan thos kyi 'dul khrims rdza be'u chags pa ltar gsor mi rung ba ma yin gyi dbang nod pa dang bshags pa la sogs pa'i cho gas bska~Xngs pasa~X/

ba~Xr 'do~Xd na~X 'phe~Xl ba~Xr bye~Xd do/

/ sposa~X mo~X che~Xn mo~X pukka sī la~X so~Xgs pa~X mtshams ma bzhi'iX bro~X ga~Xr glu~X tshi~Xg che~Xn mo~Xs ni~X dgra bgegs la sogs pa lhana~X ne~X ste zhi bar 'do~Xd na~X zhi zhing lhana~X ne~Xr bye~Xd la sems rmuga~Xs shing mi gsal bar 'do~Xd na~X rmuga~Xs pa~Xr bye~Xd do/ / gsum pa yul gyi phra men brgyad kyi bro gar gyi phan yon ni/ senga~X gdo~Xng che~Xn mo~X la~X soga~Xs pa~X phyogs ma bzhi'iX bro~X ga~Xr dang glu ༵tshi~Xg che~Xn mo~Xs ni ༵gdug pa can thama~Xs ca~Xd de dgra bgegs kuna~X gyi lus srog la~X za~X ba~Xr byeda~X cing rdula~X phra rab kyi cha~X shas tsama~X ya~Xng me~Xd pa~Xr bye~Xd do/

/ bzha~Xd gdo~Xng che~Xn mo~X la~X so~Xgs pa~X mtshams ma bzhi'iX bro~X ga~Xr dang glu~X tshi~Xg che~Xn mo~Xs ni~X gdug pa ca~Xn thama~Xs cada~X kyi lusa~X kuna~X las nang khrol dang don snying 'byi~Xn pa~Xr byeda~X cing de dag gi srog la sogs pa phun sum tshogs pa kuna~X la~Xs ra~Xb tu ༵nyama~Xs pa~Xr bye~Xd do/ / bzhi pa dbang phyug ma nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi bro gar gyi phan yon ni/ slasa~X da~Xng byi~X mo~X bra~Xn mo~X yi~X bro~X ga~Xr dang glu ༵tshi~Xg che~Xn mo~Xs ni~X pho nya dgra la rbada~X cinga~X mngag gzhug las la gtanga~X ba~Xr bya~X ba~X ste~X phyir 'gal byed cham la 'bebs pa'i las thama~Xs ca~Xd dang*/ nang du dngos grub yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i las thama~Xs ca~Xd byeda~X pa~X yi~Xn no/ / gsum pa las bzhi bsgrub pa'i gnas dang ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par ni/ shing ljona~X pa~X'i nags tshal da~Xng ni~X lcuga~X phra~Xn gyi tsha~Xl skyed shing gi ra ba dang*/ shing sdonga~X gci~Xg gi drung dnga~X ni~X me~Xs re~Xg ste nags mes tshig pa'i gnas rnams su~X zhi ba dang rgyas pa dang dbang dang drag po rnams bsgrub pa'i phyir dwanga~Xs ba~X dang dga~X' ba~X dang chaga~Xs pa~X dnga~X khrosa~X pa'i yid bzhi rim pa ltar ldan pasa~X kā~X li~X ste thabs kyi phrin las bzhi po ra~Xb tu ༵bsgrub par bya~X'o/ / kha cig yum bzhi dang sbyar nas 'chad pa na ā li'i sgra la 'jug pa ste skabs ma yin no/ / gsum pa skabs kyi don bsdu ba ni/ de skad ce~Xs brjo~Xd pa~Xs gtso bo de~X bzhi~Xn gshe~Xgs pa~X nyida~X la~X 'khor gyi de~X bzhi~Xn gshe~Xgs pa~X nyida~X phrin las rnam pa bzhi'i don rtogs pa ste lung nod pa'i tshul gyis bsgru~Xb para~X gyur ༵to~X/ / rang bzhin gsa~Xng ba'i~X snyinga~X po~X ye shes kyi de~X kho~X na~X nyida~X nge~Xs pa~X la~Xs/ sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa chen po ye nas lhuna~X gyisa~X gruba~X pa~X'i phri~Xn la~Xs rnam pa bzhir gnas pa de nyid du gdul bya'i don du byina~X gyi~Xs rlo~Xb pa~X zhe~Xs bya~X ba~X'i le~X'u~X ste~X nyi~X shu~X ba'i rnam par bshad pa~X'o~X/

/ / / ༈ spyi don gsum pa 'bras bu sku dang ye shes la bstod pa'i tshul la gnyis te/ bstod tshul mdor bstan pa dang*/ bstod pa dngos rgyas par bshad pa'o/ / dang po ni/ khro bo'i dkyil 'khor gyi mdzad pa rdzogs pa de~X na~Xs rang snang gi sku dang ye shes la bstod pa'i phyir bco~Xm ldana~X 'da~Xs dgye~Xs pa~X che~Xn po~X'i tshoga~Xs khrag 'thung rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa'i dkyi~Xl 'kho~Xr gyi~X snang ba chen po de nyid la shina~X tu~X rngama~Xs pa~X'i mda~Xngs kyi~Xs dgyes pa'i glu~X 'di~X skad ces blanga~Xs so~X/ / gnyis pa la gnyis te/ rigs dang rigs kyi bdag po la bstod pa dang*/ rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor la bstod pa'o/ / dang po la gnyis te/ rigs lnga la spyir bstod pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbang phyug la bye brag tu bstod pa'o/ / dang po la lnga las/ sku'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad la bstod pa ni/ hūm̐~X zhes pa rnams ni khro bo'i glu rnams re re zhing sku lnga ye shes lnga ldan du mtshon zhing mgo 'dren pa'o/ / de'ang sku ni bdud dang rū tra la sogs pa dregs pa can rnams 'dul bar byed pas gtuma~X po che~Xn po ste~X/ bskala~X pa 'jig pa~X'i me~X ltara~X 'ba~Xr zhing me dpung gi klong na bzhugs pa'i sku las ye shes kyi 'o~Xd ze~Xr nyi~X ma~X 'buma~X gyi~X gzi~X brjid phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa dang mtshungs pa phyogs bcur 'phro zhing*/ gdug pa can bsdigs pa khro~X gnyera~X gloga~X stonga~X 'gyu ༵ba~X bzhi~Xn 'khyug pa/ gdug pa can tshar gcod pa'i mche~X ba~X za~Xng ya~Xg rno dkar bzhis ma rungs pa za~X bar byeda~X pa'i 'jigs byed che~Xn por gnas pa'o/ / ho~X ni ngo mtshar ba'i gad mo ste 'og ma rnams la yang sbyar ro/ / gnyis pa gsung gi rigs kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad la bstod pa ni/ khro bo'i gsung rnga~Xm pa~X'i ngo~X ro~X 'bruga~X sgra stonga~X dus gcig la ldira~X ba lta bu'i gtuma~X che~Xn dang drag shul ri~X ra~Xb 'buma~X dus gcig tu bsnyila~X ba'i sgra ska~Xd dang mnyam pa/

a~X a dang ha~X ha dang a la~X ha la~X'i gda~X rgyanga~X che~Xn po dgod pa/ dbugs kyi shugs las bshuga~X pa'i~X 'tho~Xr rlunga~X chen pos gdug pa can rnams 'jigs pas g.yenga~X bar byed pa~X ni dus mtha'i rlung bas kyang che~X'o~X/ / gsum pa thugs kyi rigs kyi dkyil 'khor la bstod pa ni/ shes bya ma lus pa mkhyen pa ni ma rig pa'i tshogs la khrosa~X pa~X'i she~Xs ra~Xb kyi 'o~Xd zer che~Xn po~X mnga' ba ni/ ye~X she~Xs lnga'i dkyila~X 'kho~Xr kuna~X tu~X gsa~Xl bas gnas skabs dug lngar 'ba~Xr ba~X'i ngo bo ye~X she~Xs su gnas pa'i nyon mongs pa rang mtshan gyi rtsal kuna~X tu~X 'jo~Xms pa'i ye shes de yang sprul sku la ltos nas ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes gnyis dang*/ longs sku la ltos nas me long lta bu la sogs pa sna~X tsho~Xgs kyi ye~X she~Xs rnams ngo bo gnyis su med pa'i thi~Xg le~X che~Xn po chos nyid don gyi ye shes su ro gcig pa'o/ / bzhi pa yon tan gyi rigs kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad la bstod pa ni/ gdug pa can 'dul ba'i yon tan mnga' bas khro~X bo~X'i rgyala~X po~X yin zhing*/ de las sprul pa du ma'i char 'bab pa'i gzhi byed pas sprina~X che~Xn po~X zhes bya la/ thugs khrosa~X pa~Xs khro bo'i dkyi~Xl 'kho~Xr gyi cha~Xr che~Xn po 'be~Xbs shing*/ gdul bya'i don du gang la gang 'dul gyi dkyi~Xl 'kho~Xr yi~Xd bzhi~Xn gyi nor bu ltar bsam pa bzhin du 'byunga~X ba~X'i gtera~X las sprul pa sna~X tsho~Xgs pa khrosa~X pa'i~X gzugs su nam mkha' khyab par 'byung ba thams cad kyang gnas lugs thi~Xg le~X che~Xn po gcig tu gnas so/ / lnga pa phrin las gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad la bstod pa ni/ phung po la sogs pa bduda~X bzhi po kuna~X gyi~X ni stobs 'joms pas na bduda~X che~Xn po~X yin zhing*/ sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa ni 'khor bar 'du byed pas bduda~X kyi~X dbang po rnams kyang 'dul bar byed pa'i phyir bduda~X de~X las dang nyon mongs pa'i bduda~X rnama~Xs 'jo~Xms shing*/

bdud dang gshin rje la sogs pa 'ji~Xgs pa~X'i tshoga~Xs kyanga~X rab tu 'ji~Xgs shing skrag par bye~Xd pa~X chen po he ru ka rnams ni rang bzhin spros pa'i mtha' dang bral bas thig le chen po'o/ / yang na gzhan 'phrul dbang byed la sogs pa'i bdud kun gyi ni bdud chen po dga' rab dbang phyug lta bu yin zhing*/ bdud de'i bdud ni dregs pa'i rū tra yin pas 'jigs pa'i tshogs chung ma dang bcas pa 'jigs par byed pa ni 'ji~Xgs byeda~X chen po che~X mcho~Xg nyid de spros pa med pa'i ngo bor bzhugs pas thi~Xg le~X che~Xn po'o/ / zhes so/ / gnyis pa dkyil 'khor gyi dbang phyug la bye brag tu bstod pa ni/ che mchog yab yum gyi sku ni skye shi 'pho 'gyur med pas rdo~X rje~X'i braga~X che~Xn po nyid de 'jig 'bral med pas rab tu sra~X ba~X chen po~X mtshan dpes 'bar zhing*/ gsung dang yon tan ni ye shes rdo~X rje~X'i chu~X bo~Xs gdul bya'i tshogs sdud cing tshim par byeda~X pa po~X yin la/ thugs ni thams cad mkhyen pa'i rdo~X rje~X ye shes kyi me~X 'od gsal ba ste~X shes bya'i yul ma lus pa mngon sum du gyur cing thugs rje'i 'oda~X zer rab tu 'ba~Xr ba che~Xn pos 'gro ba'i ma rig pa'i mun pa sel bar byed pa'o/ / phrin las ni lhun gyis grub pa rdo~X rje'i~X bdag nyid gdul bya la khyab cing g.yo bar byed pas rlunga~X ste~X bdud dang mu stegs la sogs pa 'tho~Xr zhing las bzhi'i don rnams yongs su rdzogs pa~X che~Xn por lhun gyis grub pa'o/ / gnyis pa rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor la bstod pa la'ang gnyis las/ brten pa lha'i dkyil 'khor la bstod pa ni/ hūm̐~X gtumaX cheXn dusaX mthaX' zhes pa nas 'jiXgs byeXd cheXn poX thiXg leX che ho'iX bar ste/ he ru ka rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor la so sor bstod pa'o/ / rten gzhal yas khang la bstod pa ni/ rdoXrjeX'i bragaX cheXn keng rus kyi ri rab dang*/

chuX boX rakta'i rgya mtsho dang*/ me ye shes kyi meX ri dang*/ rlungaX 'og gzhi rlung gi dkyil 'khor la sbyar te bshad do/ / de skad ce~Xs de bzhin gshegs pas che~Xd du~X glenga~Xs so~X/ / 'bras bu gsa~Xng ba~X'i snyinga~X po~X sku dang ye shes kyi de~X kho~X na~X nyida~X nge~Xs pa~X la~Xs rang snang ye shes kyi khro~X bo~X la~X bstoda~X pa~X'i le~X'u~X ste ༵nyera~X gci~Xg pa'i rnam par bshad pa~X'o~X/ / / / ༈ spyi don gsum pa rgyud dam par gdams nas rjes 'jug la gtad pa'i tshul la gsum ste/ don gyi 'brel dgod pa/ tshig gi don bshad pa/ skabs kyi don bsdu ba'o/ / dang po ni/ sgyu 'phrul rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs par bstan pa de~X na~Xs bco~Xm ldana~X 'da~Xs dgye~Xs pa~X che~Xn po~X dpal kun tu bzang po ste/ de'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs la/ bde ba chen po*/ rdo rje snying po/ dam pa dang po/ gdod ma'i mgon po/ rdo rje 'chang chen po la sogs pa'o/ / ston pa des rang snang lhun stug po bkod pa'i rigs lnga sems dpa' brgyad la sogs pa'i de~X bzhi~Xn gshe~Xgs pa~X nyida~X la~X gsa~Xng sngaga~Xs kyi~X rgyala~X po~X 'di nyid mi nub cing 'gro ba la phan gdags pa'i phyir brtana~X pa~Xr gzunga~X shig ces pa~X 'di~X che~Xd du~X brjo~Xd cing khyad par du rig pa'i sems dpa' gsang bdag la gdams par mdzad do~X/ / kha cig ni gsang bdag 'chad pa'i skyes bu yin gyi/ rdo rje las dang*/ chos dang*/ kun nas snang ba'i dpal la gdams pa'o/ / zhes pa'ang rigs par ma mthong ste/ 'di ltar phyag na rdo rje la gdams pas gzhan la ma gdams par mi 'gyur ba dang*/ 'og min du kun bzang nyid rigs lnga'i gtso bo rnam par snang mdzad du snang bas ston cing 'chad pa'i skyes bu yin la/ gsang bdag 'khor du snang bas 'dzin pa po yin pa'i phyir ro/ / gnyis pa la gnyis te/ lam kun gyi 'bras bur gdams pa dang*/ gsang ba kun gyi mchog tu gdams pa'o/ / dang po la gnyis te/

gdams bya rgyud kyi rang bzhin dang*/ gang la gdams pa snod kyi che ba'o/ / dang po la gsum las/ 'bras bu rgyud dngos bstan pa ni/ rang snang gi 'khor thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa'i rang bzhin yab yum du snang ba rnams la kye~X kye~X zhes bos nas snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos phyoga~Xs bcu~X dang dusa~X bzhi~Xs bsdus pa'i ra~Xng bzhi~Xn 'di~X dag thams cad de~X bzhi~Xn gshe~Xgs pa rigs lnga yab yum dang sems dpar bcas pa ste zhi khro gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor du ye nas sangs rgyas pa~X'i ngo~X bo~X nyida~X du gnas pa ni gzhi gsang ba'i snying po ste/ des mtshon nas lam dang 'bras bu gsang ba'i snying po ni rgyud kyi ngo bo'o/ / gnyis pa lam gzhan de'i rkang stegs su bstan pa ni/ phyi gzu~Xng ba'i yul dang nang 'dzina~X pa'i sems kyi spros pa la~X blo 'che~Xl nas srid pa gsum por 'khyams pa'i 'gro ba~X yi~Xs phyi nang gzhan la sogs pa'i rnama~X par rtoga~X pa mi bzad pa'i zhaga~Xs pa~Xs so~X so~Xr z-i~Xn te sdug bsngal ba ni/ slob dpon phyogs kyi glang pos 'jam dpal la bstod pa las/ rnam par rtog las ma gtogs pa'i/ / 'khor ba zhes bya ci yang med/ / ces pa dang*/ 'jug pa las/ dang por nga zhes bdag la zhen gyur cing*/ / bdag gi 'di zhes dngos la chags pa skyes/ / zo chun 'phyan ltar rang dbang med pa yi/ / 'gro la snying rje gyur gang de la 'dud/ / ces pa'i tshul gyis 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i sems can gyi dbang po'i rim pa dang sbyar te theg pa so so'i sa ༵rnama~Xs dang lam gyi khyada~X para~X gong 'og tu bko~Xd pa~X yanga~X rang bzhin gsa~Xng ba~X'i snyinga~X po~X 'gro~X ba'i~X la~Xm stegs yin gyi lam tshang la ma nor ba dngos ma yin te/ de dag gi mthar 'dir 'jug dgos pa'i phyir ro/ / gsum pa rnams grangs du ma gsungs pa'i dgos pa ni/ de lta na gsang ba'i snying po gcig pu gsungs pas chog mod/ theg pa'i rnam grangs mtho dman mang po bstan ci dgos she na/

sems can rnams ni dbang po'i rim pa sna tshogs su gnas skabs gnas pas gang la gang 'tshams kyis so sor bstan te/ 'di nyid dang po nas go ba'am phrad pa shin tu dka' bas sngon 'gro'am stegs su bstan te/ phyis 'di dang phrad cing spyad par bya ba'i phyir spangs pa dang rtogs pa'i ye~X she~Xs ngo~X mtsha~Xr ba raba~X 'bya~Xms mnga' ba'i ston pa kun tu bzang po nyid kyi rang byung gi thugs rje sprul pa'i sku 'jig rten du snang bas gsungs pa'i chos thams cad kyanga~X sems can gyi do~Xn du~X mi~X 'gyu~Xr zhes bya ba ni gang cung zad cig kyang yonga~X ste dus rnams pa thams cad du ma~X gsunga~Xs pa yin no/ / de skad du'ang legs byin gyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ 'jig rten rnams la phan pa mdzad pa'i phyir/ / rgyal ba rnam 'dren de yis chos gsungs te/ / 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug zhi mdzad cing*/ / mya ngan 'das pa'i lam la 'god par mdzad/ / nam yang don du mi 'gyur mi mnga' ste/ / nyes zad rdzun gyi tshig spangs drang srong che/ / zhes so/ / des bstan pa'i chos ni shes bya ma lus pa mngon sum gyis gzigs shing sgrib pa mtha' dag spangs pa sangs rgyas kyi gsung yin pa'i phyir na don du 'gyur ba kho na'o/ / de la ye shes kyi gzigs pa ni/ rgyud bla ma las/ mkhyen pa'i skad cig gcig gis kyang*/ / shes bya'i dkyil 'khor kun khyab can/ / zhes so/ / sgrib pa mtha' dag dang bral ba ni sangs rgyas te rdzun spangs pa'i skyes bu tshad mar gyur pa ni/ rnam 'grel las/ nyes pa spangs pas brdzun gyi tshig/ smra bar mi 'gyur rgyu med phyir/ / nyes zad lung du shes par bya/ / zhes so/ / de ltar sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa don du 'gyur ba bzhin du de'i sras dang slob ma dag gis rgyal ba'i bka'i rjes su 'brangs te rnam bshad mdzad pa'ang bka' bzhin 'gyur ba ni/ rgyud bla ma las/ gang zhig rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'ba' zhig gi / dbang byas rnam g.yeng med yid can gyis bshad/

/ thar ba thob pa'i lam dang rjes mthun pa/ / de yang drang srong bka' bzhin spyi bos blangs/ / zhes so/ / gnyis pa gang la gdams pa snod kyi che ba ni/ phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i de~X bzhi~Xn gshe~Xgs pa~X thama~Xs cada~X kyi~X sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las phun sum tshogs pa'i phyaga~X rgya~X dam pa ni gzhi lam 'bras bu'i gsa~Xng che~Xn chos thams cad kyi snyinga~X po~X 'di~X yin no/ / de'ang brjod bya don dang rjod byed rgyud kyi gzhung gnyis ka de bzhin gshegs pa'i phyag rgyas btab pa'i phyir de las 'da' bar dka' bas phyag rgyar bshad de dper na rgyal po'i bka' rtags kyi phyag rgyas btab pa bzhin te/ mnyam sbyor las/ 'da' dka' de bzhin mi shigs pa/ / rgyal bo'i phyag rgya mchog gi rtags/ / bdag nyid chen po'i mtshan ma'i gzugs/ /de bas phyag rgya zhes bya'o/ / zhes so/ / de lta bu'i tshul ni rgya du mas btab cing rang bzhin dang gnas skabs kyi gsang ba'i don de nyid phyin ci ma log par rang gis rtoga~Xs na~Xs skal ba dang ldan pa gzhan la smra~X b.ra~X ganga~X bye~Xd pa~X'i gang zag de~X nyida~X rgyud kyi ston pa phun sum tshogs pa nga ༵kun tu bzang po yi~Xn zhing*/

phan pa dang nus pa'i dba~Xng ya~Xng ye nas ngang ngam lhun gyis rdzo~Xgs pa yin no/ / tshig 'di'i rgyud 'chad pa de la ston pas thog ma med pa'i dus su dbang bskur zin pas tshe 'di la ma mnos kyang rgyud la dbang bas bdag don dang gzhan don byos shigang kun tu bzang po dngos kyis byin gyis brlabs shing ye nas sangs rgyas pa dang gsang ba zab mo'i don la mos shing mi skrag par gyur pa'i phyir ro zhes bya bar bstan to/ / gnyis pa gsang ba kun gyi mchog tu gdams pa la gnyis te/ gsang don dngos dang*/ de 'dzin pa'i gang zag dam par lung bstan pa'o/ / dang po ni/ phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i de~X bzhi~Xn gshe~Xgs pa~X thama~Xs ca~Xd la~X sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsa~Xng ba~X mthar thug pa rgyud kyi dam pa 'di~X la~Xs gzha~Xn cung zad kyang mi~X mnga~X' ba yin pas mchog dam par zungs shig ces pa'o/ / de'i don yang chos thams cad ye nas mnyam pa nyid gsang ba'i snying por sangs rgyas pa ni gzhi'i rgyud de/ rgyal ba thams cad kyis gtan la dbab bya'i don mthar thug pa'o/ / de nyid ston pa gzhung gi tshogs la'ang don zab mo yod pa rtag pa'i mthar sgro~X 'dogs pa dnga~X med pa chad pa'i mthar skura~X pa~X 'debs pa dang*/ yod med gnyis yin pa dang min pa la sogs pa'i spros pa thams cad nye bar zhi~X ba~X yi~X rang bzhin ye nas stong zhing bdag med pas blo yi yul las 'das pa ni/ gsa~Xng ba~X'i snyinga~X po~X chos thams cad kyi de~X kho~X na~X nyida~X de~X chos nyid bsam brjod med pa ngesa~X pa~X'i dbyinga~Xs na~Xs brjod pa'i don du ston pas byunga~X ba'o/ / de skad du'ang mngon rtogs rgyan las/ zab pa nyid de sgro 'dogs dang*/ / skur ba'i mtha' las grol ba nyid/ / ces pa dang*/ rtsa ba shes rab las/ gzhan las shes min zhi ba dang*/ / rnam rtog med don tha dad med/ / spros pa rnams kyis ma spros pa/ / de ni de yi mtshan nyid do/ / zhes pa dang*/ ye shes snang ba rgyan gyi mdo las/

chos rnams ma skyes mkha' ltar rab zhi ba/ / don dam gzigs pa rnams kyi spyod yul te/ / rgyal ba rnam 'dren zag pa med zhi ba/ / de bzhin nyid dbyings nas ni bstan par mdzad/ / ces so/ / rjod byed kyi tshig le'u nyi shu rtsa gnyis po 'di dag kyang de bzhin nyid kyi rang bzhin sgro 'dogs dang skur ba zhi ba yi don gyi lta ba zab mo dang spyod pa brlang po rnams snod min la gsang zhing snod ldan la bstan pa'i rang bzhin chos thams cad kyi snying po gzhi lam 'bras bu'i de kho na nyid de ni/ kun tu bzang po'i thugs kyi dbyings rum nges pa'i dbyings nas phyung ste lhan cig pa'i 'khor la skal ldan gyi gdul bya'i don du gsungs pa'o/ / gnyis pa de 'dzin pa'i gang zag dam par lung bstan pa ni/ rgyud 'di 'dzin cing ston pa'i gang zag de~X ni~X nge~Xs pa~X kho naraX gzhan la ston pa rig pa'i skyes bu dang rang nyid grol ba skye ba gcig gis mi thogs par sangs rgyas su lunga~X bstana~X te~X/ de ni nga yin dbang yang rdzogs/ / zhes pa dang*/ rdo rje las/ chos tshul 'di la gang spyod pa/ / de ni tshe 'dir rdzogs sangs rgya/ / zhes pa dang*/ rdo rje me long las/ rang rig ye shes don ston phyir/ / rang snang rig pas mngon byas la/ / rig 'dzin mchog ste lhun grub ba'i/ / ting 'dzin nus pa'i mthu med kyang*/ / sa sbyong sems dpas bskyod du med*/ / bde gshegs nyid dang spyod yul gcig/ rig pa'i skyes bu'i lung thob pa'o/ / zhes so/ / de lta bu'i gang zag de ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi srasa~X po ni~X dam pa yin te/ thuga~Xs kyi gsang ba rmad du byung ba 'di lta bu la~Xs skyesa~X pa~X yi~Xn pa'i phyir/ dper na 'khor los sgyur ba'i bu thu bo rgyal tshab tu skyes pa bzhin no/ / de nyid gnas skabs su sara~X chud pa/ sa la gnas pa/ sar smin pa gsum la gnas shing*/ mthar thug 'bras bu'i sa raba~X mchog tu gyur pa/

rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa zhes bya/ thabs dang shes rab mchog gi sa zhes bya/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i sa zhes kyang bya/ mthar thug pa de la gnas par 'gyur ro/ / de ni nga yin zhes pa dang sbyar na da lta nyid nas ri~Xg pa~X 'dzi~Xn pa'i sa la~X gna~Xs par bstan te/ 'chad pa'i ston pa kun bzang dngos su gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ / de'i yon tan yongs su ma rdzogs par snang yang don la rdzogs par yod de/ sangs rgyas kyi dkyil 'khor du ye nas sangs rgyas pa'i phyir ro/ / dper na mi dbul po'i sa 'og gam khyim na rin po che'i gter yod pa 'byin pa'i rtsol ba la gnas pa'i tshe/ dus de nas longs spyod mig lam ma gyur pas dbul po brjod kyang gter chen dngos su dbang bar thag chod pas 'byor ba can yin pa bzhin du/ saX rabaX rigaX paX 'dzinaX paX rang laX gnasaX pa de nyid mngon du byed pa'i rtsol ba la zhugs pas na sa rab rig pa 'dzin la gnas zhes kyang bshad par bya ste/ 'di kho nar nges so zhes phyogs gcig tu rtag pa mtha' bzung gis rgyud sde chen po bshad par mi bya ste/ rdo rje tshig brling zhing gang du 'ang sbyar du yod pa'i phyir ro/ / gsum pa skabs kyi don bsdu ba ni/ rgyud kyi ston pas mdzad pa chen po'i bshad pa rdzogs nas ji ltar bzhugs tshul ston pa ste/ de'ang mdo dang rgyud sde kha cig gis ni bshad pa rdzogs nas 'khor rnams rjes su yi rang zhing mngon par bstod pa tsam ston zhing*/ de nas spyod lam gzhan gyis bzhugs par mngon pas dus res 'ga' bar bstan la/ thabs kyi zhags pa las/ nyid kyi thugs kar zhugs nas mi snang bar gyur to/ / zhes dkyil 'khor bsdu bas mi snang bar gsungs shing*/ de dag tu ston pa/ bstan pa/ 'khor/ dus/ gnas rnams re 'ga' ba dang*/ ston pa nyid las gzhan du gyur pas dman pa dang*/ chos kyang sna tshogs pa dang*/ gnas kyang gdul bya'i snang bas bsdus pa ste/ thun mong du gyur pa rnams las ches gsang zhing khyad par du 'phags par bstan pa'i phyir rgyud kyi don de skad ce~Xs brjo~Xd pa~Xs rang snang 'od gsal du bkod pa'i de~X bzhi~Xn gshe~Xgs pa~X rigs lnga til gyi gong bu ji snyed kyis nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mtha' dbus khyab pa de dag thama~Xs cada~X gnyis su mi dmigs shing*/

。ngo bo dbye~Xr me~Xd pa~Xr dgye~Xs na~Xs dus gsum 'pho 'gyur med pa'i ngang gzhir rdzogs lhun gyis grub pa'i rang bzhin dusa~X bzhi~X chos nyid kyi 'khor lo mnya~Xm pa~X nyida~X kyi~X dbyi~Xngs mtha' dbus med pa'i zhing khams/ snang zhing bkod pa thams cad ston pa nyid kyi sku~X dang gsu~Xng dang thuga~Xs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i rang bzhin las lhuna~X stuga~X po~X bko~Xd pa~X'i rgyana~X nyida~X du~X sngon ji lta bar phyis kyang de bzhin nyid de/ nam mkha' bzhin du rang bzhin 'pho 'gyur dang 'phel 'grib med pa'i tshul gyis bzhuga~Xs so~X/ / zhing khams gsa~Xng ba'i~X snyinga~X po~X ye shes kyi rang snang de~X kho~X na~X nyida~X nge~Xs pa~X la~Xs/ mdzad pa rdzogs nas dgongs pa la bzhugs pas mnyesa~X pa~X dnga~X rgyud mi nub par gtad pas 'khor gyis yonga~Xs su~X gzunga~X ba~X'i le~X'u ༵ste~X nyi~X shu~X rtsa~X gnyi~Xs pa'i rnam par bshad pa~X'o~X/ / / / ༈ spyi don gsum pa yongs su rdzogs pa mjug gi don la gsum las/ dang po rgyud gang gi khongs su gtogs pa ni/ brjod bya gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa bden pa dbyer med kyi don ye nas sangs rgyas par ston pas rjod byed tshig gi rgyud la'ang 'pha~Xgs pa~X zhes brjod do/ / 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs kyi rgyud thams cad la rtog pa zer la/ 'di ni de dag thams cad kyi mchog tu gyur pa'i phyir rtoga~X pa'i~X rgyala~X po~X rdo rje sems dpa' sgyu~X 'phrula~X drwa~X ba~X'i rgyud chen po le~X'u~X stonga~X phra~Xg brgya~X yod pa~X la~Xs de'i khongs su gtogs so/ / gnyis pa le lag gang yin pa de ni/ de'i nang nas 'di ni rgyu mtshana~X nyida~X kyi theg pa dnga~X 'bras bu gsang sngags kyi rgyuda~X thama~Xs ca~Xd kyi~X 'phro gzhi'am 'byung khungs yin pas lunga~X gi~X spyi~X zhes bya'o/ / de nyid phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i de~X bzhi~Xn gshe~Xgs pa~X thama~Xs ca~Xd kyi~X sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i gsa~Xng ba~X yin la/

mchog tu 'phags shing rab tu zab la rgya che ba'i gnas ston pa'i phyir gsa~Xng ba~X'i snyinga~X po~X gzhi lam 'bras bu'i de~X kho~X na~X nyida~X rnam par nge~Xs pa~X'i le'u zhes bya ba yin te/ 'di lasa~X theg pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa thama~Xs ca~Xd ma~X lusa~X pa~Xr 'phrosa~X te~X bstan pas na kun gyi rtsa bar gyur pa yin no/ / gsum pa 'bras bu mchog tu bstan pa ni/ rgyal ba rnams kyis 'gro ba'i don du sgyu 'phrul stong phrag brgya pa la sogs pa chos kyi 'kho~Xr lo~X dpag tu med pa bsko~Xr ba~X de~X dga~X gi nang nas 'bra~Xs bu~X gsang sngags bla na med pa'iX mcho~Xg rtsa~X ba~X'i rgyuda~X che~Xn po~X rdzo~Xgs so~X/ / zhes legs par gtan la phab zin to/ / / / de ltar rgyud don zab cing rgya che 'phags blo'i spyod yul gangs can mtsho/ / mkha' ltar rab zhi rnyog pa kun bral gdod nas 'od gsal 'dus ma byas/ / ji snyed ji bzhin gzigs pa'i gsang chen shin tu rmad byung mtha' yas gang*/ / rgyal ba'i thugs rjes 'gro la snang byas gangs ri'i khrod 'dir cung zad gsal/ / de don mkhas rnams rim par legs bshad gser gyi drwa bas mdzes byas na'ang*/ / tshig don brgal dka'i chos tshul rgya mtsho da dung cung zad yongs mi gsal/ / 'di ni shin tu rtogs dka' rlabs chen gsang ba'i mdzod yin phyir/ / kun gyi yul min mchog gsang rab ni rigs ldan 'gro ba'i thugs la gnas/ / gang 'dir bdag blo'i mtsho skyes tshal du tshig don rnam bkra'i gzugs snang ba/ / kun dga'i cha shas zla ba'i gzugs brnyan dwangs pa'i rdzing bur shar ba bzhin/ / gsal zhing yongs dag dkyil 'khor gang bas chu nang kun tu mdzes pa ni/ / lha yi thugs rje shin tu rmad byung ches dkar rol ba'i zung gis brgyan/ / tshul 'di skal bzang slob ma'i mchog gyur pa/ / blo bzang dge ba'i 'byung gnas dam pa dang*/ / dad ldan gtong phod srid zhu'i mchog gyur pa/ / shākya ye shes bzang pos bskul ba'i ngor/

/ ji bzhin don nyid spyod pa'i rnal 'byor bas/ / rgyud don zab mo'i rang bzhin mngon phyungs nas/ / gangs ri thod dkar rin cen snying po'i mgul/ / o rgyan rdzong zhes bya ba'i gnas su bkod/ / ji bzhin don nyid de ltar phye yang rgyud don rdo rje'i tshig brling pas/ / 'gal 'khrul nor ba'i rang bzhin mchis srid 'phags pa'i go 'phang ma thob phyir/ / rgyal dang rgyal sras bla ma'i tshogs dang blo mchog mnga' ba ji snyed dang*/ / ye shes las grub mkha' 'gro'i sprin phung dam can rgya mtshos bzod par mdzod/ / sngon rabs skye bar kam̐ ru'i shar phyogs bhe la he ta'i nags khrod du/ / ma hā mi tra padma'i rjes slob phyi nang grub pa'i don kun shes/ / de las 'dir 'ongs mdo rgyud gsal ba'i blo gros dam pa ngang gis grub/ / zab don snying po'i bdud rtsis rab brlan nges gsang snying po'i tshul 'dir mos/ / da ni rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin chen gter/ / phan bde'i 'od stong mnga' ba'ang nub tu nye/ / legs ldan 'gro ba'i mig kyang phal cher zum/ / gang na'ang chos tshul 'di 'dra dkon pas na/ / thos bsam snying po'i don la nan tan bskyed/ / nam yang mi rtag skyes bu'i tshe 'gro ste/ / wu ba brdol 'dra so sor 'jig gyur cing*/ / srid pa'i bde sdug 'khor mor 'khyams pa na/ / 'khor ba'i grong las zhi bde'i nags khrod du/ / rang bzhin 'da' bas brtson pa'i go bgos shog/ de bas rab tu thar ba'i lam zhugs te/ / de ring nyid nas srid la skyo ba yis/ / do mod tsam yang gnas pa'i mthu med ces/ / da lta nyid nas nges par bsam 'tshal lo/ /mdzo ldan rnams kyi ye shes gangs can mtsho/ / mtsho gter zab mo shin tu rmad byung dwangs/ / dwangs pa'i 'od kyis yon tan phun tshogs kun/ / kun nas brtson pas legs grub 'bad par mdzod/ / dus rnams kun tu dus gsum rgyal ba'i mdzad pa can/ / bla na med pa'i bla ma dam pa mnyes bya zhing*/

/ dam las mi 'da' dam tshig sdom pa tshul bzhin bsrung*/ / lhag bsam rnam dag lhag pa'i ting 'dzin zab mo bsgom/ / de ltar legs gsungs zhi ba'i chos tshul tshangs pa'i rnga sgra snyan po yis/ / ma rig gnyid myos 'jig rten gsum rnams skad cig de las rab sad de/ / ye shes dam pa'i go 'phangs la gnas gdod ma'i gzhi la mthar phyin nas/ / chos sku'i mkha' dbyings dri ma med la gzugs sku'i dkyil 'khor snang bar shog/ phyi nang snod bcud rigs lnga'i zhing du ma lus rang bzhin rnam dag cing*/ / nyon mongs ye shes dri ma med la dran rigs thugs kyi dkyil 'khor mchog/ ye nas yin la de ltar gsal ba'i glo bur sgrib gnyis rnam dag cing*/ / gang na'ang srid ces ming tsam med la thams cad kun bzang nyid gyur cig/ phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i rang bzhin gnyis med dpal ldan dga' ba'i skyed mos tshal/ / gdod nas mngon par byang chub tshul 'di gsal bar bkod pa'i legs byas des/ / 'gro bas rang bzhin 'bad pa med par zhi ba'i dbyings su legs gzhol te/ / sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pas sangs rgyas padma 'dzum par shog/ dpal ldan yon tan sprin gyi bzhon pa'i bla re shin tu gsal ba can/ / mdzad pa'i rnam 'gros nam mkha'i 'khor khyab phan bde'i char gyi tshogs mang ba/ / legs gsung rang bzhin gsang ba'i snying po rgya cher bshad pa'i bsod nams des/ / nam mkha'i mtha' klas skye rgu yongs kyi kun tu bzang po'i gnas thob shog/ las dang nyon mongs srid pa'i mtsho las brgal bar shog/ sa dang lam dang gzungs dang ting 'dzin 'grub par shog/ gnas skabs mthar thug re ba thams cad rdzogs par shog/ dag pa'i zhing rnams rgyal ba'i yongs gang mthong bar shog/ bgegs dang srin po mkha' 'gro'i gdon gyi tshogs zhi zhing*/ / tshe dang dpal dang skal ba bzang pos legs 'byor te/ / zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang mngon spyod 'grub pa yis/ / 'gro ba'i don gnyis rin cen mchog legs 'byung bar shog/

chos tshul 'di yang ji srid nam mkha' gnas kyi bar/ / 'gro ba'i don du de srid gnas pa'i don byed cing*/ / nyi zla'i mchog dang nor bu dpag bsam bum mchog bzhin/ / lhun gyis grub pa'i mdzad pa chen pos phyogs rnams kun tu khyab par shog/ gaṅgā'i chu bo rgyun ring ji bzhin 'dis kyang gzhan phan rgyun ring zhing*/ / 'od ldan rnams kyi bdud rtsi'i mchog bzhin nyon mongs gdung ba sel ba dang*/ / yid bzhin rin cen sprin gyi tshogs bzhin 'dod dgu'i re ba rnams skong zhing*/ / sa chen gling bzhi snang byed mchog bzhin yid mkha'i mun pa sel bar shog/ chos tshul ston ka'i ri bong 'dzin gzugs legs bshad rgyu skar phreng ba can/

/ don rnams gsal ba'i 'od dkar gyis mdzes blo gsal kunda'i kha 'byed pa/ / nyes pa'i cha shas sgrib pa med can ma rig mun pa sel ba'i dpal/ / blo gros rta lnga'i bzhon pas rab bskyod skal ldan 'gro ba'i snang byed yin/ / gang rnams phyi nang don rnams shes 'dod gzhung lugs rgya mtshor gnas bcas te/ / ji bzhin don nyid rnam dpyod mig gis de bzhin legs par blta 'dod pa/ / de dag gis kyang tshul 'di mthong na dga' ba'i blo gros cher 'phel cing*/ / grags dang ma grags tshig don rnam bkra'i tshul la shin tu mkhas par 'gyur/ / rgyud don rgya mtsho'i pha rol brgal 'dod pas/ / legs bshad rin cen gru bo 'dir zhugs te/ / don zab ba dan phyogs yangs brkyang byas nas/ / tshig don ji bzhin don gnyis blang bar rigs/ / 'dir ni rgyud don 'o ma'i chu gter mchog/ bdag blo'i rnam dpyod bzang pos legs bsrubs te/ / snying po'i rang bzhin bcud du rab bsdus nas/ / phyi rabs 'gro ba rnams la snang bar byas/ / phyogs tsam ma yin don kun gsal ba yin/ / grags phyir ma yin gzhan phan brtse ba yin/ / rnyed phyir ma yin chos don mthong phyin yin/ / nyes bshad ma yin legs bshad rgya mtsho yin/ / ye shes rnam bkra nor bu'i khang bzang dbang po'i gzhi dang dus mtshan dang*/ / nyi ma rnam bkra dkar ba'i mchog dang zla zer bdud rtsi'i skyed mos tshal/ / gzhi lam 'bras bu'i de nyid legs mtshon mchog gsang rdzogs pa chen po'i don/ / ma lus rang bzhin gcig tu bstan pa gsang ba'i snying po dam pa yin/ / 'od ldan rnams kyi snying po la reg padma'i drwa bas cher mdzes shing*/ / bdud rtsi'i lha dang mi'am cis mchod shin tu gsang ba'i mdzod mnga' ba/ / rgyal ba'i yum gyur kun gyi 'bras bu gsang ba'i snying por 'gro ba'i lam/ / de nyid legs gsungs rgya che'i tshul la chen po rnams kyis mchog tu bsngags/ / lam 'dir zhugs rnams kun las mchog gyur sa rab rig pa 'dzin la gnas/

/ lha mi'i 'jig rten mchog gi gtso dang drang srong grub pas phyag byas shing*/ / don gnyis 'bras bu tshe 'dir 'byor bas zhing gi dam pa rgya che ba/ / de phyir de dag 'byung ba'i mdzod ni rnam bshad rgya mtsho 'di yin pas/ / thar 'dod rnams kyis chos tshul mchog 'di gtsug gi rgyan du gus pas gzung*/ / dge legs yid bzhin ston ka'i sprin ni 'jig pa'i snang ba rgya che ba/ / 'od zer sna tshogs kun nas 'khrug cing zhing rnams bye ba gsal bar byed/ / ma lus de dag lam ldan 'dir brten legs pa'i 'bras bu mchog 'grub ste/ / phyogs bcu'i mgon pos rab tu dgongs shing kun nas bsngags par mdzad pa yin/ / dpal gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rnam bshad nyi zla'i sprin gyi snang ba chen pos phyogs bcu'i mun pa thams cad nges par sel ba zhes bya ba/ sngags dang pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul rgya mtsho la mang du thos shing legs par sbyangs pa'i me tog rgyun chags pas blo'i pad mtsho gang bar byas pa'i rang bzhin/ theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa rdo rje gzi brjid kyis sngon gyi 'grel chen du ma dang*/ bla ma rnams kyi legs bshad mngon par snang ba'i tshogs dang*/ rgyud lung man ngag du ma'i snying po bsdus te gzhan la phan pa'i blos shin tu gsal bar phye nas/ 'brug gi lo ston zla ra ba'i tshes bco lnga bkra shis kyi nyi ma shar ba la gangs ri thod dkar gyi mgul du legs par sbyar ba 'di yongs su rdzogs so/ / / / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (23) dpal gsang snying gi rgyud kyi 'grel pa phyogs bcu'i mun sel/ -PAGE 394--PAGE 519-mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (23) -PAGE 390-
